description:

===============

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.  
Join one of **Europe’s fastest-growing companies**.

**Your role**
-------------

* You own the creative angles for our campaigns and constantly develop new approaches
* You work closely with the Static Ads Designer and Content Creator to turn concept into finished output
* You operate autonomously; the Creative Director sets direction and gives final sign-off

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

* Experience scripting paid ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) with demonstrable performance
* You think in hooks and angles and understand what stops people in the feed
* You produce fast and at volume without sacrificing quality
* Genuinely excited about AI and the space

title: Micro-Drama Director (Creative Director) | 100% Remote
description:
**Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.**

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We're building an AI-powered entertainment studio producing addictive vertical micro-drama series for US audiences, primarily women aged 35–55.  
  
We're looking for a **creative director with exceptional storytelling instincts, strong cinematic taste, and a deep understanding of human emotions.**  
  
Your mission is simple: **turn good scripts into emotionally powerful episodes that people can't stop watching.**  
  
You'll work with screenwriters, AI video creators, and editors, taking creative ownership from script review to the final finished episode.  
  
You won't need to write the scripts or generate every video yourself. Your role is to guide the creative execution, identify what needs improvement, and ensure every episode meets our standards.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

**1. Script Review & Creative Direction**

* Review season storylines and individual episode screenplays.
* Evaluate storytelling, emotional impact, character motivations, hooks, and cliffhangers.
* Approve scripts or provide specific, actionable feedback to screenwriters.
* Add directing instructions only when necessary. If the script is already strong and production-ready, approve it without unnecessary changes.

**2. Direct AI Video Production**

* Establish the visual style and creative standards for each series.
* Guide AI video creators on cinematography, framing, character performance, lighting, and emotional delivery.
* Review generated footage and identify scenes or shots that need improvement.
* Maintain visual consistency and quality across episodes.

**3. Editing & Final Approval**

* Review episode edits for pacing, tension, emotional impact, music, sound design, and visual storytelling.
* Give clear, prioritized feedback to editors.
* Approve final episodes before release.
* Ensure the finished video delivers the intended emotional experience.

**4. Production Quality & Efficiency**

* Work with multiple AI video creators and editors.
* Help the team increase production speed without sacrificing creative quality.
* Identify recurring production problems and improve workflows.
* Use audience feedback and retention data to improve future episodes.

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

* **Exceptional storytelling instincts** – you understand why audiences feel anger, excitement, suspense, satisfaction, and anticipation.
* **Strong cinematic judgment** – you know how camera angles, acting, editing, lighting, and sound influence emotions.
* **Experience in directing or filmmaking** – ideally film, television, serialized drama, or narrative short-form video.
* **Understanding of AI filmmaking** – you know the capabilities and limitations of AI video generation and how they affect production decisions.
* **Strong attention to detail** – you easily spot continuity errors, weak performances, awkward cuts, or emotional moments that don't work.
* **Clear communicator** – you can explain exactly what's wrong, why it matters, and how to fix it.
* **Pragmatic** – you don't make changes just to make changes. You know when something is good enough to approve.
* **Comfortable with fast-paced production** – you can make strong creative decisions quickly.
* Excellent English communication skills.

**BIG PLUS**
------------

* Experience directing drama, romance, thrillers, soap operas, or telenovelas.
* Familiarity with ReelShort, DramaBox, or other vertical drama platforms.
* Experience with AI filmmaking tools such as Kling, Runway, Seedance, or similar.
* Experience leading creative production teams.
* Understanding of audience retention and performance-driven storytelling.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* Episodes consistently deliver strong emotional impact, hooks, and cliffhangers.
* Screenwriters and AI creators receive clear, useful feedback without unnecessary revisions.
* The team produces more high-quality episodes while keeping production costs under control.
* Finished episodes maintain consistent cinematic quality and improve based on audience feedback.

**THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**
---------------------------

Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.  
Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.  
Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

**FIXED SERVICE FEE**

€2,000–5,000 monthly service fee, depending on experience.

Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.

**LOCATION**
------------

Remote, hiring across selected European countries and South Africa.  
  
**RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* Application and portfolio review.
* AI interview.
* Practical creative directing test.
* Interview and trial period.

**PERKS & BENEFITS**

* Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Apploye ensures transparency and fairness.
* Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check.
* A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously.
* Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.
* A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.
* Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you.

**ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS**

This role is 100% remote.

* Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.
* For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy.  
  (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.)

Currently, **we are hiring in** Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

description:
**Who we are**
==============

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**The role**
============

We make a lot of content. Across a portfolio of DTC clients, our studio shoots and edits dozens of UGC ads every week. Most of it is good. Some of it is great. And the difference between good and great is specific: the hook that actually stops the scroll, the edit that holds attention, the subtle thing that makes a piece of content feel native rather than forced. That's what this role is about.

We’re looking for a Creative Lead (Social & UGC) to be the final creative eye before work reaches clients. You'll review raw footage, storyboards, and final edits, and give the kind of specific, hands-on feedback that actually improves the work rather than just flags problems.

You’ve made content yourself. You’ve been on set, you’ve been in the edit, you know what it takes to make a 15-second video that does something to the person watching it. You bring that maker's instinct to a quality and creative leadership role, and you use it to raise the bar across a whole studio.

**Timezone preference**
=======================

For this role, we're only considering candidates based in +/ 3 hrs CET time zone.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**Hold the creative quality bar**
---------------------------------

* Review storyboards, raw footage when necessary, and final edits before they go to clients
* Be the quality gate: if something isn’t ready, you say so clearly, and you explain exactly what needs to change and why
* Build and maintain the ad example library, creative checklists, and “what good looks like” guides that codify your instinct into something the whole team can learn from
* Spot recurring patterns: editing habits that aren't working, storyboard mistakes that keep appearing, hooks that aren't landing. Address them at the root, not ad by ad

**Give hands-on creative direction in post**
--------------------------------------------

* Review raw footage after shoots and provide clear direction on what’s usable, what’s not, and what to do differently next time
* Give precise editing feedback to our video editors: pacing, cut points, text overlays, sound design, the craft layer that turns a decent edit into something that performs
* Understand design fundamentals well enough to give direction on static assets, thumbnail frames, and text treatments: what reads on a phone screen and what doesn't
* Know what a 9:16 UGC ad needs to do in the first 2 seconds, and be able to articulate it in a way an editor can act on immediately

**Support production with a creative eye**
------------------------------------------

* Review storyboards before shoots and flag what isn’t shootable as written, what talent or set requirements are missing, and where the brief and the concept have drifted
* Give production the creative context they need to go into a shoot prepared: what angles matter, what the edit is going to need, what “good” looks like for this format and this brand
* Periodically join shoots at the Amsterdam studio (+-3 times a year) when creative stakes are high or a new format is being tested
* Over time, help build a visual reference library for the studio: what set styles, lighting setups, and shooting approaches produce the most versatile footage

**Drive platform and content intelligence**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain a genuine, current relationship with TikTok, Meta, and emerging short-form platforms: scrolling with a critical eye, not just awareness
* Curate a regular inspiration feed for the team: specific content examples with notes on why they work, what the craft decisions are, and how we could produce something similar in our studio
* Know the difference between a format worth adopting and a trend worth skipping, and be able to make the case either way
* Bring fresh creative references when the team’s output starts feeling formulaic or dated

**Build the team’s creative instinct**
--------------------------------------

* Give Creative Strategists feedback on CSPs and scripts that builds their creative eye over time, not just fixes the brief in front of them
* Run regular creative review sessions and inspiration shares that create a shared language for what “good” means at Creative Milkshake
* Be the person the team brings work to when they're not sure if it's there yet, and give them an answer they can trust

**Own CM’s creative identity externally**
-----------------------------------------

* Approve CM's own social content and website portfolio: what we put out about ourselves should reflect the standard we hold for clients
* Help define and document CM’s creative POV over time: the format instincts, the aesthetic signatures, the things that make our content recognizably ours

**Who you are**
===============

We’re not filtering on titles. We're looking for a specific type of person: someone with a sharp creative eye for what works on social, who wants to use that experience to raise the quality of an entire studio's output.

* 3–7 years of hands-on experience in video production, editing, content creation, or a creative role at a social-first agency or DTC brand. You've made things, not just briefed them
* A genuine, current feel for short-form social content: you scroll TikTok and Meta with a critical eye, you notice what’s working before it’s obvious, and you can describe the craft decisions behind it in specific terms
* Ability to understand paid media and performance marketing reports to inform creative decisions
* Real editing experience, or close enough collaboration with editors, that you speak the language of the edit
* Enough on-set or production experience to spot when a storyboard isn’t going to translate, and know what to do about it
* The ability to tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain why in a way the person who made it can actually use
* Feedback that is specific, timestamped, and producible, not vague creative notes that leave people guessing
* High EQ: you can give honest creative feedback without damaging the confidence or the relationship of the person on the other end
* Comfortable with ambiguity and pace: we're building systems while operating at volume
* Fluent in English, confident presenting creative rationale to clients when needed

**Backgrounds that tend to produce this person**
================================================

There’s no single path. People who are great at this role often come from one of these places:

* A video editor or post-production lead who has developed a strong creative eye for social, and wants to work upstream on quality rather than just executing edits
* A UGC creator or content creator who has built a real, granular understanding of what performs and why, and wants to bring that instinct to a studio environment at scale
* A creative producer who sits between strategy and production, has strong taste, and wants to formalise that into a quality leadership role
* A social content lead or in-house creative at a DTC brand who has been hands-on with short-form video and wants to take their creative judgement further

**What they all share: they’ve made things, they have taste, and they can teach it.**

**You’ll thrive here if…**
==========================

* You get genuinely excited about the craft of short-form video: the hook, the cut, the text timing, the sound. You find it hard to watch a mediocre ad without knowing what you'd fix
* You want a role where your creative instinct directly improves what goes out the door every week
* You’re energised by the challenge of holding a high standard at volume: lots of content, lots of clients, fast turnarounds
* You want to shape creative culture from the inside: setting a standard, building the resources that make a team better, defining what “good” means at a growing studio
* The idea of helping a UGC studio move toward elevated social-first content over the next couple of years sounds like exactly the right moment to join

**This role isn’t for you if…**
===============================

* You’ve only worked in creative strategy or performance marketing and haven’t been hands-on with video production or editing
* Your creative background is in brand identity or traditional advertising rather than short-form, social-first content
* You prefer to stay in the strategic or conceptual space and find production and editing detail less interesting
* You’re primarily looking for a people-management role. Your influence here comes through creative expertise, not team size

**What we offer**
=================

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare & internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO + 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

* Lead and inspire the Brand Studio team, raising the creative bar through strong direction, mentorship, and a high standard of craft, while continually exploring new ways of working — including AI tools and processes — used additively to extend the team's craft, never in place of it
* Lead the development of high-impact brand campaigns and creative platforms from concept through execution, bringing strong creative judgment to work across channels and formats
* Build brand into an operating system — standards, briefs, review cycles, and clear decision rights — paired with AI-powered, self-serve tools, and partner across Checkr to put those tools directly in every team's hands

title: Art Director Fiction, Children's Department
description:
Simon & Schuster, a global leader in general interest publishing, is dedicated to providing the best in fiction and non-fiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world’s most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well-known imprints and divisions such as Simon & Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Adams Media, Avid Reader Press, Simon & Schuster Children’s Publishing and Simon & Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  
The Job Profile
  
We are looking for an Art Director to lead children’s fiction design for Simon & Schuster Children’s Books. Based in London and reporting to the Creative Director, you will develop distinctive, commercially effective design from brief through to print. Working with designers, external contributors, Editorial and the wider publishing teams, you will deliver books, packages and brands that serve our authors and readers.
  
The Job Role
  
You will help shape the visual direction of children’s fiction, balancing creative ambition with audience, commercial and production needs. Reviewing manuscripts and briefs, you will guide creative decisions, present recommendations and resolve feedback while maintaining high design standards across formats, editions and campaign assets.
  
You will commission and direct illustrators, designers and other contributors, negotiating contracts and managing briefs, budgets, schedules, approvals and payments. Working closely with publishing teams, you will oversee delivery and address creative risks to keep projects on time and within budget.
  
With Editorial and Production, you will prioritise titles and deliver print-ready files to agreed schedules and specifications. You will also maintain organised artwork, files and project information, supply assets to Sales, Marketing and Rights, and support bibliographic updates and general administration.
  
The Candidate Profile
  
You will bring substantial experience of designing and art directing illustrated children’s books, preferably fiction covers and interiors, with a portfolio demonstrating strong concept development and finished work. You will have proven experience of commissioning and directing illustrators or other creative contributors, including managing briefs, fees, schedules and feedback. Sound knowledge of print production, pre-press, digital artwork and the technical requirements of book design is essential, alongside strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud and an understanding of the children’s fiction market, age-appropriate design, illustration talent and commercial publishing considerations.
  
With strong visual judgement, typography and art direction skills, you will be able to explain and defend creative choices clearly. You will confidently manage projects and budgets across multiple deadlines, combining careful attention to detail with a practical approach to solving problems. Your collaborative leadership style, constructive feedback and effective communication will support strong working relationships with colleagues and external partners. A formal design qualification or equivalent professional experience is required.
  
  
**Salary:**  
Competitive and benefits
  
  
Please apply with your CV and cover letter.

title: Art Director, Clash of Clans
description:
**Clash of Clans is one of the most recognisable games ever made. We want to keep it that way, and then some.**
Clash is growing beyond the game, showing up in trailers, campaigns, toys, and collaborations. The visual identity has to stretch to cover all of it, stay true to what players love, and still feel fresh. We're also modernising how we make things: pipelines are evolving, our content production is scaling, and we're working more closely with external partners than ever before.
  
  
We need someone who can own this at a strategic level. Someone who sets the vision, builds the conditions for great work, and steers the IP with confidence across every surface it touches.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Define and evolve the visual direction of Clash across the game, cosmetics, and wherever else the IP lives. True to its DNA, but never frozen in time.
* Set the standard for style and brand fit across in-game art, marketing, trailers, toy lines, campaigns, and entertainment partners, and empower the team to uphold it.
* Partner with game design, product, and marketing leadership to ensure art strategy supports gameplay clarity, player understanding, and long-term brand health.
* Mentor and support Clash artists, help them do the best work of their careers while staying aligned on the IP.
* Shape the roadmap for modernising Clash pipelines (2D to 3D, audio, tooling, and emerging technologies), championing approaches that give artists more time for the work only they can do.
* Represent art at a senior level across the business: outsourcing partners, Entertainment and Partnerships, marketing, and franchise collaborators.

What You Have
  
  

* A strong track record leading art direction on stylised games. Mobile and live-service experience is a big plus.
* Deep IP and brand instincts, the ability to define what's on-brand vs off and build the frameworks that help a whole team make that call consistently.
* Leadership experience on a highly collaborative senior art teams: setting vision, developing artists, and making the culture as strong as the output.
* Strategic experience managing outsourcing pipelines and external partners at scale, balancing quality ambitions with the realities of live-game timelines and budgets.
* Comfort operating in a low-process, high-trust environment where you own the outcomes, not just the opinions.
* A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have
  
  

* Experience with cosmetics economies or large seasonal content pipelines.
* Experience bridging game art strategy and marketing/UA: key art, trailers, social.
* Familiarity with Clash (as a player or from prior work) and a feel for how it's evolved.

Where You'll Be
  
  
This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. Clash of Clans team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios however most of our Artists are located in Helsinki!
  
  
To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role especially if based out of London.
  
  
–––
  
  
*That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.*
*Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.*
*–––*
**About Supercell**
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of
*Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars*
. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
  
  
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.
  
  
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
  
  
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
  
  
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
  
  
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.
  
  
**Benefits And Compensation**
Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
  
  
Relocation? Yes!
  
  
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
  
  
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
  
  
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
  
  
Wishing you all the best,
  
  
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Head of Brand | Betty UK
description:
**About Us:**

**Betty**
is an innovative entertainment company pioneering at the intersection of real-money online casinos and casual mobile gaming.

As our group continues to grow, we’re launching a new regulated venture in Great Britain.
**Betty UK**
is a startup company licensed by the Gambling Commission, as a casino operator in April 2026.

Our mission is to redefine the online casino experience by offering a uniquely transparent environment where players can relax, unwind, and enjoy themselves safely. We are committed to accessibility, fairness, and inclusivity, fostering a community of like-minded individuals who value ethical gaming practices and prioritize our players' safety and enjoyment above everything else.

**Our Values:**

* **We are Honest**
  - we value honesty in all aspects.
* **Bring the Olives**
  - we offer premium customer experience.
* **Think Big**
  - we believe in always striving for more.

**About the role:**

The Head of Brand shapes what Betty stands for in the UK and builds its recognition. The core challenge is to translate Betty’s product advantage into a compelling brand story that drives customer acquisition. You will also build and lead an in-house creative team, delivering video, design and social content for CRM, performance marketing and social channels at the pace and scale a live-operations business demands.

1. **Brand expression.**
   You adapt the Betty group brand for the UK market. You set the standard for how Betty looks, sounds and behaves across every UK touchpoint, including product, CRM, paid media, social and customer communications.
2. **Brand reach.**
   You build awareness and preference in the UK market, own brand media investment and agency relationships, and turn Betty from a challenger into a household name.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define Betty UK's positioning, brand platform and distinctive brand assets. Ground them in UK consumer insight and in a clear view of how we differ from the incumbents (Sky Vegas, bet365) and from challengers including MrQ, PlayOJO and Jackpotjoy.
* Turn Betty's product advantage into a brand story that changes player behaviour, not only perception.
* Express our product differentiators (no-wagering rewards, original games, engagement features, live operations) in ways that drive trial, conversion and loyalty.
* Make Betty distinctive and easy to find, so that the brand name, its assets and our UK presence point unambiguously to us.
* Work with the Betty group brand team to keep Betty UK consistent with the group brand's core identity, values and assets.
* Adapt the group brand for UK culture, humour, tone and regulation, and agree where the UK expression should differ from other markets and why.
* Share UK insights, creative and results with the group, and draw on group assets and learnings where they help the UK business.
* Own the UK visual identity, tone of voice and brand guidelines within the group brand framework, and make sure they are applied consistently across the business.
* Act as the final UK brand authority on creative output from internal teams, agencies and partners.
* Work with Product and Design so that the in-product experience delivers on the brand promise.
* Own the UK brand media strategy and budget across TV, BVOD, OOH, audio, sponsorship and partnerships, phasing investment in line with business milestones.
* Appoint and manage creative and media agencies, including briefs, commercial terms and performance.
* Build the case for brand investment and present it to senior leadership, with clear links to acquisition efficiency and long-term value.
* Build an in-house team of 4–6 across graphic design, motion and video, and social.
* Run an efficient creative workflow, from intake and briefing through production, approvals and asset management, serving the CRM, LiveOps, performance marketing and social teams.
* Work with performance marketing on creative testing, so that learnings from paid media shape brand creative and the reverse.
* Own Betty UK's organic social presence and community.
* Set up and track brand health metrics: prompted and spontaneous awareness, consideration, preference, share of voice and branded search.
* Measure the effect of brand activity on acquisition costs and conversion together with Marketing, Data and Finance.
* Make sure all brand and creative output meets Gambling Commission requirements, the CAP and BCAP codes, ASA guidance and industry codes on safer gambling advertising. Work closely with Compliance.
* Build safer gambling messaging into the brand rather than adding it afterwards.

**Requirements:**

* A track record of building a challenger brand that gained market share from incumbents. Experience in gambling is not required.
* Experience turning a product-led proposition into brand communications that measurably drove acquisition and conversion.
* Senior ownership of brand strategy, identity and above-the-line campaigns, including managing significant media budgets and agency relationships.
* Experience adapting an international or group brand to a local market while keeping it consistent.
* Experience building and leading in-house creative teams across design, video and social.
* Strong creative judgement together with commercial discipline. You can explain brand investment in terms of acquisition, retention and lifetime value.
* Experience working in fast-moving, data-led businesses where marketing operates at high volume and on short cycles.
* The ability to work credibly with product, CRM, performance, finance and group stakeholders.
* The ability to take on regulated advertising requirements quickly, if you are new to gambling.

**What success looks like**

* **First 6 months:**
  The UK brand positioning, identity and tone of voice are defined, agreed with the group, and adopted across the business. The core team is hired. The creative workflow is meeting the volume needs of CRM, performance and social.
* **First 12 months:**
  Agencies are appointed. The first UK brand campaign has launched against an approved budget. Brand health tracking is live with a clear baseline against Sky Vegas, bet365 and the leading challengers.
* **Within 24 months:**
  Awareness and consideration are measurably closing the gap with the incumbents. There is a visible effect on branded search, conversion and acquisition efficiency.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive salary
* Premium Health insurance
* Career and skills development opportunities
* Fun and collaborative team environment
* New modern office space

*At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location for this position on a full time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.*

title: Creative Director, Visual
description:
**Description**
**Some problems are too important for ordinary thinking.**
How do you change behavior at scale? Build trust when trust is hard to earn? Make something complicated feel simple? Get millions of people to see things differently—and do something about it?
  
  
These are the kinds of problems we work on at ICF Next. The stakes are high. The answers aren't obvious. And the work has to do more than look good.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Creative Director**
who loves that kind of challenge. Someone with a restless imagination, exceptional instincts and the ability to turn a difficult brief into an idea that feels inevitable once you've seen it.
  
  
Someone who knows great creative work doesn't happen by accident. It takes curiosity, conviction, craft and people who care enough to keep pushing.
  
  
**About ICF & ICF Next**
ICF is a global consulting and technology services company working on some of the most pressing challenges facing businesses, governments and communities. From energy and climate to public health, infrastructure and government, our teams bring deep expertise to problems that don't have easy answers.
  
  
ICF Next brings creativity into that equation.
  
  
We're writers, designers, strategists, technologists and creative thinkers working together to help organizations connect with people and move them to action.
  
  
We have the creative ambition of an agency and access to the expertise of a global consultancy. That combination gives us an unusual opportunity: to understand difficult problems from the inside, find the human story and create work that makes a difference in the real world.
  
  
There's no shortage of interesting briefs. The challenge is doing something extraordinary with them.
  
  
**The Role**
You'll lead creative across major client engagements, from the first conversation about a problem to the last detail of the finished work.
  
  
You'll find the idea that makes everything click. Set the visual direction. Push the thinking. Bring writers, designers, strategists and producers together around a shared ambition.
  
  
The work spans integrated campaigns, brand experiences, film, digital, social, experiential and whatever else the idea calls for.
  
  
You'll be expected to have a point of view, make decisions, challenge work that isn't good enough and know when to let a better idea win.
  
  
You'll also help shape the creative culture at ICF Next. Not through speeches about excellence, but through the work you make, the standards you set and the people you help develop.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Find the idea. Get beneath the brief, ask better questions and turn complicated challenges into original, compelling creative concepts.
* Set the standard. Bring a sharp eye, strong art direction and a deep respect for design, storytelling and execution. Care about the big idea and every detail that makes it work.
* Make people care. Take subjects that can be technical, sensitive or difficult to explain and make them clear, relevant and human.
* Think beyond the medium. Lead creative across digital, social, film, video, experiential, paid media, out-of-home and emerging platforms. Start with the idea, not the format.
* Make the team better. Inspire, mentor and challenge creatives. Give useful feedback. Recognize talent. Create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers.
* Stand behind the work. Present ideas with clarity and conviction. Build relationships with clients. Know how to push without making it personal, and how to protect a strong idea while making it stronger.
* Get it made. Work across disciplines, manage competing priorities and navigate the realities of complex projects without losing sight of what made the idea worth pursuing.
* Stay curious. Explore new tools, technologies and ways of working, including AI, without confusing what's new with what's good.

**Who You Are**
You came up through art direction or design, but you've never thought of yourself as just a visual person.
  
  
You think in ideas. You understand the power of an image, the precision of a line of copy and the way everything comes together to tell a story.
  
  
You have taste. You have opinions. You can explain both.
  
  
You know the difference between a clever execution and a genuinely good idea. You can spot what's missing, see what's possible and help a team get there.
  
  
You're comfortable leading a room, but you listen. You know how to sell an idea without overselling it. And you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves when the work needs you.
  
  
You've worked on difficult briefs, with demanding clients and tight deadlines. You've learned that constraints aren't an excuse for mediocre work.
  
  
Most importantly, you still get excited when something great comes together. You haven't lost the instinct to make it better.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of creative experience in an agency, design studio or comparable environment, including senior-level creative leadership.
* A portfolio that shows exceptional conceptual thinking, art direction, design craft and integrated creative work.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Experience leading creative teams and developing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Strong visual storytelling, strategic thinking and presentation skills.
* The ability to take ambitious ideas from concept through production while managing complex projects, stakeholders and deadlines.

**Why ICF Next**
The problems we work on aren't always easy to explain. They don't always come with glamorous briefs or obvious answers.
  
  
That's what makes them interesting.
  
  
You get to work with people who know their subjects inside out, tackle challenges that affect how people live and make decisions, and bring your creative instincts to places where they're genuinely needed.
  
  
There's room here for big ideas. For unexpected thinking. For the kind of work that makes you proud of what you do.
  
  
**If you believe the hardest problems deserve the best creative minds, we'd like to meet you.**
Show us your work. Show us how you think.
  
  
**Bot and Third-Party Applications**
Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. title: Creative Director
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.
  
  
We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.
  
  
Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.
  
  
We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.
  
  
If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.
  
  
****The Role****
Most B2B software looks the same. A few companies have proven it doesn't have to: brands with real taste, that people follow, wear and want to work for.
  
  
Behind every CPG brand you love is a back office nobody sees: the finance lead chasing a deduction at 11pm, the sales team planning a promotion blind, the founder watching margin leak line by line. Confido exists for them. Your job is to tell their story, and ours, so well that people who have never heard the words "trade spend" want to be part of it.
  
  
This is a principal-level role. You'll be our first creative brand hire and the keeper of how Confido looks and feels, setting the creative direction for the company and holding the final call on the craft. A new strategy and identity are underway with our agency partner, and you'll take it from a set of guidelines to a brand with a point of view: one customers share, candidates join for, and competitors quietly copy.
  
  
You'll own every place someone meets us, from the website and launches to decks, ads, events, video and the brand moments inside our product. As the work grows, you'll build and direct a bench of specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication. You'll report to our VP of Marketing and work closely with the founders.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Be the creative voice in the room. Partner with the founders and marketing leadership on how we tell our story and what the brand stands for
* Shape the brand from the ground up. Take the new identity from guidelines to a living system with a voice, a point of view and a standard people notice
* Find the story in the numbers. Turn customer outcomes, like $500K recouped for Feastables or revenue doubled with the same finance team at DUDE Wipes, into campaigns, films and stories people remember
* Make the invisible visible. Put the people, shelves, pallets and trucks of CPG at the centre of how we show up, never just another dashboard screenshot
* Own every surface. confido.com, launches, sales and customer decks, ads, social, email and the brand moments inside our product
* Create moments in the room. Concept and direct our booths, customer dinners and owned events so people leave talking about them. We care deeply about unreasonable hospitality - people should feel that across every experiential surface.
* Build your bench. Hire and direct specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication, with the templates, intake and asset library that let them do their best work
* Make brand and product one. Partner with our product design team so every touchpoint feels like the same company

****What We're Looking For****

* 8+ years in brand design, art direction or creative direction, in-house, at an agency, or both, including time leading brand for a company or major client
* You're a storyteller first. You can take a complex, unglamorous idea and make people feel something about it
* A portfolio with a brand system you built or scaled, and work you're proud to show anyone
* Taste you can defend. You know the difference between good and world class
* Range: you can move from identity and web to a sales deck, a booth and a photo shoot in the same week
* Hands-on craft in Figma. You sweat the kerning and what the work does for the business
* You own work from concept to production, including vendors, printers, fabricators and budgets
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and speed, communicate clearly, and can hold an idea through founder and sales feedback

****Nice to Have****

* Brand experience at a B2B software or fintech company known for its design
* Experience working with or for CPG brands
* Motion design and video editing
* Designing and building websites in a no-code tool
* Experience leading designers or managing freelancers and agencies
* AI tools in your creative workflow, used as a multiplier rather than a gimmick

****🌴 Perks + Benefits****

* Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
* Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
* Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
* Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
* 401(k) through Vestwell
* Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
* Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
* Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

*Confido provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*
Compensation Range: $230K - $270K

title: Art Director
description:
**About us**

At Pencil, we are building the AI Operating System for marketing — the only enterprise platform that aggregates every leading AI model, enforces enterprise-grade governance, and turns creative production savings into media growth. Our work moves brands like Diageo, L’Oréal and Unilever from creative brief to live, on-brand, performance-tested campaigns in minutes — across every market, channel and language — without sacrificing legal, IT or brand control.

**Your mission**

Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. You build and operate agentic and nodal creative workflows — connecting insight, concept, copy, imagery and video into scalable systems — so our creative teams and clients can move from idea to finished advertising faster, without losing quality or strategic grounding.

You work day-to-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision — you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.

**Reporting and partnerships**

* Reports to Juliette Suvitha, Head of AI Creative & Enablement.
* Briefs and reviews daily output from the wider Creative team, providing hands-on guidance rather than formal management.
* Works closely with Producers, the Creative Director, and Product teams to keep output strategically aligned and technically feasible.
* Feeds back to Product on tools, workflows and user experience based on hands-on use.

**Key responsibilities**

***Creative production***

* **Design and deliver:** creative assets across formats — advertising, digital and print — using GenAI tools.
* **Translate briefs into output:** turn briefs into polished creative work that aligns with project objectives and the relevant visual identity.
* **Support flagship projects:** contribute to creative production on projects that demonstrate Pencil’s product capabilities.
* **Juggle volume without dropping quality:** manage multiple creative requests simultaneously, maintaining quality and consistency across deliverables.

***Quality and client-facing work***

* **Brief and review:** brief the Creative team and review their daily output.
* **Own quality control:** provide daily quality checks on client decks and feedback.
* **Present with confidence:** present to clients on AI creative workflows.

***Collaboration and process***

* **Stay aligned:** work closely with Producers, the Creative Director, and Product teams to ensure output is strategically aligned and technically feasible.
* **Shape the platform:** provide feedback on platform and AI tools, workflows, and user experience to support ongoing product improvement.
* **Contribute ideas:** help define how GenAI shapes Pencil’s approach to storytelling and design in internal creative discussions.

***Innovation and growth***

* **Stay current:** keep up with emerging GenAI and design technologies, sharing insights and inspiration with the team.
* **Find better ways of working:** identify new techniques and workflows that enhance speed, consistency, or creative quality.
* **Improve what exists:** take initiative to improve creative systems, templates, and processes within your projects.
* **Keep growing:** seek feedback proactively and apply it to grow both your craft and your creative judgment.

**Your background**

* Experience as an Art Director or similar, ideally in advertising or digital production (essential).
* Hands-on experience with GenAI creative tools across image, video and design generation (essential).
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud or equivalent design tools (essential).
* Comfortable presenting creative work directly to clients (essential).
* A strong eye for visual identity, brand consistency, and craft (essential).
* *Please be prepared to showcase your portfolio.*

**You’ll thrive here if you...**

* **Detail-oriented:** You can run multiple creative requests at once without letting quality slip.
* **A hands-on leader:** You brief and review others’ work, but you’re still making things yourself.
* **Calm under pressure:** Daily quality checks and client decks don’t rattle you.
* **Curious:** You’re always exploring what new GenAI tools and techniques can do.
* **Collaborative:** You work well across Producers, the Creative Director, and Product.

**Your benefits**

* Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of GenAI.
* Sponsored professional and personal learning allowance
* Flexible vacation / time-off policy.
* Competitive health insurance and welfare cover.
* Fully remote work.

title: Art Director - all games
description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are one of the biggest Roblox studios by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 95+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Voldex is looking for an **Art Director** to lead and scale our Art function across our growing portfolio of live-service games. You’ll lead and develop our Art Leads, strengthen how our teams operate, and ensure we continue delivering high-quality, distinctive art across our games.

This role is ideal for an experienced art leader who brings together **strong artistic judgment, exceptional people leadership, and a deep understanding of art production**. You’ll partner closely with Art Leads and cross-functional leadership to navigate creative, technical, and production challenges, while ensuring our teams have the right structure, resources, and support to do their best work.

We’re looking for someone who knows how to lead through other leaders—coaching and empowering Art Leads while maintaining a strong quality bar and helping the broader Art organization scale. If you’re passionate about building great teams and creating exceptional player experiences, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the overall health, scalability, and performance of the Art function across all of Voldex’s games
* Lead, coach, and develop Art Leads, empowering them to own the visual direction and day-to-day leadership of their games independently
* Partner with Art Leads to establish, maintain, and evolve distinctive visual directions that resonate with each game’s players
* Maintain a portfolio-level view of art capacity, roadmap demand, delivery risks, and capability gaps across all games
* Allocate full-time and contract resources across competing priorities to ensure teams have the support needed to deliver their roadmaps
* Build and maintain a reliable network of high-quality art talent that can be engaged as needs change
* Lead art hiring end-to-end, partnering with Art Leads to source, evaluate, select, and onboard full-time, part-time, and contract talent
* Establish and improve art standards, workflows, review processes, and sign-offs that increase quality, consistency, and efficiency
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Producers, Engineers, and company leadership to translate product goals into clear and achievable art plans
* Guide Art Leads and cross-functional partners through tradeoffs involving artistic quality, technical performance, scope, and deadlines
* Ensure consistent, high-quality art delivery across all games without relying on sustained crunch
* Manage performance across the Art leadership team, including delivering direct feedback, supporting development, and addressing performance issues when necessary

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Proven leadership of an Art function supporting multiple games (ideally), products, or teams simultaneously, with accountability for overall quality, capacity, delivery, and performance
* Deep experience leading sizable art organizations, including managing teams of at least 25 full-time employees and directly managing multiple Art Leads or other art people managers
* A strong track record of coaching and developing Art Leads into stronger, more independent leaders, alongside extensive people management experience including difficult feedback, performance improvement, and terminations
* Experience overseeing distinct visual directions across multiple games or products, with the artistic judgment to maintain a high quality bar across different styles and audiences
* Strong artistic and technical expertise spanning 3D art, animation, 2D art, and technical art, including direct experience leading teams responsible for 3D asset creation
* Experience establishing technical art standards that balance visual quality with reliable performance across supported devices
* Strong art production and resource management experience, including portfolio-level capacity planning and allocating full-time and contract talent across competing priorities
* A track record of consistently delivering high-quality art against roadmap commitments without relying on sustained crunch
* Experience leading Art within a live-service environment with regular content and game updates
* End-to-end art hiring experience, from identifying capability gaps and partnering with recruiters on sourcing through evaluating artistic and technical talent and making hiring decisions
* Experience building and scaling teams using a mix of full-time, part-time, and freelance/contract talent as production needs change
* Experience hiring and managing distributed, international teams across multiple markets and time zones

**Nice to Have**

* Experience serving as the senior-most leader of an Art organization, including reporting to a leader outside of the art discipline
* Roblox Studio and Roblox development experience, with an understanding of the platform’s technical and performance considerations
* Experience working within an art organization of similar size or complexity to Voldex, ideally managing teams of 40+ full-time employees
* Experience overseeing art across multiple game genres, audiences, and visual styles simultaneously
* Experience working on games involving external brand or IP partnerships with specific creative guidelines, approvals, or requirements
* A strong network of art talent and experience independently sourcing and hiring freelance or part-time artists as needs arise

**Tech Stack**
--------------

Please see below Voldex’s art stack in case you are interested:

* Roblox Studio
* Blender
* Photoshop
* Substance Painter
* Blender
* Maya
* Figma

*Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status*

**Permanent Voldex employees enjoy the following benefits:**

Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options

Retirement benefits - company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!

Medical, dental, and vision benefits - depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.

Remote First - we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere

In-person get-togethers, virtual company-wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more!

Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

title: Senior Director Creative Strategy
description:
Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care and body care. COTY is the global leader in fragrance and number three in color cosmetics. COTY’s products are sold in over 150 countries around the world. COTY and its brands are committed to range of social causes as well as seeking to minimize its impact on the environment. For additional information about Coty Inc., please visit www.coty.com.
  
  
**MISSION**
Reporting to the SVP Brand & Equity, the role of Creative Strategy Snr Director, Consumer Beauty will be fully responsible for leading creative strategy across the iconic brands within the CB portfolio: across Color cosmetics and Mass scenting.
  
  
This pivotal role will partner with the creative teams and brand teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – writing innovative creative strategy, cultural levers and conceptual ideas borne of consumer insight.
  
  
This is a hybrid role, half strategist half creative. The Creative Strategy Snr Director – Consumer Beauty might need to write a headline one day, write a compelling pithy presentation the next, a script the next, and think through what the cultural springboard is for a brand or a campaign. Or take the SVP’s place in a creative review to ensure the work is clear, effective and impactful, and refined until delivery. All while taking pressure off the SVP to free up focus for higher-level priorities.
  
  
Coty is a challenger brand; work is intense and entrepreneurial. It is agile and fast. Immediacy and hands on attitude is critical. Autonomy is pivotal.
  
  
Please note that whilst this position will be based in our Wimbledon Office, we do offer a flexible Omni-working policy which means that up to 50% of your hours will be based from the office and the remaining 50% of your hours can be remote.
  
  
**THE ROLE**

* Leading Creative strategy across the iconic brands within the Consumer Beauty portfolio.
* A unicorn with the ability to write disruptive creative strategy, borne of consumer insight, and concept ideas with the creatives.
* Critical ability to write in a pithy and provocative way, with fearless clarity.
* Partner with the creative teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – helping generate vital creative thought starters which can be further developed.
* Pivotal ability to help teams (creative and brand) ‘see’ the idea amongst the clutter of creative development; articulating, expanding, and presenting story telling in a way that becomes unmissable and strategically flawless.
* Develop product claims and (both traditional and contemporary) to create something innovative that the world cannot miss!
* Responsible for creative strategy across color cosmetics, personal care, nail and mass scenting/fragrance.
* Social first thinker - with the ability to brand build in the new Meta led landscape our brands now live in.
* Connected to global culture, knowledgeable.
* GLOBAL - this is global business. Must be well versed in US beauty, as well as European beauty.
* A realist - not precious – if it doesn’t work or is too highbrow, move on!
* Hand-On. Not a floater waiting for other to action.

**What You’ll Bring**
Knowledge and Experience:
  
  

* 15+ years experience in an agency/in-house brand creative strategist.
* Global in outlook
* TikTok and socially savvy.
* Consumer first thinker.
* Ability to co-create with the SVP Brand & Equity, the creative teams, third parties and the brand teams within a highly collaborative environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of hierarchy with both multifunctional partners and with external stakeholders.
* A ‘roll the sleeves up do-er’ not a floater. We are an entrepreneurial set of people that think and do, and we do it fast.
* Ability to work autonomously under pressure.
* Agile and adaptable as the business and brand environment changes daily.
* Experienced in the new beauty world - not the old traditional world.
* A good beauty aesthete - this person needs judgment and an eye. They will take responsibility for the work being on brand, on strategy and effective (passing IPSOS tests, and driving in market growth)

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* Ability to think creatively, highly-driven and self-motivated.
* Digitally literate and culturally plugged in.
* Well versed in UK/EU/Global mass consumer beauty universes (color cosmetics and fragrance)
* Ability to work in an international business context.

**CONCLUDING**
You’ll get to work in a diverse and environment with a team who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way. Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you’re the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Head of Creative
description:
**Intro**

 

Founded by sisters Louisa and Rebecca, Regalrose is a British-born ecommerce jewellery retailer with over 15 years in business. Specialising in uniquely designed jewellery and accessories with a fierce edge and dreamy-dark twist, Regalrose is going from strength to strength as demonstrated by our exceptional growth over the last few years. We have built up a loyal community of passionate fans and customers, delivering our products to over 80 countries worldwide. We are now looking for an outstanding and experienced Head of Creative to join our team in our offices, located in St Albans.

 

 

**About You**

 

You will be a driven, self-motivated creative leader with an exceptional eye for brand and at least 10 years’ creative experience, or experience running a creative function as a Head of, Director or Senior Manager – ideally in fashion, jewellery or accessories. You will hold very high standards, make fast, confident creative calls under pressure, balance creativity with commercial awareness, and stay hands-on with asset creation while leading a team.

 

 

**Requirements and Skills**

 

As Head of Creative, you will be the guardian of the Regalrose brand – owning how it looks, sounds and feels across every channel, campaign and the website. Working from the founders’ vision, you will turn each collection into concepts, briefs, photography, copy and assets, lead the in-house creative team and have final creative approval on all outward-facing marketing. You will work as a peer to the Head of Marketing, who owns the commercial and go-to-market plan.

 

 

**The Role and Accountabilities**

Overall goal: Protect and grow the Regalrose brand by ensuring every piece of marketing and website output is on brand, to the highest standard and right first time.

 

*Brand guardian:*


 

* Final creative decision-maker, with a brand veto on any marketing output.
* Own the brand guidelines, copy and content rules, tone of voice, and social narrative and seasonal themes.
* Keep the brand culturally relevant, filtering trends and performance insight through the brand lens.

*Collection & campaign launches:*


 

* Turn the founders’ campaign vision into concepts, themes and the creative brief for every launch.
* Develop the founders’ photoshoot concepts and lead photoshoot direction.
* Own copywriting, artboard production and delivery of all assets; approve all copy, emails and assets before launch.

*Channel & website creative:*

 

* Assets, copy and tone of voice for paid media, social, CRM, blog, PR and the website (product descriptions, e-commerce imagery, banners).

*Partnerships:*

 

* Set the creator criteria across the four influencer pillars, sign off creator content and make the final call on Muse creators.
* Own the content of paid and brand collaborations; identify licence and influencer collaboration candidates.

*Leadership & budget*
**:**

 

* Line manage the in-house creative team (currently Graphic Designer and Content Creator) and external creative suppliers.
* Own the creative production budget and decide whether new or ad-hoc go-to-market elements can be resourced.
* Present creative strategy to the founders at agreed steer points; collaborate with the Head of Marketing and other department leads.

 

This is not an exhaustive list of tasks.

 

 

**Qualifications Required**

* 8+ years’ creative experience, or experience running a creative function (Head of, Director or Senior Manager)
* Ideally from a fast-paced retail, fashion or jewellery/accessories brand; ideally degree qualified in a creative discipline
* Brand management across digital, social, CRM, web, print and packaging
* Art direction of shoots and video; strong copywriting and editing
* Hands-on with Adobe Suite (specifically Illustrator), CapCut and Klaviyo
* Creative team leadership and budget ownership

 

Due to the nature of our business, our peak time stretches from November to January. As a small yet growing business, annual leave must be kept to a minimum during those months.

 

 

**Regalrose Values**

At Regalrose, we don’t follow trends, we create them – putting our customers at the heart of everything we do. Together we turn ideas into reality, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. If you're ready to make an impact and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want you with us.

 

 

**Team Structure**

 

Line Manager: Managing Director

 

Direct Reports: In-house creative team (currently Graphic Designer and Content Creator)

 

Works closely with: Founders, Head of Marketing, Social Media Executive, Buying & Merchandising, Quality Control and Customer Experience.

 

 

**Salary & Benefits**

 

Salary range: £55-£70K

* Employee discount
* Bonus scheme
* Flexitime
* Casual dress
* Company events
* Health & wellbeing programme
* Free on-site parking
* Taxi service provided from train station
* Enhanced Sick pay

 

**Hours:**

Flexitime Monday to Friday between the hours of 8.00am – 5pm (37.5 hours per week – 7.5 hours per day).

 

 

**Job Type:**

Full-time, Permanent, 4 days on-site and 1 day remote per week.

 

 

**Location:**

Office based role (4 days per week), St Albans, AL3 6PA

 

 

**Application Details:**

Please send your cover letter to careers@regalrose.co.uk explaining how you would be suitable for the role, along with your up-to-date CV and portfolio.

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
  
  
**Job Description**
Location:
  
  
London, GB
  
  
Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House & Garden and Tatler, among many others.
  
  
We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
  
  
Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday - Thursday).
  
  
We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
  
  
Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
  
  
Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
  
  
Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high-stakes, multi-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi-market event sponsorships.
  
  
You excel at guiding cross-functional teams through complex, fast-paced workflows, bringing executive-level problem-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
  
  
Individual & Team Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop bold multi-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.

**Desired Qualities**

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
  
  
***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Creative Director
description:
Ibotta is seeking a
**Creative Director**
to join our innovative team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. As Creative Director, you will shape how the world sees Ibotta as a leading technology company, elevating our look and feel across all enterprise marketing and communications while ensuring on-time delivery and efficient operations.
  
  
You will lead our creative studio to develop distinctive brand assets and impactful campaigns that build Ibotta's awareness and grow advertising revenue in the CPG industry. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of strategic thinking, creative excellence, and team leadership to drive our brand's impact and growth. This leader will be expected to have proficiency in design, copywriting, or video production, and will be asked to roll up their sleeves as a practitioner to guide execution and help the team produce exceptional work.
  
  
This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States.
  
  
**Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one.**
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build corporate brand identity and creative guidelines for Ibotta to show up visually and experientially across every touchpoint with distinction.
* Lead and mentor a diverse team of creative professionals across design and production, fostering a culture of proven concept, craft, and collaboration while ensuring consistent creative execution.
* Partner closely with product, analytics, marketing, and leadership teams to drive brand consistency and elevate Ibotta's market presence.
* Help translate complex product offerings, data, and value propositions into clean, engaging creative concepts.
* Establish and optimize operational processes to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability of creative output.
* Lead creative reviews, provide actionable feedback, and foster a culture of craft, curiosity, and innovation.
* Serve as a key brand ambassador internally and externally, articulating creative vision and strategy clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Manage team health, resource planning, and talent strategy, ensuring the right capabilities, skills, and staffing are in place to meet business needs.
* Embrace and uphold Ibotta’s Core Values: Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, & A good idea can come from anywhere

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience as a hands-on creative with a proven track record across diverse media (agency and in-house). In-house experience is strongly preferred.
* 4+ years of experience leading creative teams in dynamic, fast-growing companies, ideally with a B2B / tech focus.
* A portfolio or sample of work demonstrating excellence in creative direction, brand identity, and multi-channel campaign execution.

* Confidence in establishing and scaling creative operations and processes in fast-growing environments.
