title: Head of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Head of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

title: Creative Director - Growth / Experiential
description:
About Us:

**Who We Are**  
  
At Left Field Labs, we turn complex concepts, emerging technologies, and often ambiguous challenges into irresistible experiences people can see, touch, and understand. Experiential moments where abstract ideas become clear, irressistible, and tangible.

Our positioning is simple:

**We Make It Real.**

We’re looking for a Creative Director who can do exactly that shape bold ideas, tell the story that sells them, and lead — not dictate — teams to bring them to life.

Overview:

**THE WORK**

This role sits inside our GROWTH & NEXT Pods, working across some of the most ambitious and creatively open territory in the industry:

  

* Experiential environments — brand worlds, immersive spaces, permanent and touring installations
* Themed entertainment — narrative environments, attraction concepts, destination experiences
* Brand activations — moments that earn attention, build belief, and convert audiences into advocates
* Interactive and technology-enabled work — experiences where the audience participates, not just observes

You’ll lead creative across the full arc: from early pitch and concept development through to final execution. That means being as sharp in a competitive pitch room as you are on a build site walkthrough.

Responsibilities:

**HANDS-ON CRAFT**

This isn’t a role for someone who only directs from a distance.

We want someone who can get into the work — who can open a file, shape a frame, and contribute meaningfully to what’s on screen or in the room. Specifically, we’re looking for hands-on fluency in:

* **Graphic and/or digital design** — Visual systems, spatial graphics, concept visualization, motion
* **3D** — Environmental modeling, spatial concept development, real-time rendering

Both is exceptional. One is the floor. Either way, your hands-on capability should show up in how you direct, how you review, and how quickly you help a team find the right answer.

**THE QUESTION WE CARE ABOUT**

AI is everywhere.

Clients use it. Teams use it. Partners use it. So do we.

The real question isn’t whether you use AI — it’s how you use it to gain an advantage.

We want to understand:

  

* How AI expands your creative exploration
* How it helps you uncover insights others miss
* How it strengthens ideas instead of flattening them
* How it accelerates thinking without outsourcing judgment

In short: **How does AI make you a better Creative Director, not just a faster one? (or a lazier one.)**

  
Required Skills:

**TABLE STAKES**

There are fundamentals every Creative Director here must bring.

* + **Great Work** — A portfolio of ideas that live beyond the slide deck. Work that exists in environments, systems, installations, or interactions. Show us things that were actually built.
  + **Pitch Leadership** — You know how to shape and sell ideas in competitive environments. You understand what converts opportunity into business — and you can carry a room.
  + **Storytelling** — You craft narratives that capture attention, build belief, and move clients to act. From concept decks to client presentations, your work reads and performs.
  + **Team Leadership** — You elevate the people around you. Clear direction, strong taste, and the generosity to help others do their best work. Not a gatekeeper. A multiplier.
  + **Taste & Clarity of Vision** — You understand the difference between novelty and meaning, spectacle and substance. You push for both.

Qualifications:

**BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE**

Experience across two or more of the following areas will set you apart:

* Experiential marketing and brand activations at scale
* Themed entertainment, attraction design, or narrative environment development
* Permanent or touring installations
* Technology-forward or interactive experience design
* Cultural moments; festivals, tentpoles, world’s fairs, fan experiences

We’re less interested in a single lane and more interested in someone who has genuine range and the creative ambition to push further in each direction.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $150,000-$200,000. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in Culver City, California. This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

**THIS IS A REMOTE OPPORTUNITY IN THE US.**

The **Experiential Creative Director** is the strategic and creative lead responsible for shaping world‑class exhibition and event experiences across the healthcare and aerospace sectors. This role blends narrative craft, spatial storytelling, and industry‑specific insight to create immersive environments that elevate brand presence, simplify complex technologies, and drive meaningful audience engagement.

You will guide multidisciplinary teams —3D, digital, brand and experience design — to deliver concepts that are bold, human, and commercially effective.

**Company Overview**

This is Spiro. A strategically-led, creatively-driven, leading global experiential agency. We exist to cultivate powerful brand connections through the channel of experiential. We believe strong global communities are empowered by diversity, inclusion & belonging.

Where data-informed creative meets advanced digital solutions, we boldly go where no experience has gone before. As Spiro•nauts, we are born storytellers & story makers; fearless dreamers of the “what if;" and pioneers of innovation in our craft. Together, we launch brands into their experiential orbit through the power of Brand Gravity.

Learn more about who we are here (https://www.thisisspiro.com/who-we-are/)!

**Responsibilities:**

**Creative Leadership & Storytelling**

* Develop compelling experience narratives that translate complex healthcare and aerospace innovations into clear, emotionally resonant stories.
* Craft overarching creative platforms that unify spatial design, content, technology, and attendee journey.
* Lead ideation sessions, creative development, and pitch storytelling with clarity, confidence, and vision.
* Champion narrative coherence across every touchpoint — from pre‑show engagement to in‑booth interactions.

* Translate brand strategy and technical product information into immersive physical environments.
* Ensure creative intent is maintained through design development, prototyping, and fabrication.
* Guide the integration of digital, interactive, and sensory elements that enhance the physical experience.

* Interpret complex aerospace technologies, systems, and engineering narratives into accessible, engaging experiences.
* Stay ahead of industry trends, audience expectations, and emerging technologies relevant to both sectors.

* Review 3D outputs, content, and environmental storytelling to maintain quality and consistency.

* Explore emerging experiential technologies, materials, and engagement formats relevant to exhibitions.
* Drive experimentation and pilot new approaches that differentiate clients on the show floor.
* Inspire teams with forward‑thinking creative methodologies and sector‑specific innovation.

* Proven experience as a Creative Director or Senior Experiential Creative within exhibitions, events, or spatial storytelling.
* Strong narrative craft with the ability to simplify complex healthcare or aerospace subject matter.
* Deep understanding of exhibition design, attendee behaviour, and environmental storytelling.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with 3D teams and translate ideas into spatial concepts.
* Confident presenter with exceptional communication and storytelling skills.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing creative development from concept to execution.
* Familiarity with Adobe creative tools and expertise in harnessing the power of AI technologies to visualise creative ideation
* Possess the presence and experience to interface at executive level
* Generate and present thought leadership on behalf of the agency
* Maintain an effective working relationship with all company departments, with particular emphasis on a team approach to projects.

**Experience & Requirements**

We understand the importance of transferrable skills and a diverse perspective, so if you do not fit all these requirements, we still want to hear from you and encourage you to apply!

* Minimum of 8+ years of experience in an experiential creative agency with a particular focus on experiential events & activations in the exhibition industry.
* Strong leadership skills – ability to build, develop and motivate winning teams, supported by your coaching and mentoring skills
* Excellent customer and inter-company relationship skills
* Proven experience in managing small and large creative projects from inception to project closeout, including follow-up methodology
* Strong ability to work under pressure.
* Some travel required.

**How to measure success**

* By 30 days incumbent should understand team dynamics and perform basic job functions independently
* By 60 days incumbent should be self-reliant on basic job functions and begin executing more complex tasks
* By 90 days, incumbent should have ownership over specific projects

**Benefits**

In general, you can expect to have an initial phone interview with our talent acquisition team and thereafter video interviews with team members and your future manager. title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two-sided platforms
* Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

**Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

**Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

**References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

* Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
* Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
* Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

**Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

title: Installation and Logistics Principal Engineer
description:
As the Principal Engineer for Installation and Logistics, you are responsible for the overall technical underwriting and acceptance of design, development, and implementation associated with wind turbine installation processes and site logistics. You will support defining rigor for acceptance of the design decisions for installation tooling and processes, lifting strategies and logistics strategy that will result in safe, high-quality products and services that meet customer needs.
  
  
The areas associated with Installation and Logistics include crane operations, lifting equipment design, site mobilization, transport logistics, ground preparation and up-tower installation support. For these areas, you will support Senior Principal Engineers and Chief Engineers to set and execute a strategy associated with design processes, field issue resolution, and design tools and technology.
  
  
You will collaborate with design teams, cross-functional teams and other designated experts across subsystems to achieve desired outcomes, sometimes executing the work yourself. You will mentor and develop engineering talent, creating technical depth within the Installation and Logistics domain.
  
  
This is a leadership position and requires technical proficiency and adept problem-solving skill while developing fundamental capabilities for organizational advancement.
  
  
As the Principal Engineer for Installation and Logistics your curiosity, problem-solving skills, and ability to lead design teams will be crucial in ensuring we can technically underwrite that our products and services are of high quality and meet customer needs. Your passion for innovation, your capacity to solve technical challenges head-on, and your ownership to develop technical talent will drive your success in OneWind Engineering.

**Job Description**
===================

* Provide technical leadership and guidance to the design teams involved in Installation and Logistics within the OneWind engineering team across all stages of the project lifecycle, spanning from conceptualization and design development to product launch and ongoing fleet operations.

* Accountable for overall technical underwriting of designs in the areas of Installation and Logistics and site execution processes, and consequently, accountability for the design itself.

* Influence technical rigor for acceptance of design decisions, DFMEA, root cause analysis, design methods and tools.

* Identify and drive continuous improvement in engineering design processes, design practices for Installation and Logistics to enable engineering design execution that results in safe, high-quality products and services by working with design teams, CTHs, and cross functional teams.

* Assist the design team and sometimes execute the optimization of the design ensuring compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and customer requirements.

* Provide technical support and expertise to internal and external stakeholders, including customers, suppliers, and regulatory authorities.

* Stay informed and participate in relevant industry regulations, Intellectual Property and standards committees to influence the outcome of regulations and standards.

* Perform risk assessments and assist teams in developing mitigation strategies to address technical challenges and ensure safe, high-quality products and services.

* Work strategically with Product Line, Field Services, and New Unit NPI segments to ensure that installation and logistics requirements are "built-in" to turbine designs at the earliest stage (Design for Installation).

* Provide insight to Senior Principal Engineer, Chief Engineer of the Lifecycle Organization, and Functional Managers to identify technology needs and support technology development to address those needs.

* Cultivate a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth through coaching & mentoring for controlled title holders and broader engineering team in your discipline.

**Qualification / Requirements**

title: Head of Non-Gaming Partnerships (Mediation)
description:

Our mission is to create a high-performance marketplace where publishers maximize value and advertisers access premium inventory with full transparency and control.  
We are proud of our technology, our ambitious vision, and our globally distributed team of talented professionals who continuously raise the bar in AdTech.

**Here's what we value, and what we hope you do too:**

**Ownership & Accountability**  
We move fast, take responsibility, and think like builders. Every team member has a direct impact on product growth and market success.

**Data-Informed Excellence**  
We leverage data to make smarter decisions, optimize performance, and build scalable solutions that deliver measurable results.

**Innovation & Technical Depth**  
We solve complex programmatic challenges with cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of the ecosystem.

**Global Collaboration**  
We work across cultures, time zones, and disciplines — united by shared goals and high standards.

**Ambition & Impact**  
We are here to build something significant — a best-in-class exchange that competes with the strongest players in the market.

BidMachine is looking for a hands-on **Head of Non-Gaming Partnerships (Mediation)** to bring non-gaming app publishers onto our mediation platform and grow them.

This role combines go-to-market and product for one segment: non-gaming apps such as utility, weather, fitness, health, news, AI and consumer-brand apps. You'll choose which segments and markets to win first, sign the publishers, get them integrated and live alongside the platforms they already run, and hand them over to our account-management team once they're integrated. The first direct non-gaming publishers are already live, so you start from real accounts and a revenue target, not a blank page.

Success here isn't measured by activity or meetings. It's measured by the gross profit the non-gaming publishers you bring live generate, how efficiently your squad runs, and how repeatable the path to the next publisher becomes.

You'll build and lead a small squad across commercial, product and engineering work, and work closely with the other mediation squads, our exchange and our sales team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has worked at a company with its own mediation and knows that the largest platforms win publishers on brand. Non-gaming publishers won't come to us that way: they have to be won outbound, from a platform they already use. We're looking for someone who understands the SDK and the integration well enough to make a demanding publisher say yes, and who turns what publishers ask for into product changes that ship.

**Location:** Barcelona, Spain (4 days in the office, 1 remote). Relocation supported.

### **Responsibilities:**

**Choose where to play**

* Pick the non-gaming segments and markets to go after first, and say why.
* Write the plan, with a revenue goal and the leading indicators you'll track every week.

**Sign non-gaming publishers**

* Lead the commercial effort for the segment, outbound, together with our sales and business development teams.
* Win publishers from the platform they use today: understand their stack, their objections and what it takes for them to switch or add us.

**Get them integrated and live**

* Own the path from signature to live traffic, working with engineering, alongside the other mediation and ad platforms the publisher already runs.
* Go after quality inventory: native and video formats and strong audiences, with banners where they still earn.

**Shape the product**

* Translate what non-gaming publishers need (formats, demand, integration effort) into clear requirements for the SDK and the platform, and follow them through until they ship.
* Make the case for non-gaming needs on a roadmap and a shared SDK you don't own, with numbers from real publishers.

**Ramp and hand over**

* Take each account to live and earning, then hand it to the account-management team with the terms written down and nothing lost.

**Build and lead the squad**

* Choose the people the work needs, set priorities and keep the squad as small as the job allows.

**Watch the market and write it down**

* Track how competing mediation platforms work with non-gaming publishers, market by market.
* Keep plans, decisions and the state of each integration written down where the team can see them.

### **Requirements:**

* **Mediation experience.** You have worked at a company that runs, or ran, its own mobile ad mediation platform, in a product, go-to-market, partnerships, publisher business development or solutions role with real scope.
* **Product and commercial in one person.** You have signed publishers and you have shaped a product. You are technical enough to discuss SDKs, integrations, bidding and waterfalls with engineers.
* **Non-gaming or brand publisher experience.** You have worked with app publishers outside games and can describe what you did to bring them on and grow them.
* **More than one region.** You have worked with publishers in more than one market.
* **Team leadership.** You have led a team, even a small one: chosen people, set priorities and coached them.
* **Demonstrated AI experience, required.** Practical hands-on use of AI tools in publisher, partnerships or product work, with the ability to describe the specific workflows you improved, the results delivered, and how you validated the output.

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience on a mediation platform that grew significantly while you were there.
* Native and video formats, and publisher audience or data monetization.
* Spanish.

With a powerful product, strong market positioning, and a team that strives for excellence, BidMachine offers a unique opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a tangible impact in the programmatic advertising space.

**Build the future of mobile AdTech with us!**

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Wind Turbine Driveline Systems
description:
The successful candidate will be a part of GE Vernova’s Wind Global Machine Head Driveline subsystem. The team is responsible for mechanical hardware (main bearing, main shaft, covers, rotor locks, rotor brakes, and couplings) including New Product / Technology Introduction, Validation & Testing, Field Support, and Root Cause Analysis for utility scale wind turbines.
  
  
This position will primarily support the high speed rotor lock, rotor brake, and flex coupling through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, validation, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

**The Opportunity**

Wind turbine reliability is engineered before a single blade turns — in the design of the rotor brakes, locks, and couplings that have to perform for decades in some of the most demanding environments on earth. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at GE Vernova, you will own the full design lifecycle for Machine Head Driveline subsystem components across the wind turbine fleet: from specification and analysis through validation testing, root cause investigation, and standardization across the global product portfolio.

This is a role for someone who combines deep mechanical design expertise with the judgement to make consequential decisions independently — and the collaborative instinct to bring manufacturing, sourcing, quality, and field teams along with them.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead component design and development** — design build-to-spec rotor brakes & couplings and build-to-print rotor locks for wind turbines; own component specification design, system interaction analysis, and reliability verification through physical testing; drive new product introduction and new technology integration from concept through to validated production release.

* **Own design quality and documentation standards** — ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs (Bills of Materials), and specifications in accordance with GE Vernova and industry processes; own and drive lessons learned, design best practices, and standardization into design practices, drawings, and technical specifications.

* **Develop and execute validation plans** — design testing and validation programs to prove component function and reliability; resolve field issues through root cause analysis and identify design-based corrective actions that prevent recurrence.

* **Solve cross-functional manufacturing and field issues** — work closely with quality, manufacturing engineering, sourcing, suppliers, and field support teams to improve product quality and FTY (First-Time Yield); provide design-based corrective actions for NCR (Non-Conformance Report), SDR (Supplier Deviation Request), and PAC (Product Acceptance Criteria) issues.

* **Identify and execute cost and technology improvements** — identify and deliver cost-saving strategies; introduce advanced materials, manufacturing methods, and design tools to advance the strategic position of Driveline subsystem components within the broader wind turbine portfolio.
  

**About You**

You are a senior mechanical engineer with extensive experience in component design, analysis, and validation for rotating or power generation equipment — comfortable operating with a high degree of independence while driving outcomes across global, cross-functional teams. You are also experienced working with suppliers and manufacturing processes to ensure your design is consistently produced with high quality.

**Required**

* A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar discipline.

* Major experience in mechanical analysis and design in an industrial or product engineering environment.

* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), and manufacturing processes.

* Proficiency in 3D CAD (Computer-Aided Design) tools — specifically Unigraphics / Siemens NX.

* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across different geographies and cultural contexts.

* Clear communication, project management, and interpersonal skills — with the ability to present complex technical findings to diverse audiences.

* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering.

* Experience in design and/or application of mechanical components in the powertrain of rotating equipment.

* Working knowledge of ANSYS or other FEA (Finite Element Analysis) tools.

* Experience in design or product development of mechanical components in wind turbines or other power generation products.

* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and DFM (Design for Manufacturability) / DFI (Design for Installation) / DFS (Design for Serviceability) methodologies.

* Exposure to PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) processes and tools.

* Track record of collaborating with product managers and suppliers to optimize component costs and shape purchasing strategy.
  

**Why GE Vernova**

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In this role, you will contribute directly to the reliability and performance of wind energy technology that operates at scale across the global fleet — supported by a team that values engineering rigour, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

We provide varied, competitive benefits designed to reward high performers and support your personal and family needs. GE Vernova invests in your continued on-the-job learning and development and provides a clear path for career growth within a global organization.

  

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike's Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike's AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

**Role Scope:**

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike's agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

**MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:**

* Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
* Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
* Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
* Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

**Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:**

* Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
* Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
* Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
* Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

**What You Will Help Shape:**

* A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
* GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
* A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

### **Your Impact:**

* Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers' existing ecosystems.
* Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
* Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
* Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
* Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
* Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
* Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

**Why This Role Is Unique:**

* You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
* You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
* The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

### **What's Next?**

* Introduction Call with a Recruiter

* Conversation with the AI Product Director

* Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

* Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Performance Media Buyer
description:
### **About ExoClick**

ExoClick is an innovative and global ad company serving 20 billion daily geo-targeted ads to web and mobile advertisers & publishers. We are part of EXOGROUP, a set of companies made up of +200 talents and offering a wide range of services within the digital business landscape with headquarters in Barcelona and offices in Dublin, Porto and Valencia.

We are revolutionizing the online ad-serving industry for advertisers, publishers, and networks alike and are seeking to recruit a Performance Media Buyer for our Barcelona office.

### **Role**

As Performance Media Buyer, you will work with global performance-based online advertisers across a wide variety of verticals within the adult entertainment industry. You will actively create, monitor and optimize campaigns for a portfolio of clients (both assigned and newly qualified leads) with a particular focus on effective inventory monetization, delivering a first-class service and sharing best practices within the various internal departments. Your daily tasks will also involve data analysis, preparing strategic client reports, proposals and contracts.

Together with a cross functional team, you will participate in development on new products and new marketing angles. As a top-notch media buyer you should educate and coach new media buyers in developing advertising strategies and campaigns. You will report to the Sales Director.

### **Responsibilities**

* Media buy on CPM, CPC, and CPV pricing models to back into CPA goals.
* Setup, manage and optimize campaigns using ExoClick Ad platform.
* Use of internal tools, systems and processes to keep a daily track of client development and expansion.
* Prospect and identify new potential direct response advertisers.
* Daily spend/revenue monitoring.
* Effective client relationship management, dealing with internal/external conflicts and collate best practice examples of reporting, client feedback and case studies.
* Proven technical capabilities and understanding, including basic skills in the editing of landing pages (HTML), use of tracking pixels and creative optimization.
* Close interaction with Business Intelligence, Business Development teams in order to interpret market insights, client data, and be able to react quickly and implement this back into the business.
* Effective management of your clients on performance versus target and company growth strategies.
* Support and coach existing and new employees. Help Performance team members by providing additional steps and resources that help employees move ahead with confidence.
* Collaborate with multiple departments in creation of documentation, educational material, case studies.
* Develop and incorporate new marketing angles in the user flows. Guide the marketing team on how to implement them in the marketing material.
* Participate in establishment and improvement of relevant processes of the department.
* Take responsibility and accountability over new products and projects within the department.

### **Profile**

* You have a solid working knowledge of the digital performance and affiliate marketing ecosystems, and understand the general needs of online advertisers and publishers
* Very detail-oriented with a meticulous approach and be able to manage multiple campaigns successfully
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Money conscious with an innovative approach and ability to thrive in a fast-paced working environment
* Proactive, a strong communicator and confident with pitching new opportunities to external clients
* Analytical mind, good with calculations and statistical interpretation
* Problem-solving attitude
* Interest in following advertising and media trends

### **Requirements**

* +2 years minimum experience in the online advertising industry as a media buyer.
* Previous Developing effective media buying strategies.
* Experience with RevShare models.
* Experience managing 6 digit campaigns directly for product owners or affiliate networks.
* We will value any experience as a media buyer or traffic manager. Previous experience with ExoClick Platform is a highly appreciated.
* Strong analytical proficiency, especially with Excel or Google spreadsheets.
* Good technical knowledge (HTML).
* Perfect knowledge of the different performance-based pricing models (CPA, CPL, CPM, CPC, etc.).
* Fluent English, written and spoken (Russian, German, French, Spanish or other languages will be highly valued).
* Strong proficiency with web applications (browsers, software).
* Experience with tracking and attribution tools.

### **What you’ll find working at ExoClick**

We offer a position in a young, dynamic and international team with exceptional working conditions in unique offices high up in the Torre Mapfre, one of Barcelona’s world-renowned landmarks, located right on the city’s seafront.

Additionally, we offer the opportunity for permanent training, personal development, ambitious career growth, and a competitive salary.

Most of all, we offer a position in a team that thrives on achievement, success, and leadership within our industry. Our core company value is innovation: where people and creativity drive innovative technology. If you have an innovative, winning mentality, this position is for you!

### **Our company benefits**

* Flexitime and summer schedule
* Private health insurance
* Your Birthday off as a paid holiday
* Flexible compensation plan: travel, meals & childcare
* Additional internal and external training through our EXOGROUP University program
* English, Portuguese & Spanish classes
* Training budget & study leave
* Employee referral program bonus - You can earn 2500Eur by referring someone!
* Exciting team buildings in locations such as Ibiza

* Organic fruit
* Monday team breakfast
* Yoga classes
* Subsidised Well-Being activities
* Calm App
* Massages
* Subsidized catering

Is this not the right role for you? Then make sure to check out all other roles we have open for you on our careers website.

title: Faculty Member - CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming
description:
**Seville Faculty Member: CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming**

On-site - Seville | Verto Education  
Learn more about us:  
https://vertoeducation.org/abroad-locations/study-abroad-spain/

**About Verto**

Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.
* Verto seeks faculty who can be a bridge to the local culture and help bring learning to life for students above all else.
  

**Application Instructions**

To apply, please submit the following:

* Cover Letter - a letter of interest (no more than 2 pages) that articulates your experience and qualifications in relation to the job description. Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

* Current Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* References - Names and contact information of three references who will provide a professional recommendation.
* Unofficial transcripts of graduate work. If your graduate degree was conferred from an institution that doesn’t traditionally issue transcripts, please upload a scanned copy of your diploma.
* Teaching evaluations from related courses / up to three separate semesters, if available.

Faculty will be asked to share a schedule of availability and complete a background check as part of the hiring process. All faculty are subject to final review and approval by the University of New Haven.
  
  
**Enrollment Sizes & Course Details**

Course assignments are typically 45 hours (3 U.S. credits) or 60 hours (4 U.S. credit) courses, depending on the course and discipline (4 credit/60 hours are typical for Lab or Studio based courses).

Faculty may be invited to teach multiple sections of the same course, when possible, and/or multiple courses directly related to their academic field of expertise, if related courses are available.

Course syllabi are developed and approved by the Academic Provider, along with specific information regarding course learning outcomes, academic policies, assessment of learning, and overall expectations. Faculty typically develop their own teaching materials, including schedule, readings, assignments, experiential learning activities, and develop and manage a course site via the Learning Management System, Canvas. Some courses are delivered in a sequential manner (e.g. BIOL I & II) or offered across all locations (e.g. ENGL 1112) and may have required course textbooks, common assignments or assessments, or other materials that are standard for course delivery.

Section enrollment varies by program location, scheduling, student enrollment, and classroom size. Specific information will be provided by the local program staff.

* Language courses: Approximately 15-18 students
* Non-language courses: Approximately 15-24 students
Lab courses: Typically fewer than 25 students  

**Why Join Verto?**  
***The below are for full-time Employees in the United States (benefits for international staff benefits vary by location and meet or exceed local standards)***

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation reimagining higher education
* ✈️ Work in a globally-minded, international environment
* Exposure to cross-functional teams (academics, operations, student life)
* Opportunity to grow in a fast-moving, impact-driven organisation

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**Compensation**  
At Verto, base salary is one part of your total compensation package.

Final base pay will depend on your location (aligned to Verto’s compensation regions), as well as your experience, skills, and relevant qualifications. Your recruiter/hiring manager can share the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

**On-site - Seville** **— Anticipated Base Salary Range**  
€900–€1,200 per credit.  
  

* **️ Right to Work**

You must have the legal right to work in Spain. Verto Education is unable to sponsor visas for this role.  
  

* **Accessibility & Accommodations**

Verto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities. If you require support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

  

**Data Privacy**

By applying for this role, you acknowledge that Verto Education will process your personal data for recruitment purposes. This includes assessing your application, communicating with you, and managing the hiring process. Your data will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) where applicable.

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Verto Education is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic, including race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Change & Training / Site Adoption Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

**Empowering Global Talent in Life Sciences Transformation**

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

This role will be based in Tokyo, Japan remotely and be able to travel to Yamagata upon the client’s requests. We are looking for a potential candidate who can lead the workstream at the client's side as well as large projects in the near future.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

As we are still in the exciting early stages of building our presence in Japan, joining Fusion means you won’t just be another consultant - you will be an initiating member helping shape our Japan growth story locally. You will have the opportunity to work on projects with truly global clients, where diverse perspectives and cross-border collaboration are the norm. You will be acting as the bridge between the global English-speaking business and potentially Japanese speaking local operations. With this comes a high level of accountability and ownership, empowering you to directly influence outcomes and see the tangible impact of your work.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced **Change & Training / Site Adoption Specialist** to drive organizational change management, user training, and adoption activities within a complex SAP transformation environment. The role focuses on preparing business users for new systems, processes, and ways of working by developing effective change management strategies, training programs, and site readiness initiatives. Working closely with project managers, business stakeholders, functional teams, and local site representatives, the specialist ensures successful solution adoption, smooth transitions, and sustainable business outcomes across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute change management and training strategies to support SAP implementation, transformation, and rollout initiatives.
* Lead organizational change impact assessments, stakeholder analysis, and site readiness evaluations.
* Design and deliver comprehensive training programs, including instructor-led sessions, virtual training, workshops, and digital learning materials.
* Develop user guides, training documentation, communication materials, and knowledge transfer resources.
* Coordinate site adoption activities, ensuring local business teams are prepared for system deployment and process changes.
* Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, local change champions, super users, and business representatives.
* Monitor training effectiveness, user engagement, adoption metrics, and organizational readiness throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support go-live preparation, hypercare activities, and post-implementation adoption initiatives to ensure smooth business transitions.
* Identify potential resistance to change, address adoption challenges, and implement continuous improvement measures.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Proven experience in **Organizational Change Management (OCM), Training, or Business Adoption** roles within large-scale IT or business transformation projects.

description:
