title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | Hydrogen
description:
*Lead the technological core of Kerionics: the development and industrialization of the SOEC technology you'll bring to market in 2028.*

### **About us**

At Kerionics, we accelerate industrial decarbonization through technologies that make cleaner, more efficient energy possible. We are a spin-off from ITQ (UPV-CSIC), born from scientific knowledge with a clear goal: turning research into real industrial solutions.

Our SOEC (solid oxide electrolysis) technology produces hydrogen with high energy efficiency where it is needed most: energy-intensive industries such as steel, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics and paper, where replacing fossil fuels remains a major challenge. We are a multicultural team of more than 40 people, united by a shared purpose.

### **What we are looking for**

We need a CTO to lead the development and industrialization of our SOEC technology, with our 2028 go-to-market in sight. Over the coming years we will scale the technology by orders of magnitude. You would join at a critical point: not at the beginning, where everything is exploration, nor at the end, where everything is execution, but where scientific rigor and industrial discipline must coexist every day.

We want someone who combines the scientific rigor to solve the open challenges in MEA (Membrane Electrode Assembly), Stack and Balance of Plant (BoP) with the discipline of New Product Introduction (NPI) to take the technology from the lab to an industrial product.

You will lead three managers, one each for MEA, Stack and BoP: people with judgment, autonomy and deep knowledge of their fields. Your challenge is not to build a team from scratch, but to take it to the next level: aligning everyone around the roadmap, professionalizing how we develop product and building a technical culture together.

This is not a role for silent execution. You will be **the CEO's technical right hand**: following the defined strategy and, when needed, challenging it with arguments if you believe something has been decided wrongly. You report to the CEO, but we expect you to co-build, not just execute. That technical honesty is part of the job.

### **Why this role matters**

* **Technical leadership of a European deeptech scale-up**, with technical, commercial and environmental impact at the same time.
* **A project with real backing**: financial support from deeptech-specialized funds such as InnoEnergy, top-tier industrial and scientific partners, participation in strategic European projects, and new conversations with private investors for the next phase.
* **A real voice in strategy**: you sit on the management committee, take part in strategic and investment decisions, and your technical opinion carries weight.
* **The full transition to market**: from prototype to product, from lab to industrial plant, from first customer to deployment.

### **What you will do**

* **Product development:** lead the cross-functional development of our SOEC technology across MEA, Stack and BoP; make sure it follows an NPI logic with clear stage gates, technical pass/fail criteria and traceability of decisions; lead the transition from R&D to industrialization.
* **Team and culture:** lead the MEA, Stack and BoP managers directly, unblock what they need, build a technical culture grounded in data, honesty and accountability, and take an active role in technical hiring.
* **Critical technical problems:** provide top-level judgment on open challenges and lead decisions that cut across areas, even with incomplete data.
* **Strategy:** be the technical reference in the management committee, give the CEO honest judgment, and represent Kerionics before partners, investors and customers.
* **Industrialization and quality:** coordinate with the Industrial Project Manager on the future plant, and with the Quality & Testing Manager to align validation criteria with the product.

### **What we expect in your first 12 months**

1. **Own the technical roadmap:** understand the current state of the product and the commitments made to partners and investors. By the end of your first quarter, present your own critical assessment of the roadmap to the CEO and the board.  
2. **Build the trust of the MEA, Stack and BoP managers and their teams**, and the cross-functional rituals and processes that do not yet exist.  
3. **Strengthen the development process:** consolidate the existing stage-gate system, refining pass/fail criteria, decision traceability and documentation.  
4. **Bring AI into how the team works**, where it adds real value, leading by example. No top-down rollout.  
5. **Deliver the next major validation milestones** of the roadmap.  
6. **Build Kerionics' technical voice externally** and position it as a SOEC reference in Europe.

### **How we work**

We work **on-site** at Parque Tecnológico de Paterna (Valencia), close to the product: lab, workshop, prototypes and test benches. We usually start early (around 7:30), which leaves your afternoons free for sports, family or whatever you prefer.

### **What we ask for**

**Must-haves**

* Advanced degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Materials, Energy), Materials Science or Chemistry. A PhD will be highly valued.
* At least **5 years** in electrochemical or hydrogen technologies (electrolysis, fuel cells or equivalent). Direct SOEC experience is not required: we value deep knowledge of stacks, MEAs or systems that you can bring to ours.
* At least **3 years** leading product development from R&D toward industrialization.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Solid knowledge of at least one pillar: MEA and electrochemical materials, stack design and validation, or BoP in complex energy systems. We do not expect equal depth in all three, but you must hold demanding technical conversations across them.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, for technical discussions and for representing the company.
* Availability to relocate to Valencia within 2-3 months. If you need more time for family reasons, let's talk.
* Valid work permit for Spain, or eligibility to obtain one. For the right candidate, we support the paperwork.

**We are looking for someone who...**

* Has the judgment to say no to a good project that doesn't fit the strategy, and yes to a hard one when the evidence supports it.
* Decides under uncertainty without falling into paralysis or improvisation.
* Challenges the CEO with arguments when needed, while staying loyal to the agreed strategy.
* Leads through context and example, not micromanagement, and stays hands-on when needed.
* Stays current with AI and uses it critically.
* Can join an already formed team and earn its trust through knowledge and respect, not hierarchy.

**Not required, but you'll surprise us if you also...**

* Have direct experience with SOEC or SOFC, or high-temperature ceramic materials.
* Have been a CTO, VP of R&D or Head of Technology in a deeptech scale-up.
* Have lived a complete industrial scale-up (TRL 5-6 to TRL 8-9) in electrochemical, energy or advanced materials technologies.
* Know our target sectors (steel, cement, petrochemicals, ceramics, glass, paper).
* Speak Spanish.
* Have your own network in the European hydrogen, SOEC/SOFC or industrial decarbonization ecosystem.

**A note before you decide...**

This list describes an ideal profile, not a checklist. People from groups underrepresented in deeptech and engineering tend to be harder on themselves when reading job descriptions. Don't decide for us: send us your CV, and let us decide whether there's a fit.

### **What we offer**

* **€70-90K gross per year**, depending on experience and fit.
* **Variable bonus of up to €20K**, linked to the technical milestones of our roadmap. Details shared during the process.
* **Stock option plan.** Full terms shared during the process.
* **Permanent contract**, with a standard 6-month probationary period.
* Relocation support package for candidates moving to Valencia.
* 22 working days of holiday.
* Language lessons (Spanish or English) if you want to strengthen your language skills.
* Annual training budget tailored to your needs.
* A multicultural team: colleagues from India, the UK, France, Pakistan, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, Ecuador...
* Every Friday, 11:00 to 12:00, a good Valencian esmorzaret to disconnect and celebrate the week's small wins.

### **How our selection process works**

1. A video call with our Head of People & Culture.  
2. A video call with our CEO, to explore your technical vision and how it fits with Kerionics' strategy.  
3. A video call with an external expert.  
4. A video call with a member of our Board, focused on long-term vision and an independent view of strategic fit.  
5. A full-day visit to our facilities in Paterna (Valencia), where you will see the product and meet the MEA, Stack and BoP managers, your future direct reports. We cover your travel and accommodation.

We will update you within 5 working days after each step and treat your candidacy with full confidentiality.

* Monitor Retail Health & Safety performance, maintain accurate data in corporate systems and prepare practical reports on incidents, findings, overdue actions, recurring risks and deployment progress

We welcome Creators Of All Kinds. If you are unsure of meeting all the requirements but trust you have the transferable skills to excel in this role, complete the application and our teams will get in touch if you are selected for an interview.

* A range of learning and development opportunities
* An international company with plenty of opportunities to grow
* A competitive compensation & benefits package

title: PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative: Postdoctoral Researcher in TGV Metallization and Seed-Layer Processes
description:
As part of the **PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative**, ICFO coordinates PIXEurope, a flagship **Pilot Line funded under the European Chips JU program**, focused on Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) through which ICFO is advancing frontier technologies, including optical interposers for Co-packaged optics for next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices.

To strengthen this initiative, ICFO is seeking a highly motivated Engineer/Scientist with strong expertise in thin-film deposition and metallization of high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias (TGVs).

**Position Overview:**,

We offer a post-doctoral position to a scientist with hands-on experience in thin-film deposition, surface preparation, and metallization for semiconductor, MEMS, or advanced-packaging applications. The successful candidate will develop, optimize, and scale reliable adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed layers inside high-aspect-ratio glass vias, ensuring continuity and compatibility with subsequent copper plating and interconnection processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**,

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Develop and optimize seed-layer deposition processes for high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias
* Develop substrate cleaning, glass-surface activation, and adhesion-promotion processes
* Develop adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed stacks such as Ti/Cu, Cr/Cu, TiW/Cu, and related systems
* Optimize sputtering, evaporation, electroless, ALD or CVD-assisted, and hybrid deposition approaches
* Achieve continuous and conformal seed coverage along via entrances, sidewalls, and exits
* Characterize thickness, morphology, resistivity, adhesion, continuity, and wafer-level uniformity
* Identify and mitigate shadowing, seed discontinuity, oxidation, delamination, and cracking
Coordinate with the laser and glass team to align via geometry and surface condition with seeding, plating, and interconnection requirements  

  
This position will report to the **Prof. Dr. Valerio Pruneri, Director of the European Chips JU Pilot Line PIXEurope.**

PIXEurope is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of the Participating States, Spain, Ireland, The Netherlands, Finland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, France, Italy, United Kingdom. In particular, it is co-funded by Spain through the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service under reference CJU-010000-2025-0005, as part of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan (PRTR).

Applicants must hold a PhD in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics, microengineering, or related fields, or equivalent research experience.

Candidates should demonstrate expertise in the following areas (not all mandatory, but strongly preferred):

* Thin-film deposition by sputtering, evaporation, ALD, CVD, or electroless methods
* Metallization processes for semiconductor, MEMS, microfabrication, or advanced-packaging applications
* Surface preparation, activation, and surface chemistry of glass or dielectric materials
* Metal-to-dielectric adhesion and adhesion/barrier/seed-layer material systems
* Metallization or coating of high-aspect-ratio three-dimensional structures
* Redistribution layer patterning and fabrication
* Electrical and structural characterization of thin films and interconnects
* Cleanroom processes, safety procedures, and fabrication protocols
Process optimization, reproducibility, failure analysis, and wafer-level uniformity  

Desired (but not required):

* Direct experience with Through-Glass Via or Through-Silicon Via metallization
* Experience with FIB/SEM cross-sections, X-ray inspection, four-point-probe measurements, or via-resistance testing
* Experience with reliability testing, thermomechanical stress, process scale-up, or wafer-level packaging
* Experience with glass surface processing will be evaluated as a strong asset
Experience with electroless deposition, ALD-assisted seeding, or electroplating  

**What We Offer**

* Full time contract up to 3 years (ASE (Accés al Sistema Espanyol de Ciència i Innovació) contract pursuant to Spanish Law 14/2011)
* Access to state-of-the-art microfabrication and characterization facilities
* A dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment
* Opportunities to work on high-impact projects bridging fundamental research and real-world applications
A family allowance may be granted to candidates with dependents, according to ICFO policies.  

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

To apply, please submit your:

* resume,
* a cover letter outlining your experience,
contact information for 2 professional references.  

  
Applications should be submitted via the ICFOjobs platform http://jobs.icfo.eu.

The selection process is conducted in accordance with ICFO’s Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) Policy, ensuring equal opportunities, transparency, and fair treatment for all applicants. Candidates are assessed exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, experience, skills, achievements, and potential in relation to the requirements of the position. Further information on the recruitment principles and procedures, conflict of interest and the appeals mechanism available to candidates, can be found in the OTM-R Policy.

The selection process will consist of:

1. Eligibility check of applications
  
2. Assessment of merits (education, experience, and language)
  
3. Interview with shortlisted candidates  
  

The Evaluation Committee will include at least three members and ensure gender balance and impartiality.
  
Each phase will be documented, and candidates will be notified of the outcome within 15 days of the interview.

For formal enquiries regarding the application process, please contact: jobs@icfo.eu

For project and technology enquiries, please contact: valerio.pruneri@icfo.eu.

For more information about ICFO, visit: https://www.icfo.eu.

**Data Protection**

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018, ICFO informs applicants that their personal data will be processed exclusively for recruitment purposes.

* **Controller**: Fundació ICFO – Institut de Ciències Fotòniques, Av. Carl Friedrich Gauss 3, 08860 Castelldefels (Barcelona).

title: Store Manager Barcelona
description:
**Become our Store Manager and establish Hatstore in Barcelona**
----------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Help build Hatstore’s next international store**

2026 is an important year for Hatstore. Following our first international store launch, we’re taking the next step in our retail expansion and opening a new store in **Barcelona**.

Since launching in 2011, we’ve grown into one of Northern Europe’s leading e-commerce retailers for caps and headwear. Now we’re continuing to develop Hatstore as a brand and a place to meet, both offline and online. With our store in Barcelona, we want to create an inspiring destination for caps, fashion and a great customer experience.

For this exciting chapter, we’re looking for an **entrepreneurial, driven and hands-on Store Manager** who wants to help build our presence in Barcelona from the very beginning.

**About Hatstore**
------------------

Hatstore was founded on a genuine passion for caps, creativity and innovation—and those are still what drive us forward.

Today, we have more than 100 employees and sell to customers in 55 countries. Our range includes tens of thousands of caps, beanies and hats, including the option to create custom designs.

Our international retail expansion is an important part of Hatstore’s continued growth. We’re now looking for someone who wants to help make Barcelona an important part of our international store expansion.

**Your role as Store Manager**
------------------------------

As Store Manager of our new store in Barcelona, you’ll play a key role in establishing and developing Hatstore in the Spanish market.

You’ll be responsible for the store’s day-to-day operations, building and leading your team, and ensuring our customers have an experience that reflects the Hatstore brand.

You’ll also work closely with our head office in Sweden and be an important link between the local business and our international team.

This is an opportunity to be involved from the start, influence the way we work and lay the foundations for future Hatstore stores in other markets.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

**Store launch & development**  
Take part in planning, launching and developing our new store in Barcelona.

**Leadership & team**  
Recruit, onboard, develop and motivate the store team, and build a strong team culture.

**Sales & customer experience**  
Ensure a high level of service, create an inspiring store environment and actively work towards the store’s sales targets.

**Store operations & merchandise flow**  
Take responsibility for day-to-day operations, stock, merchandise flow, inventory and orders.

**Building the brand locally**  
Help build Hatstore’s local brand through social media, partnerships, events and other creative initiatives.

**Budget & performance follow-up**  
Manage the store’s budget and key performance indicators, and monitor and report results to our head office in Sweden.

**We believe you**
------------------

* Have experience in retail, for example as a Store Manager, shop manager, team leader or in a similar role
* Are a natural leader who enjoys developing people and building teams
* Have a strong customer focus and understand what makes a great in-store experience
* Are entrepreneurial, solution-oriented and used to taking responsibility
* Enjoy working hands-on and are ready to roll up your sleeves when needed
* Have a good understanding of retail and the local market in Barcelona
* Are comfortable with social media and enjoy creating content and building a brand
* Are proficient in English, as you’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden
* Are proficient in Spanish; Catalan language skills are an advantage
* Have a genuine interest in caps, fashion, sport and streetwear

You’re also someone who gets things done. You’re sociable, down-to-earth and confident in your leadership. You enjoy meeting people and building relationships, while also being clear and direct when needed.

An interest in American sports is an advantage, as a large part of our range is connected to MLB, NBA, NHL and NFL.

**What we offer**
-----------------

**A key role in Hatstore’s international expansion**  
You’ll be an important part of our continued international retail journey and help launch our new store in Barcelona.

**The opportunity to build something from the ground up**  
You’ll have plenty of scope to influence how the store develops, how the team works and how Hatstore establishes itself locally.

**International collaboration**  
You’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden and become part of a growing international team.

**Employee discounts**  
Enjoy attractive employee discounts across the Hatstore range.

**Annual wellness allowance**  
All employees receive an individual wellness allowance that can be used for activities such as sports and outdoor pursuits, or for spa, wellness and recovery.

**A growing and passionate organisation**  
Join us on an exciting growth journey where caps, creativity, entrepreneurship and people are at the heart of everything we do.

**Become part of Hatstore**
---------------------------

We’re looking for our next **Hatstar**, someone who wants to help make Hatstore a go-to destination for caps and headwear in Barcelona.

Does this sound like you? Apply today and become part of Hatstore’s international expansion.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description:
**About us**
------------

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale.

**About this role**
-------------------

As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture**

* **Define European Hub Talent Strategy:** Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers.
* **Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative:** Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent.
* **Navigate Market Nuances:** Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks.

### **2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation**

* **High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence:** Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets.
* **End-to-End Pipeline Activation:** Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners.
* **Developer Platform Immersion:** Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement.

### **3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement**

* **Targeted Campaign Architecture:** Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines.
* **Technical EVP Translation:** Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors.
* **Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits:** Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion.

### **4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization**

* **Hiring-Centric Metrics:** Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill.
* **Budget Oversight:** Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver.
* **Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever):** Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration.

### **5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability**

* **Strategic Thought Partnership:** Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment.
* **Playbook Documentation:** Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets.
* **Mentorship & Functional Growth:** Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales.

**Experience & Background**
---------------------------

* **8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership:** Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines.
* **European Market Expertise:** Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain).
* **Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record:** Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper.
* **Fintech & Scale Exposure:** Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments.
* **International Collaboration:** Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets.

**Skills & Competencies**
-------------------------

* **Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation:** Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires.
* **Deep Engineering Domain Fluency:** Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences).
* **Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity:** High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments.
* **Strategic Campaign Design:** Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires).
* **Paid Digital Campaign Optimization:** Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks.

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days (Discovery & Immersion):** Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. title: Strategy & Transformation Specialist
description:
Quiénes somos

We are TK Airport Solutions, a business unit of TKE Group.

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. TKE employs more than 50.000 people around the world, being present in more than 100 countries.

From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. Our **passenger boarding bridges** connect terminals to aircraft safely and efficiently. Our **ground support equipment** covers preconditioned air, ground power units and potable water units for aircraft turnaround. Our **advanced visual docking guidance systems (A-VDGS)**, including the LiDAR-based Apron Vision, ensure precise and safe aircraft docking. Our **digital solutions** — MAX Automate, MAX Monitor & Control and MAX Maintenance Manager — bring AI and remote operation to the apron.

We also provide **modernization and service** programs, including upgrades and spare parts that extend equipment life and performance, and we adapt this same engineering expertise to **seaports**, with our Seaport Passenger Boarding Bridges (SPBB) for ferry and cruise terminals.

Our equipment is used at more than 370 airports in over 100 countries, and TK Elevator boarding bridges have carried over 1.8 billion passengers worldwide.

Joining TKAS means working on real engineering challenges at global scale, combining German engineering heritage with a strong local team in Asturias, and contributing to safer, smarter and more sustainable airport infrastructure.

**Qué esperamos**
-----------------

**Your mission :** Support the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office in defining, tracking and delivering the company’s strategic initiatives. You’ll provide high-quality analysis and reporting, and use data to challenge initiative owners so that initiatives move forward, are properly prioritised and deliver the expected impact.

**What you’ll do:**

**Analysis and reporting (c. 50%)**  
Half of your time will go into turning information into decisions. You’ll prepare the management reports, dashboards and materials that committees and senior leadership use to steer the business. You’ll also run ad hoc analyses whenever a strategic question comes up, from market sizing and benchmarks to business cases for new initiatives. Working closely with the Head of Strategy, you’ll help shape executive presentations that are clear, well-grounded and ready to support key decisions.

**Strategic initiative tracking (c. 50%)**  
The other half is about making sure strategy actually happens. You’ll manage the portfolio of strategic initiatives as you would a project, keeping a clear view of owners, milestones, KPIs, risks and status. You’ll meet regularly with directors and initiative owners, not just to collect updates but to ask the right questions: what is being done and why, what impact it is having, and what is holding progress back. When something goes off track, you’ll raise it with the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office, always bringing a proposal on how to get it back on course.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

You have 2–4 years of experience, ideally in strategy consulting, working on strategy, transformation or operations projects. You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Administration or a similar field, and your English is strong. A master’s degree is a plus, but not a requirement.

You’re highly analytical. You work comfortably with advanced Excel and build executive-level PowerPoint presentations, and experience with Power BI or an equivalent tool is highly valued. You know how to synthesise complex information and turn it into a clear, compelling storyline.

You’re also well organised. You track milestones rigorously and can manage several workstreams at once without losing sight of priorities.

Above all, you have the presence and confidence to challenge directors without creating friction. You’re results-oriented, proactive, and you don’t wait for problems to escalate before acting on them.

* The opportunity to join an international team working on high-impact, technically demanding projects within the airport mobility sector.

title: Head of YouTube (Strategy, Scripting & Team Lead)
description:
We're hiring a **Head of YouTube** to lead Richard Yu's channels and creative team. Richard teaches people how to build businesses selling digital and physical products through "AI Arbitrage"

### **✅ The challenge**

Our immediate goal is to grow the business channel from ~90,000 to 200,000+ subscribers in six months and bring average views per video above 100,000. These are aggressive goals. We want someone excited by that challenge, with a clear approach to choosing what to make, testing ideas and getting good videos out consistently.

You'll grow the top of the funnel by reaching new viewers who fit our audience. You'll also plan content for viewers who are getting to know Richard, learning about our offers and deciding whether to buy. Ultimately, we want this channel to grow the business, so views and subscribers need to translate into an audience we can serve.

You'll be responsible for what we make, why we make it, how we package and produce it, and whether it worked. You'll work directly with Richard and the leadership team to set direction, goals and KPI's and lead, hire and manage a creative team underneath.

**This is a senior creative strategist and operator role**.
  
  
You will write first-person, long-form scripts yourself, as well as review and improve other writers' work. You should be equally comfortable setting channel direction, giving specific feedback and getting videos published.

### **✅ What you'll own**

* **Strategy and ideation:** own the channel's growth goals, metrics and KPIs. Turn them into a clear plan for topics, formats and ideas, based on what our audience cares about and what we can learn from videos that perform well above their channel's usual results. Plan videos that bring in new viewers, build trust and help the right people take the next step.
* **Testing and learning:** build structured tests with a clear hypothesis, a useful comparison and defined success measures. Decide which tests are worth running, make sense of the results and apply what you learn to the next videos.
* **Packaging:** titles, thumbnail concepts and briefs, A/B tests, and repackaging decisions informed by CTR, retention and traffic sources.
* **Scripting:** write full scripts when needed, and edit and quality-check every script before Richard films it. Build strong hooks, story structure, pacing, curiosity and payoffs that keep people watching. Deliver the title's promise in a natural voice, with concrete examples and verified claims.
* **Production:** give editors specific feedback from the first cut, set clear standards and make sure each video meets them.
* **Analytics:** review what worked, what didn't and what to change next. Track subscriber growth, views and audience quality alongside the channel's contribution to leads and sales, working with the wider marketing team. Be clear about which results we can attribute to YouTube and where we’re still making assumptions.
* **Team:** hire, onboard and manage editors, designers and writers. Coach people to improve and write procedures and checklists that help the team make good decisions independently.

### **✅ Who will do well here**

You have a deep passion for YouTube (storytelling and psychology), and an understanding of channel growth. You can explain why a topic, format, title, thumbnail or script works: what earns the click, what keeps someone watching and what makes them return. You can turn that understanding into work that performs.

You are excited about taking on ambitious goals and being responsible for the results. You track progress honestly, work out what's holding us back and come with ideas for fixing it. You learn quickly, ask for feedback and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Strong business judgment, an understanding of marketing funnels and experience in Infopreneurship, online education or Edutech are major advantages. We’ll weigh that experience heavily. We’ll also consider an exceptional YouTube leader who can learn our audience, offers and funnel quickly.

This is a full-time role for someone who wants to focus on one business and take responsibility for both the creative work and the team.

### **✅ Hiring process**

Application, Zoom call, paid test project, final interview, offer. For your application, share existing work you are allowed to share; no new script or channel audit is required at this stage.

### **✅ How to apply**

Review Richard’s business YouTube channel and browse the other channels/accounts linked there for context.
  
  
**IMPORTANT TO BE CONSIDERED YOU MUST SHARE A 3–5 MINUTE LOOM/VIDEO COVERING:**

**1. Your background and motivation:** Briefly introduce yourself, your role on the YouTube channels you’ve worked on and the results you’re most proud of. What excites you about this opportunity, and why do you want this particular role working with Richard Yu?

**2. Your growth philosophy:** How do you approach growing a business YouTube channel like ours? Which metrics matter most, and why?

**3. Your read on our channel and your first 30 days:** What are we doing well, and what most needs to improve to reach 200k+ subscribers in six months and average over 100k views per video? Briefly explain your reasoning and what you would focus on in your first 30 days. Tell us what you can judge from the public channel and what you’d need to learn from our analytics or team. One or two meaningful observations are enough.

**4. Your leadership:** What creative teams have you led? Share one brief example of a difficult leadership decision, how you handled it and what happened.

Keep it conversational and focus on what matters most. You don’t need slides, a detailed audit or a strategy deck. We want to understand you, your judgment and how you work. Please check that your Loom link is accessible.

 **Requirements**  

* + - * + - * + Deep passion for YouTube and demonstrated understanding of storytelling and channel growth. Show us published long-form work and explain what you contributed.
              + Strong creative judgment across topics, formats, ideation, titles and thumbnails. You can explain why people click, keep watching and return.
              + Deep understanding of a winning script: hooks, narrative structure, pacing, curiosity, clear explanations and satisfying payoffs. Ability and willingness to write complete first-person, talking-head scripts and improve another writer's work.
              + A structured approach to testing: clear hypotheses, useful comparisons, defined success measures and sound interpretation of results.
              + Ownership of goals, metrics and KPIs. Strong command of CTR, average view duration, retention graphs, traffic sources and channel growth metrics, with examples of how you used them to make decisions.
              + Experience managing editors and/or designers, setting clear standards, giving specific feedback and helping people improve.
              + You learn quickly, ask good questions and take direct feedback well. You can get up to speed on a new audience, subject and business model.
              + Strong business judgment and experience with marketing funnels, infopreneurship, online education or edusoftware are highly valued. A record of connecting content to leads or sales is a strong advantage. These are not prerequisites for an exceptional YouTube candidate who can learn this side quickly.
              + Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You must be able to write natural, compelling English scripts and communicate clearly with Richard and the team.
              + Confidence using without over-reliance on AI tools, particularly Claude/Codex. You still take responsibility for the voice, accuracy and claims in the finished work.
              + Full-time availability and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.
              + Remote: we welcome candidates across the United States, Canada, the UK, Europe, Mexico, Central America and South America, including Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Brazil, Panama, Colombia, Argentina and Costa Rica. Exceptional candidates elsewhere are also welcome. What matters is strong YouTube judgment, fluent English and reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.

  
**Benefits**  

* + **A meaningful challenge.** Help grow a brand with audacious goals, including taking our business channel to 200k+ subscribers in six months and averaging over 100k views per video. Your work will directly shape how we reach people, earn their trust and grow the business.
  + **Real ownership and influence.** We value input from everyone, and few things are off-limits to thoughtful questioning. Bring your perspective, question assumptions and propose better approaches. We listen to good reasoning and are willing to change direction when the evidence supports it. Your ideas and what you learn through testing can influence the broader business.
  + **A team invested in your growth.** We want this to be one of the biggest personal and professional growth experiences of your life. You’ll work directly with Richard and the rest of the leadership team, get honest feedback and take on challenges that stretch your thinking, creative judgment and leadership. We set high standards, and we’re here to help you reach them.
  + **$75,000–$150,000 USD annually plus performance bonuses for exceptional results, in a fully remote, full-time role with reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.**

title: Senior Amazon Content Strategist
description:
**About Us**  
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.  
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Content Audits & Quality Assessment**  

* Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
* Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
* Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

**Content Strategy Development**  

* Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
* Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
* Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
* Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
* Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

**AI & Agentic Discoverability**  

* AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
* Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
* Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

**Testing & Performance Monitoring**  

* A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
* Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
* Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

**Creative Briefing & Review**  

* Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and

marketplace advertising content.  

* Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
* Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

**Client Management**  

* Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
* Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
* Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
* Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
* Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

**Quality & Output Review**  

* Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

**AI-Enabled Working**  

* AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
* Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

* Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

* Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

* Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

* Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

* Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

* Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

* Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

* Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.

* Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.

* Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

* Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

**Desirable**

* Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.

* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

* Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

* Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

**Benefits**
------------

**What We Offer**  

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Hybrid Working Model
* Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
* Continuous learning & career development
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Youtube Strategist & Channel Manager
description:

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**What we're building**
=======================

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

**Why join Shadow?**
====================

* **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.
* **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.
* **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

**The agency behind the product**
=================================

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**The role**
============

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.  
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.  
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

**Core Tech & Tools**

* **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)
* **Datastore:** PostgreSQL
* **Cloud & Infra:** Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
* **ML/AI:** LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.
* Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.
* Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.
* Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.
* Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.
* Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.
* Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.
* Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.
* Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

**Must haves**
==============

* Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.
* Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.
* Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.
* Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.
* A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.
* Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.
* Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.
* Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private.
* Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers.
* Most people who fit this have 5+ years across design and some experience with frontend engineering.

**Nice to haves**
=================

* Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing work, or research with expert users.
* You’ve built a design system that other engineers rely on.
* Data visualization work in D3, Visx, Recharts or hand-rolled SVG.
* Motion work, such as spring animation or Framer Motion.
* Experience with LLM APIs, streaming interfaces or agent products.
* Time spent around marketing, ecommerce or analytics tools, or running ads yourself.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every employee exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:

Ready to shape the future of hotel operations? Join us!

**About the role**

Marketing is one of the best ways for us to grow, and we want to build it the right way. That's why we're looking for a Marketing Manager. Reporting to the VP of Growth, you'll own marketing end to end: strategy, brand, demand generation, content, customer stories, sales materials and events.

Our goal is simple. We want more hotels to know us, trust us and ask for a demo. You'll be responsible for building our brand and our visibility, turning that into inbound leads, and giving our Sales team the stories and materials that help them close deals faster.

This is a hands-on role. You'll define the strategy, and you'll also create, publish and measure the work yourself, using AI tools to move fast. You'll be our first dedicated marketing lead with a global scope, with a clear path to lead a team as the company grows.

You'll play a critical role in shaping how the hotel industry sees Hub OS.

**Your mission:**

Marketing Strategy & Brand

* Define and own the annual marketing plan, with clear goals, budget and calendar
* Define our ideal customer profiles, value proposition and positioning against competitors
* Build key messages for each type of customer and market
* Define our narrative style and tone of voice across all channels
* Own the brand guidelines and templates, so the whole company communicates in a consistent way
* Decide what we do in English and what we adapt to other languages and markets
* Follow what our competitors say and do, and share it with Sales and Product

Demand Generation & Visibility

* Own our website: landing pages, the path to "Book a demo" and continuous conversion improvement
* Lead our SEO strategy and our visibility in AI tools, so we are found and recommended when buyers search
* Own our presence on review and reputation sites such as HotelTechReport, G2 and Trustpilot, including a steady flow of new customer reviews
* Lead our LinkedIn strategy and company page
* Run email marketing and nurturing for leads who are not ready to buy yet
* Use paid channels in a focused way when they help amplify what already works
* Plan co-marketing activities with our technology and referral partners
* Organize our own webinars and online events when they make sense

Content Creation

* Create and run our blog, with a clear editorial line and a regular publishing rhythm
* Write white papers, guides and thought leadership content
* Create LinkedIn posts that get attention and move readers to act
* Produce our quarterly newsletter: product news, new features, partner and integration updates, spotlights on lesser-used modules and hotelier interviews
* Make sure every piece of content has a clear goal and a clear next step for the reader

Customer Stories & Sales Enablement

* Lead our customer success stories from start to finish: choose the hotel with Sales and Customer teams, contact the hotelier, run the interview, collect the data and write and design the story
* Collect testimonials and video quotes from happy customers
* Create and keep up to date the materials Sales uses in demos, events and meetings, such as decks, one-pagers and product sheets
* Work with Sales to understand what helps them win deals and shorten the sales cycle

Product Content & Adoption

* Review, edit and publish content for our Help Center, which is hosted in HubSpot. The Quality team owns the accuracy of the content, and you own the quality of the writing and the publishing
* Create content that explains the benefits of each module and feature, and how to set them up
* Produce product videos, including editing and AI voice-over
* Create campaigns and materials that help customers adopt modules they do not use yet, supporting upsell

Events & Trade Shows

* Be the owner of our trade shows and events from a marketing point of view, including the results
* Manage the relationship with event organizers: registration, event portal content and sponsorship options
* Own the stand design, merchandising, team outfits, catering needs and event materials
* Prepare pre-event meetings and outreach with the Sales team
* Measure the ROI of every event and recommend if we should continue or not
* Work closely with the Partnerships & Events Manager, who leads the production and logistics of each event

Data, HubSpot & Reporting

* Own the marketing setup in HubSpot: forms, workflows, email, lists, dashboards and attribution
* Define with Sales and RevOps what a qualified lead is, how leads are scored and how they are handed over
* Track and report on awareness (traffic, brand searches, LinkedIn growth, AI visibility), lead generation (inbound leads, demo requests, conversion by channel) and sales impact (content usage, customer stories, reviews, sales cycle)
* Find where visitors and leads drop off, and use data to decide what to do next
* Share clear reports with leadership: what works, what does not and what to change

Budget, Vendors & Tools

* Manage the marketing budget
* Choose and manage freelancers and agencies for specific projects, only when the impact is clear
* Own our marketing tools and AI stack, and keep looking for better ways to work

Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Quality, Product, RevOps and Partnerships & Events
* Align with regional teams across different time zones

**Required qualifications:**

* Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS or hospitality tech
* Experience building and running demand generation, from strategy to results
* Excellent writing skills in English, with the ability to create content that is clear, interesting and persuasive
* Hands-on experience with SEO and website optimization
* Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation tool
* Analytical mindset: comfortable with data, KPIs, attribution and reporting
* Daily use of AI tools for content, design, video and productivity
* Experience with LinkedIn as a B2B channel
* Basic design skills to create presentations, one-pagers and visuals with tools like Canva or Figma
* Experience with trade shows or events is a strong plus
* Fluent in English (written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus
* Organized and able to manage many projects at once

**You'll thrive in this role if you…**

* Are ambitious and see this role as a big step in your career
* Enjoy being both the strategist and the one who gets things done
* Love telling a good story and turning it into real business results
* Make decisions with data, and are not afraid to test, learn and change direction
* Are curious about new tools and always looking for smarter ways to work with AI
* Enjoy talking to customers and learning what makes them successful
* Are proactive and take action without waiting to be asked
* Enjoy collaborating across teams, regions and time zones
* Value autonomy and ownership, and enjoy the freedom to prioritize
* Would like to grow into a leadership role and build a team in the future

**What's waiting for you?**

Impact & Growth

* Join a market leader that's growing globally
* Build our marketing function from the start, with real ownership
* Work on projects that directly affect company growth
* A clear path to lead a marketing team as the company grows

Flexibility & Balance

* Flexible working hours that respect your personal life
* Choose your work style: office-based, hybrid, or fully remote
* A company culture that genuinely values work-life balance and well-being

Team & Culture

* Collaborate with a fun, cohesive, and diverse team
* Annual company offsite and team-building activities
* Work with talented professionals across multiple countries and time zones
* A supportive environment where ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary aligned with your experience, responsibilities and market standards
* Performance-based incentive plan tied to company and individual success
* Professional development plan

Our Commitment

* We're an ethical company that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone
* We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees
* We believe different perspectives make us stronger and innovation thrives in inclusive teams
