title: Senior Talent Acquisition
description:
**Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 consultants and experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace people; it elevates us to where no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will develop more than skills—you will cultivate judgment. Your expertise will deepen with every system you architect, client challenge you solve, and deployment that builds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates.

**What You'll Architect**

You will join Intake, Keyrus' international Talent Acquisition team: a cross-border team that advises Keyrus entities worldwide, combining market intelligence with strategic recruitment to help leaders make smarter, data-driven hiring decisions. In this role, you combine advisory and sourcing skills, using AI-enabled tools and talent data to find, assess and attract the people who build intelligent systems for our clients.

* Partner with Managing Directors and senior stakeholders across Keyrus entities, turning business plans into clear hiring strategies backed by real market data

* Source, engage and attract top talent in Data, AI and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), with a primary focus on the French market and support for other EMEA markets when needed

* Recruit the profiles that power intelligent systems: AI and ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists, data architects and AI consultants

* Use AI-enabled sourcing and talent intelligence tools (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter and Talent Insights, AI sourcing platforms, ATS automation) to identify and reach the right talent faster and more precisely

* Combine these tools with advanced human sourcing methods: headhunting, X-ray and Boolean search, growth hacking and deep networking

* Produce talent market insights on skills availability, salary trends, and competitor activity to guide where and how Keyrus hires

* Build and maintain talent pools in our core technologies, so entities can staff new client projects quickly

* Lead and deliver recruitment projects, managing the full recruitment cycle from intake to offer

* Run competency-based interviews that assess both technical depth in data and AI and consulting skills, with human judgment at the heart of every hiring decision

* Strengthening the Keyrus employer brand with data and AI communities through content, networking and community engagement

* Share your expertise in AI-enabled recruitment and help grow TA capabilities across the group

**Who You Are**

* You think beyond filling roles: you understand what the business is trying to achieve and recruit with that in mind

* You are a trusted advisor to senior leaders, confident enough to challenge a brief with data and propose alternatives

* You are fluent in the language of data and AI, and understand the roles you recruit for well enough to have credible conversations with engineers and consultants

* You use technology to work smarter, and you know where automation adds value and where a human conversation makes the difference

* You thrive in a cross-border team, working remotely across countries, cultures and markets

* You build genuine, long-term relationships with candidates and stakeholders

* You keep improving how we recruit, and share what works with the wider team

**What You Bring**

Qualifications/Certifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business, **Psychology,** or a related field, or equivalent by experience

* 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally with a headhunting background

Technical Skills

* Proven success sourcing and hiring technical profiles in Data, AI, and Digital

* Experience recruiting for the French market

* Advanced sourcing skills: headhunting, Boolean / X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter

* Hands-on use of AI-enabled recruitment and talent intelligence tools in your daily work

* Fluent English and French (written and spoken)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience recruiting in other EMEA markets

* Any additional language (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch)

* Background in Resource Management (in-house, MSP or RPO), ideally with nearshore/offshore recruitment experience

* Experience recruiting EPM profiles

* Experience with recruitment analytics and reporting dashboards

* Experience recruiting for consulting firms or professional services

**What Makes You Successful**

* Clear, persuasive communication with candidates and senior stakeholders across cultures

* The ability to influence hiring decisions with market data and a well-argued point of view

* Commercial awareness: you understand how a consulting business runs and why the right hire at the right time matters

* The judgment to combine AI-driven efficiency with personal, high-quality candidate experience

* High energy, curiosity and the drive to keep raising the bar on how Keyrus recruits

**Rewards – What We Offer at Keyrus**

* A full-time contract

* Benefits and package depending on your location

* A team that supports and guides you from day one

* Plenty of challenges and opportunities to keep developing your skills

* An environment built on trust, openness and collaboration

**What We Stand For**

* Collective Intelligence — Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

* Reliability — The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

* Pragmatism — Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

* Entrepreneurial Spirit — Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

**Our Hiring Process**

We keep our process clear and respectful of your time:

* Interview with the Intake Manager: a deep dive into your recruitment experience, sourcing approach, and use of AI and data in your work

* Initial conversation with the Intake team: to get to know you, your motivations, and tell you more about us

* Practical exercise: you walk us through your sourcing and market-mapping strategy for a Data & AI role

* Final conversation with Intake leadership

**ABOUT KEYRUS**

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of an intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model (HOM), we architect reliable:

* Intelligence Foundations,

* Human in Command governance,

* and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 3,000 employees across 30 countries, we help organizations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organizations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

Keyrus is listed on Euronext Growth Paris. (ALKEY – ISIN Code: FR0004029411 – Reuters: KEYR.PA – Bloomberg: ALKEY: FP).

For more information: www.keyrus.com

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Who are we**

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

### **About the Team**

We are looking for a **Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team**, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on **account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio** .

  

### **What You Will Do**

* **Own account commercial outcomes:** Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
* **Protect retention and renewal outcomes:** Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
* **Drive account expansion:** Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
* **Develop account strategies:** Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
* **Lead consultative customer conversations:** Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
* **Navigate complex enterprise sales processes:** Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
* **Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting:** Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
* **Use AI to elevate your work:** Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

  

### **What You Must Have**

* **Full account lifecycle ownership:** +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a B2B SaaS environment.
* **Proven commercial outcomes:** A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
* Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with **experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders**, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
* Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
* Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.  

### **It's a Plus If You Have**

* Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
* Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
* Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

  

### **Our Benefits**

Competitive salary and employee stock options.

Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

Health insurance to keep you covered.

Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

*We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.*

title: Solutions Marketing Manager (Remote)
description:
This role manages product marketing for document databases (MongoDB), MySQL, and MariaDB.  
  
Percona is fully remote, and open source in our identity.

**Location**: Remote (EMEA or Americas preferred, for core-hours overlap with the team)

**Reports to**: Director of Solutions Marketing (Solutions Marketing is Percona's product marketing function)

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

Percona sells support, services, and expertise alongside database software. Our software and our services combine to provide users and customers with secure open source databases, free of vendor lock-in. On this team, we help communicate the value and relevance to the people involved in deciding to use our solutions. The right person for this role thinks in use cases and buyer needs, not only product features.

You don’t need to come from a product marketing background. If you've done technical content, developer relations, solutions engineering, or technical writing in the database or infrastructure space, and you can translate complex technology into clear messaging, we want to hear from you.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

Initial focus (document databases like MongoDB, MySQL, and MariaDB):

* Technical product messaging and positioning for Percona’s MongoDB related offerings, MySQL, and MariaDB support and expertise.
* Use case and value based messaging for all feature messaging for GTM
* Competitive positioning
* Partner with Services and Consulting so your messaging connects to the support, consulting, and managed services that customers actually buy alongside the software.

Across the portfolio (ongoing):

* Coordinate with Product on roadmap inputs for your portfolio areas. Translate VOC from support, consulting, and sales into positioning updates and product feedback
* Own launch plans for releases, features, and service offerings in your areas. Contribute to launches, enablement, and messaging that span multiple database technologies.
* Build and maintain competitive landscapes for your primary areas, and contribute to the broader Percona competitive view. Track ecosystem trends across your portfolio areas (community surveys, conferences, mailing lists, analyst reports).

* Build sales and CS enablement: competitive comparison docs, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQ docs, and other materials that connect technology to the use cases buyers care about.
* Engage with the open source database community. Represent Percona's perspective at events and in public content.

**Must-haves:**

* **Strong communicator.** Can write for technical buyers (DBAs, SREs, platform engineers) and economic buyers (VP Eng, CTO, CISO). Clear and concise internally too.
* **Stakeholder skills**. Builds trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services. Responsive, organized, follows through.
* **Technical foundation**. Comfortable in technical conversations about databases, infrastructure, and operations. Can learn complex technology quickly and translate it into clear messaging. **Can work in, or can** ***learn*** **to work in GitHub**. Understanding of use cases that drive these buyers: migrations, high availability, performance, cost, compliance, and AI or vector workloads.
* **Open source mindset.** Understands transparent work, respects community, and describes licenses honestly, including when software is source-available rather than open source. Has worked in or engaged with open source in some meaningful way.
* **Adaptable.** Willing to work across multiple database technologies when the team needs it.
* 3+ years in a technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, technical writing, or product marketing role. (The specific title matters less than what you've done.)

**How we work**
---------------

Percona is fully remote with a global team. Open source is the foundation: our software is built in the open where licenses allow, our community relationships are real, and transparency is the default.

You'll partner closely with teammates covering other database technologies and have direct access to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Consulting

Occasional travel (3-6 events a year) for database community conferences, partner meetings, and internal offsites (for example Percona Live, KubeCon, and MySQL or MongoDB community events).

**Compensation**
----------------

Competitive with market for remote-first infrastructure and open source companies. Adjusted for location. We share the salary range for this role early in the conversation.

**Why Percona?**

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!

Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

title: Marketing Manager
description:

You’ll be part of a creative and friendly team in a people-oriented environment that values autonomy, results-driven thinking, and achieving business goals.

description:

Thunes' Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets, stablecoin wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 220 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay HK and many more.

**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Design, test, and implement advanced AI prompts and multi-step automated workflows (using Clay, Zapier, OpenAI APIs) to automate manual research, scale lead generation, and continuously find time-saving efficiencies for the broader marketing team.
* AI-Powered Data Enrichment & Mining: Lead advanced data mining and account matching strategies. Leverage predictive AI and lookalike data models within 6sense and programmatic workflows in Clay to discover, enrich, and segment target segments and Ideal Customer Profiles globally.

Carry out advanced data analysis using AI, spreadsheets and other tools.

* Internal Comms Architecture: Streamline internal marketing performance reporting, building automated summaries and dashboards to keep global, cross-functional stakeholders updated on key marketing wins and pipeline velocity.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, Revenue Ops stakeholders to define and implement MarTech infrastructure with AI mechanisms and capabilities for Global Marketing that enhance lifecycle customer experience, engagements, campaigns, and retention across prediction markets.

title: Generative Content Creator
description:
**Moon Active**, a leading global mobile game developer entertaining millions worldwide, is seeking a highly skilled and creative **Generative Content Creator** to join the in-house video creative team of our Marketing Art Studio.

In this role, you will own video ad creatives end to end, from brief to delivery, across our portfolio: Coin Master, Travel Town, Reality Bay, Family Bay and more. You will create everything from scroll-stopping hooks and gameplay mechanics to rich narrative storytelling ads, at the pace and volume performance marketing demands.

You will direct generative tools (such as **Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana 2, ChatGPT Image 2, ComfyUI, Suno, ElevenLabs**, and others) alongside **After Effects and Photoshop**, combining the speed of AI with the storytelling fundamentals that make a shot work.

Apply today if you are passionate about video, storytelling, gaming and cutting-edge tech!

--------------------

* Own Video Ads End to End: Take a brief and run it on your own, from concept, art and AI generation through sound, edit and delivery, across gameplay-driven ads, story-driven narratives, scroll-stopping hooks and reskins.
* Learn What Wins: Study our ads' performance data alongside market trends and competitor creatives, and turn those insights into stronger hooks, angles and fresh ideas for every brief.
* Maintain Brand Consistency: Ensure all AI-generated output strictly adheres to each game's visual style guide, character roster, quality standards, brand identity and IP/copyright guidelines.
* Stay Ahead of AI Advancements: Research, test and bring emerging image, video and audio models to the team to continuously speed up our creative workflows.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Hands-On Video Production Experience: 3+ years of practical, professional work making video: shooting, animating, designing motion, building 3D or editing real productions from start to finish.
* Expertise in Generative Video and Image: Hands-on experience with platforms like Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, Nano Banana 2 and ChatGPT Image 2, or similar. You translate film fundamentals (shot types, lenses, camera moves, lighting and action beats) into precise AI generations.
* Adobe Finishing Skills: Strong command of After Effects for basic compositing, stitching shots, quick fixes, layers, masking, tracking and color; Premiere for timeline and editing work; and Photoshop for art and image work.
* Strong Creative Fundamentals: A deep feel for story, timing and emotion, and a solid grasp of color, composition, lighting and anatomy to spot and fix imperfections in AI outputs.
* Adaptive, Independent Mindset: A dynamic, out-of-the-box problem solver who adapts quickly as tools evolve, runs their work without waiting to be told and hits deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ownership and Team Communication: Takes personal responsibility for every deliverable, raises issues early, and communicates clearly and openly with teammates, Leads and Creative Producers.

**Advantages**
--------------

* Node-Based AI Pipelines: Experience building custom pipelines in ComfyUI for precision that presets can't give.
* Building Your Own Tools: Familiarity with Claude Code, Cursor or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript) to automate pipelines and speed up production.
* 3D Software and AI Integration: Familiarity with Blender, Cinema 4D or Maya, and incorporating 3D assets into AI pipelines.
* Game UI and Gameplay Motion: Ability to create mock gameplay, game UI and interactive mechanics using a mix of AI generation and After Effects motion graphics.
* Performance Marketing Experience: A background in UA video ads or marketing creatives for mobile games.

title: Lead Producer - Game Operations | Fully Remote
description:
**What we are looking for:**

We are looking for a seasoned Lead Producer to lead the development of our new IP. This role will play a vital part in the successful delivery of a major new title. The ideal candidate will have experience at the highest levels of project leadership, building new IP, growing teams, and supporting the creative leaders in the realization of their vision.

  

**What we will do together:**

* Manage internal and external teams across multiple locations to meet production schedules and deliver the project to quality, time, and budget expectations.
* Support the strategic and tactical operations of the Release Management, Dev Ops, Live Ops, Technical Art, and other technical groups.
* Have a strong technical understanding of software release frameworks including merge & branching strategy, bug fixing and locking builds, finalizing builds and releasing them to the public.
* Work closely with Producers to develop product budgets and schedules across the team.
* Partner with the Executive Producer to ensure core development processes are adhered to with consistency.
* Mentor producers at all levels of the team, taking a keen interest in their growth and career development.
* Ensure that coherent goals are set for the team from milestone to milestone, and that they are understood and executed upon.
* Coordinate and assist with focus testing, outsourcing and other external parties as required.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years in internal game development.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience with strong applied technical knowledge.
* Experience building and leading teams across multiple locations.
* Experience building AAA Games.
* Comfortable guiding and leading staff across both production and creative disciplines, ensuring there is a healthy level of push and pull.
* An excellent communicator and emotionally intelligent leader capable of rallying a team.
* A calm and stable voice capable of managing complex problems with a cool head.
* Ability to interface with all levels of the organization.
* Resourceful, self-motivated, and capable of acting autonomously.
* Capable of balancing production and creative needs in support of making informed decisions.
* Ability to identify and analyse risk while providing mitigation.
* JIRA and Confluence expertise, with experience using metrics to drive improvement.

**Interested… a bit about Escape Velocity:**

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. But that doesn't necessarily make us unique. What does make us special? We value the time, energy, and talent of our players and our colleagues. We want every hour spent developing and playing our games to be an incredibly rewarding and worthwhile use of your time. To that end, we are 'Fully Remote' and support team members nearly anywhere in the world. We prioritize honesty, even when that means sharing bad news. We strive to give everyone autonomy so they can determine how best to work and play, and we care more about what you bring to the game and studio than how many hours you're clocking. We're dedicated to building a culture of play, which not only makes us better game makers, but also strengthens the bonds between us all. We believe in constant improvement across all areas – from the game itself to our production design – and are constantly re-evaluating how we spend our time to ensure that we're not wasting yours and we're all always working on the most important things.

  

**A few benefits you can expect from us:**

* A generous PTO allowance

* Summer and Winter holidays studio closure (separate to PTO allowance)

* Private Medical & Dental Healthcare

* Private Mental Health scheme

* A generous annual Health & Wellbeing allowance

* Discretionary Studio Bonus

* Top range tech for your home set up

* Other benefits based on your region

  

**How to apply:**

Click apply and complete an application along with a Resume / CV. If we would like to move forward with your application, a member of the Recruiting Team will reach out to you and guide you through our process.

Escape Velocity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to hiring, promoting, and compensating employees based on their qualifications and demonstrated ability to perform job responsibilities.

Applications will be considered regardless of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, belief, race, or any other protected category.

**At ING we are looking for a Senior Business Process Expert**
==============================================================

**Your role and work environment:**

  
  

At ING, we are looking for a Senior Business Process Expert to join our COO Products Tribe and help shape the future of Business Banking (BUBA).

In this role, you will be responsible for defining, delivering and continuously improving customer journeys, operational processes and capabilities that enable Business Banking customers to interact with ING in a simple, efficient and compliant way.

  
  

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment, collaborating closely with Business, Operations, IT, Risk, Compliance and Legal teams to transform ideas into scalable solutions that create value for customers and the organization.

Making things happen, simplifying complexity, improving customer experiences and driving continuous improvement are part of our DNA.

  
  

**Your key responsibilities**

  
  

As a Senior Business Process Expert, you will:

* Drive the definition, implementation and continuous improvement of Business Banking customer journeys and operational processes.

* Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, working closely with development teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.

* Support solution design, testing activities and implementation to ensure successful delivery and adoption of new capabilities.

* Take an end-to-end view of customer and operational processes, identifying opportunities to simplify, optimize and automate.

* Use data and insights to identify trends, measure performance and support decision-making.

* Design and monitor operational and customer-centric KPIs to ensure sustainable service performance.

* Collaborate with Operations, Product, Technology and external stakeholders to deliver solutions that maximize customer value and operational efficiency.

* Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities based on customer needs, operational challenges and strategic objectives.

* Ensure products, services and processes comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements and risk standards.

* Actively contribute to the tribe's transformation agenda, challenging the status quo and driving innovation.
  

  

**What are we looking for?**

  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in transformation initiatives, process improvement, customer journey design, product delivery or complex project environments.
* Strong analytical mindset and ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Customer-focused, proactive and results-oriented profile.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work across multidisciplinary teams and influence without hierarchical authority.
* Experience working in Agile organizations and delivery environments.
* Strong prioritization and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience in banking, operations or Business Banking environments will be highly valued.
* Knowledge of reporting and analytical tools (Power BI, MicroStrategy, Excel or similar) is a plus.
* Technical understanding sufficient to effectively collaborate with engineering teams is desirable.
  

  

**Why join us?**

  
  

You will have the opportunity to play a key role in the evolution of ING's Business Banking capabilities, working on strategic initiatives with high visibility and impact, while collaborating with a diverse network of experts across Business, Operations and Technology.

  
  

**What do we offer?**

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

Check out what is waiting for you!

**Balance That Works.**

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!

**Health insurance.**

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).

**Life insurance.**

We help you protect what matters most to you.

**Flexible remuneration.**

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…

**Free company shuttle.**

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.

**Banking benefits.**

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

**More vitality and more belonging**

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

**Get to know Us**

We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.

And although we are based in Spain, we **are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 35 countries.**

We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of **Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging** to foster a culture of **collaboration and innovation** that represents all collectives in the society.

And even though we look orange on the outside, **we are green on the inside**. Our ambition in Sustainability is **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.

**Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA.** If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!

*At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.*

**Job Application Safety Reminder**

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

* **Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.

* **Check the sender’s email carefully:** Legitimate communication will always come from **@ing.com** and/or **@myworkday.com**.

* **No payments or banking details will ever be requested:** If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

title: Product Manager, Degree Programs
description:
**TripleTen** is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. As a Product Manager, Degree Programs in the USA Product team, you’ll own TripleTen’s new online Master’s in Applied AI end to end: its positioning, why students choose it, and how it runs day to day. You’ll work directly with the college’s leadership and faculty, so the role runs fully in English.

* **Go-to-market for education.** Background in product marketing or launching education products.

Brand:
  
TripleTen

description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Chief Customer Officer
description:
**Work from anywhere, impact everywhere**
-----------------------------------------

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
  
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.  
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
  
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
  
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  
Work from anywhere!

**Position overview**
---------------------

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

**The mandate**
---------------

* **Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.**
    
  You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.

* **Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.**
    
  You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.

* **Win the right members, efficiently.**
    
  You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.

* **Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.**
    
  Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.

* **Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.**
    
  You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.

* **Build one Customer organisation, not four.**
    
  Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.

* **Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.**
    
  You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

**How you'll operate**
----------------------

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

* **You lead from inside the work.** You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
* **You move people with the business case, not the whip.** When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
* **You have extreme ownership.** You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
* **You have genuine gravitas.** Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
* **You diagnose before you prescribe.** You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

**What you'll have done**
-------------------------

* 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
* Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
* Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
* Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
* Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
* Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
* A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

  

**The first 90 days**
---------------------

**Day 30:** The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.  
**Day 60:** The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.  
**Day 90:** At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
* Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
* Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
* Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

**Other requirements**
----------------------

* A dedicated workspace.
* A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
* Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

**Why work for Xapo?**
----------------------

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

* **Shape the Future**  
  Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.
* **Great work-life balance**  
  Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.
* **Expect Excellence**  
  Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

title: Senior CX Manager

-------------------------

* Identify, prioritise, and support AI and Agentic use cases based on Orange business priorities.
* Translate business challenges into defined use cases, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Support use cases from discovery and pilot through adoption, optimisation, and scale.

With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements:**

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

title: Lead Security Engineer - Vulnerability Response (Imunify360)
description:
**CloudLinux** is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information: cloudlinux.com

Imunify360 Security Suite is an innovative security solution designed specifically for shared and VPS/Dedicated servers. The automated, easy-to-use solution with the six-layer approach to security delivers comprehensive and complete attack prevention.

**We are looking for a Lead Security Engineer - Vulnerability Response to join our Web Protection Team.**

**The challenge ahead**

When a critical vulnerability in a popular web application or WordPress plugin goes public, attackers start exploiting it within hours. Most site owners can't patch that fast. We want our customers protected before the first attack reaches them, and we want them to know it.

That's the challenge we're hiring for:

* **AI-driven vulnerability response.** Build and run a pipeline that detects new high and critical vulnerabilities, generates WAF rules with AI assistance, validates them, and ships them to production in a short window.
* **Protection plus public announcement, both automated.** The same pipeline that ships the rule also produces the public advisory. Every critical vulnerability we cover is announced soon after the rule ships, so customers and the market see that Imunify closed it first.
* **Build on what works.** An AI-assisted pipeline already runs for our WordPress protection plugin. The first big project is to extend this approach to ModSecurity/Coraza WAF rules.
* **Speed without breaking sites.** On shared hosting, a rule that blocks legitimate traffic is a customer incident. Fast and precise both matter.
* **Make it measurable.** Time-to-protection, coverage of critical vulnerabilities, and false-positive rate are the numbers this role owns.

**About the role**

You will own the vulnerability response pipeline end to end and be its main builder. You combine deep web application security expertise with strong automation skills, and you think about the product: what customers need, what to measure, what to build next. You'll lead a small team of security analysts and work closely with automation, QA, and marketing.

**What you'll do**

* Design and build the AI-driven pipeline from disclosure to announcement: vulnerability intake, triage, rule drafting, testing, release, and the public advisory.
* Lead the extension of our existing WordPress-plugin pipeline to ModSecurity/Coraza rules.
* Write and review WAF rules (ModSecurity/SecLang) for real-world web vulnerabilities.
* Build test harnesses that check rules against exploits and real traffic before release.
* Lead and mentor security analysts: set priorities, review their work, remove blockers.
* Define and track time-to-protection, coverage, and false-positive rate, and improve them.
* Automate advisory generation as part of the pipeline, and agree the format and review flow with marketing.

  
**Requirements**

**What we're looking for:**

* 5+ years in web/application security: vulnerability research, detection engineering, WAF engineering, or similar.
* Deep understanding of web attack classes (SQLi, XSS, RCE, auth bypass, path traversal, file upload, deserialization) and how to detect them in HTTP traffic.
* Hands-on experience writing WAF rules (ModSecurity/SecLang, OWASP CRS, or similar) and regular expressions.
* Able to read PHP code and understand a vulnerability from an advisory or a patch diff.
* Strong Python: you've built automation pipelines that run in production. CI/CD and automated testing.
* Hands-on daily use of AI/LLM tools; you know where to trust them and how to verify their output.
* Proven track record of leading a technical project end to end.
* Product mindset: you reason about customer impact, not only technical correctness.
* Upper-intermediate English or better.

**Nice to have:**

* WordPress ecosystem security: plugin vulnerabilities, vulnerability feeds (Wordfence, Patchstack, WPScan), CVE credits or bug bounty.
* Coraza or other WAF engines.
* Exploit analysis or threat intelligence background.
* Linux server administration, hosting industry.

**Personal skills:**

* Strong ownership: you take a goal, not a task list.
* See the whole process and find the bottleneck, not only fix individual issues.
* Communicate clearly and raise risks early.
* Calm under pressure: critical vulnerabilities don't wait for working hours.
* Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  
**Benefits**

**What's in it for you?**

* A focus on professional development.
* Interesting and challenging projects.
* Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
* Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
* Compensation for private medical insurance.
* Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
* Budget for education.
* The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (https://cloudlinux.com/candidate-privacy-notice), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

title: Senior Product Cost Engineer (VAVE & Value Engineering)
description:

* Use webinars to reach new audiences in Spain and international markets
* Measure the impact of each webinar on registrations, attendance, leads and pipeline

**Strategic relationships for field**

* Manage relationships with event organisers, public entities, associations, chambers of commerce and speakers

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success and Product so that every event serves commercial goals
* Equip the Sales team with the materials and plans they need before, during and after each event

We are looking for someone excellent, detail-oriented and passionate about events. Someone who feels at home both behind the scenes and on stage.

#### **Experience**

* 8+ years in event management, ideally in B2B or B2G
* Proven end-to-end management of events and webinars, in Spain and internationally
* Experience in public procurement: you understand how public tenders work and how the public sector buys
* Proven experience in public speaking.

SaaS, tech or GovTech experience is a strong plus.

* Excellent communication skills, written and spoken
* Great attention to detail: every event reflects the quality of our brand
* Autonomy and ownership: you set priorities, make decisions and deliver results
* Strong relationship-building skills
* Budget and vendor management
* Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and event management tools

AI as a productivity ally

* Portuguese, French and/or Italian: highly valued

Availability to travel 30–40%, including international travel.

* **Revenue impact:** closed-won deals and revenue influenced by field activities
* **Brand presence:** speaking slots, sector visibility and Tendios' positioning at key events

* 24 working days off + your birthday + 1 additional day
* A senior role leading a key area, with real influence on our international expansion
* Bright office in central Barcelona

Tendios is at the beginning of its international journey, and field marketing will be decisive in it. Your mission will be to make Tendios the name everyone remembers at every public procurement event, in Spain and beyond. If you love events, feel at home on stage and want to help build a global company, we want to hear from you.

title: Head of Industrial Innovation

* Lead operational excellence programs based on Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma, TPM, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and collaborate with key business functions to ensure the successful execution and scalability of transformation initiatives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and change management, building partnerships with universities, research centers, technology providers, startups, and industrial partners.
