title: Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )
description:
**Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )**

Seen & Heard is a global creative agency with studios in Newcastle and London, delivering design, video production, creative communication and brand adaptation for global brands. Now we're going further. This is a brand-new role and a rare opportunity for a designer who's ready to step up, take the lead and shape how great creative lands across an entire region.

**THE ROLE**

As Regional Design Producer Lead, you'll be the **guardian of cultural and creative relevance** for your region. Global marketing toolboxes and their localisations are created in our UK design hub. Your mission is to make sure that work doesn't just arrive in your markets, it truly lands.

This is a Design Producer role first. Creative judgement and output sit at its heart, with project management running alongside. Yes, there's plenty of coordination, and you'll need to be brilliantly organised to do it well. But the real magic is this: looking at an asset built for everyone, knowing instantly how it will and won't work in your markets, and directing what needs to change. That cultural instinct is exactly why this role lives in the region, not the hub.

You'll also be the person who brings the region together. Markets get what they need faster, and for less, when their requirements arrive as one set rather than one at a time. You'll pull those requirements together, sharpen them along the way and get them in on time, then make sure the finished work gets back out to the markets just as smoothly.

This is leadership without line management: you'll lead through influence, expertise and great creative judgement. It's the perfect next step for a designer with a strong creative eye who's ready to start delivering through others, and who wants to grow with our business. You'll embody our values of **curiosity**, **partnerships**, **insight**, **agility** and **integrity**, and solve problems through beautiful design, rather than treating design as just an output.

**Where you'll fit in**

You'll report directly to a Director.

You'll partner closely with the client's creative operations lead for your region. They own the workflow, approvals, budgets and reporting. Within all of that, you're the one who **owns brief quality, cultural judgement and market consolidation**.

You'll also be part of a growing network of regional producers. They're your peers, with no reporting line either way: the people you'll swap ideas with, cover for and build a genuine support network alongside.

Expect two to three days a week in the client's office in the region, with the rest of the week working from home. And because this role is brand new, you'll have room to help shape exactly what that looks like as working relationships in the region settle.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cultural Relevance**

This is the heart of the role, and the part that simply can't be done from the UK. It's why you'll be based in the region.

* Alongside the marketing teams in the countries, decide what adapts, what has to be made from scratch, and what is not right for a market at all.
* Check what comes out of the hub for cultural fit, inside the hub’s quality gate rather than as another approval on the end of it.
* Say when something will not work, say why, and say what would. Flagging a problem without an answer is a job half done.
* Hold a position when a market asks for something that would damage the work or the brand, and know when to concede.
* Know what is going on in the region. Retail landscape, salon landscape, competitors, language, trends and what the markets are reacting to.

**Markets and Briefs**

Every market in the region briefs through you, making you the region's creative gatekeeper. A half-finished brief costs everyone time, so you'll set the bar for brief quality and make sure every brief that reaches the hub is ready to fly.

* Be the contact for the markets in the region, and build relationships with them that go further than email.
* Quality-gate every brief before it reaches the hub. Push back, and help markets get a brief to the point where it can be worked on.
* Refuse variations that are off-brand, inappropriate or not worth what they cost. Explain why rather than simply saying no.
* Consolidate requirements so the hub gets one set from the region rather than several. These requirements need to land alongside the other regions as the model expands so scale can be leveraged in the hub.
* Coordinate with the global team what the markets keep asking for, so the next toolbox has it built in.

**EXPERIENCE**

* Producing or managing creative work across more than one market, in an agency, a brand, an in-house studio or a market team.
* Working inside established creative or operational systems, and adapting them for market or business unit.
* Running briefs/requirements and stakeholders across several countries or departments.
* Running feedback and approval rounds to a deadline, and holding people to them.
* Creative automation or AI-assisted production/operations, hands-on and current, with a clear view of what AI does well and where it does not add value.
* Reporting on volumes, progress and spend accurately and on time.
* Fluent English, and fluent in the language of the country this role is based in.

**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES**

* Creative judgement. Can look at a piece of work and say why it will not land in a market, and what would.
* Able to hold a position with a market, with the hub or with a client colleague, and to know when to concede.
* Highly organised. Several markets converge on this role and nothing can be allowed to fall through it.
* Comfortable being the only Seen & Heard person in the room, being able to represent the company and the work.
* Clear about the difference between a preference and a problem.
* Writes a brief someone can start work from.
* Generous with what they know, and curious about markets other than their own.

**DESIRABLE**

* A design background, and enough hands-on Adobe Creative Cloud to make a small amend without asking.
* Conversational skills in additional languages from the region.
* Beauty, fashion or FMCG background, and an understanding of salon and retail.
* Experience of a hub-and-spoke or centralised production model, from either end of it.
* Localisation or transcreation specifically, rather than general production.
* Working knowledge of a DAM or creative workflow platform.
* Experience of a business going through growth or structural change.

**What we offer**

* **Pension:** 3% matched contribution
* **Holiday:** 23 days plus bank holidays, with time off between Christmas and New Year guaranteed
* **Sick pay:** 5 days at full pay each year
* **Flexible working:** hybrid options that work for you and the team
* **Wellbeing:** free gym classes in Newcastle and rooftop sauna access in London
* **Learning and development:** monthly lunch-and-learns, plus funding and time off for relevant courses

**READY TO LEAD?**

If you're a designer who's ready to step into leadership, bring creative judgement to a whole region and help shape a brand-new role from day one, we'd love to hear from you.

title: LEATHER DEVELOPMENT & SOURCING MANAGER
description:
### **Position**

Are you an expert in luxury leather craftsmanship with a passion for driving innovation and speed-to-market? We are looking for a **Leather Development & Sourcing Manager** to join our Development team.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge creative vision and technical execution, translating design briefs into proprietary brand signatures while maintaining the highest standards of quality, sustainability, and efficiency.

### **Job responsibilities**

  

* **Drive Rapid Development & Innovation:** Spearhead end-to-end development cycles from the initial design brief to industrialization, successfully optimizing innovation lead times while maintaining strict adherence to the collection milestone calendar without quality degradation.
* **Translate Creative Vision into Brand Signatures:** Direct exclusive touch, finishes, color depth, and natural aging characteristics, ensuring high first-time-right color and handfeel approval rates and consistent Maison signature finishes across bulk production.
* **Quality Assurance & Technical Validation:** Balance acceleration in time-to-market with rigorous technical validation, comprehensive testing, quality assurance, and root-cause analysis for leather behavior in handbag construction.
* **Supplier Management & ESG Integration:** Lead supplier management, negotiation, and cross-functional decision-making while embedding robust ESG practices, full traceability, and regulatory compliance into daily operations.

### **Profile**

* 15+ years of proven experience in leather development, research, and tanning within a fast-paced luxury environment.
* Deep knowledge of tanning, finishing, grading, and leather behavior in handbag construction. A strong eye for luxury aesthetics, handfeel, grain, and color nuance.
* Exceptional communication, high cross-functional influence, and the ability to seamlessly translate creative briefs into precise technical specifications.
* Fluency in English and Spanish are a must; knowledge of Italian and/or French is a strong advantage.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

Are you ready to shape the future of luxury leather goods? Apply now!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Associate Director- Sustainability & Impact (Lyon, France)
description:
**Location : Lyon, France**

**About ARCHIMED:**

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

**The Team**

* An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
* Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
* Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary)

***Your Role***

Portfolio engagement and value creation

* Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes.
* Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required.
* Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary.
* Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices.

Investment process

* Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations.
* Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making.

Data, reporting, and compliance

* Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary.
* Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives.
* Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency.
* Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements.

Center of excellence and capability building

* Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices.
* Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business.

  
**Requirements**  

* At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity.
* Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability.
* Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs.
* Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally.
* Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders.
* Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback.
* Pragmatic, constructive, creative, and solution-oriented, with a positive mindset and the ability to work under varied pressures.

title: General Manager
description:
**Company Description**

**SLS Residences Infantas Madrid** brings a new way of living to the heart of Madrid’s **Justicia** neighbourhood. Set within a 1920s neo-Baroque landmark, this very first standalone residence by the brand in Spain will unveil a bold, refined and sensory world where our guests take centre stage.

Comprising **33 exclusive residences,** it offers residents the intimacy of an exceptional home, paired with a complete range of services that are as exclusive as they are iconic, from dining spaces, wellness facilities and bespoke services to our residents-only **Social House**. Welcome to a new chapter in luxury residential living, where sophistication, playfulness and exceptional hospitality come together to bring the extraordinary to life.

 **Job Description**

As **General Manager** of **SLS Residences Infantas Madrid**, you will lead the opening and day-to-day success of our first standalone SLS residence in Spain. More than overseeing operations, you will shape a bold, refined and highly personalised residential experience where service feels effortless, community feels vibrant, and every detail reflects the spirit of SLS.

**What you’ll do…**

* **Lead the homeowner journey end to end.**

You oversee every stage of the residential experience, from handover and welcome to daily living, community integration and long-term homeowner satisfaction.

* **Deliver exceptional residential service standards**

You bring SLS service promise to life through clear procedures, elevated standards, and thoughtful training, and ensure a consistently distinctive and anticipatory homeowner experience.

* **Build trusted homeowner relationships, support HOA governance and alignment.**

You serve as the main point of contact for homeowners, creating lasting relationships built on empathy, discretion, responsiveness, and personalised care. Working closely with the Homeowners Association (HOA), you ensure transparent communication, compliance with bylaws, and active participation in community governance.

* **Oversee all residential operations and drive a seamless cross-functional collaboration to deliver exceptional residential service standards**.

With you onboard, you bring SLS service promise to life, and the residence will run smoothly across all departments, and also with external providers, delivering integrated residential operations. Our guest won’t see the backstage of the show.

* **Own financial performance.**

With your Director of Finance, you manage budgets, control costs, optimise resources and monitor performance with a sharp commercial mindset, while always protecting service excellence and homeowner satisfaction.

* **Lead, inspire and develop your team**.

You recruit, mentor and empower a high-performing team which goes through fostering a culture of accountability, warmth, and excellence in a residential environment.

* **Champion health, safety, and security within the residence.**

You make sure to align with local regulations and brand expectations, you guarantee the peace of mind for residents.

* **Create meaningful local connections & bring the community to life.**

You act as an ambassador of the residence within Madrid, you curate exclusive local partnerships and bespoke lifestyle offerings to enrich residents everyday living, foster connection, and express the unique energy of SLS living.

 **Qualifications**

**What you’ll bring to**

* 7–10 years of progressive **leadership experience** within ultra-luxury standalone residences, high-end residential environments, serviced apartments, or private members’ clubs.
* A proven ability to **deliver elevated, intuitive and highly personalized service**, with a strong track record of building trusted relationships with high-net-worth homeowners and residents.
* **Strong financial acumen**, with experience managing budgets, forecasting performance, optimizing resources and driving operational excellence within a luxury environment.
* **Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills**, with the presence, confidence and emotional intelligence to engage effortlessly with homeowners, teams, partners and executive stakeholders.
* A **natural leader** with a demonstrated ability to inspire, develop and unite cross-functional teams in a dynamic, detail-driven and service-focused setting.
* Strong command of property management systems, CRM platforms and Microsoft Office, with the agility to navigate both operational detail and strategic oversight.
* **Solid experience in luxury residential living** or similarly refined lifestyle environments, with a strong understanding of what defines exceptional service beyond a traditional hotel setting.
* Good knowledge of the **local luxury market**, including resident expectations, premium service providers and the competitive landscape shaping high-end living in Madrid.
* Sound understanding of HOA governance, residential compliance and the legal frameworks that support seamless and well-managed community living.
* Strong project management capabilities, with the ability to lead complex initiatives, balance multiple stakeholders and bring ambitious openings or enhancements to life with precision.
* Multilingual skills are a distinct advantage, reflecting the international profile of the resident community.
* Above all, a genuine passion for lifestyle, community and creating extraordinary moments — with the instinct to make everyday residential living feel both effortless and exceptional.

  
**Additional Information**

**What's in it for you...**

* Command the stage at SLS Madrid, where five-star hospitality meets audacious creativity.
* Lead a powerhouse team driven to outpace the competition and redefine what luxury feels like.
* Thrive in a culture that celebrates innovation, rewards relentless standards, and challenges the expected.
* Global growth opportunities, and the prestige of leading within Ennismore and Accor.
* Indulge in lavish perks, with exclusive access and benefits across our portfolio of iconic brands.

***SLS*** *is part of Ennismore, a creative hospitality company rooted in culture and community, with a global collection of entrepreneurial and founder-built brands with purpose at their heart.* ***Ennismore*** *is a joint- venture with* ***Accor****, formed in 2021.*

title: Social Media Lead - SportyTV & Sports Media Brands
description:
**About Sporty Group**
----------------------

Sporty Group is a global sports entertainment company, home to leading brands like **SportyBet**, **Football.com** and **SportyTV**. We operate at the intersection of **sports, content, community and technology**, building products and media experiences that connect fans with the moments that matter.

Our media brands, led by **SportyTV**, bring fans closer to the game through highlights, stories, analysis, personalities and football culture, across every major social platform.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We're looking for a **Social Media Lead** to drive social strategy and coordinate the social team behind **SportyTV and our sports media brands**. This role combines **team leadership**, a **sports journalism mindset** and **strong editorial judgement** to make our channels a go-to destination for football fans.

You'll set the editorial direction, run day-to-day publishing operations, and lead a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators, making sure our output is **fast, accurate, engaging and built for growth**.

You'll work closely with **Content, Video/Production, Design, Brand, Marketing, Partnerships, BI and Country teams**, and report to the Social Media Director.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Lead, coordinate and develop a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators across SportyTV and our media brands.
* Set priorities, assign coverage and run workflows and shift planning for match days, live events and breaking news.
* Give clear feedback, run regular editorial meetings and raise the team's creative and editorial standards.
* Build scalable processes (calendars, briefs, approval flows, playbooks) that keep the team fast and consistent.

### **Editorial Strategy & Sports Coverage**

* Define and execute the social and editorial strategy for **SportyTV and Football.com**, aligned with global brand guidelines and business priorities.
* Own the editorial calendar around major football and sports moments (EPL, UCL, LaLiga, AFCON, World Cup, transfer windows, etc.).
* Apply a journalistic approach to social: newsworthiness, storytelling, fact-checking, source verification and speed without sacrificing accuracy.
* Lead real-time and reactive coverage of match days, breaking news, transfers, controversies and trending moments.

### **Content & Formats**

* Oversee content across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube (incl. Shorts), LinkedIn and Telegram.
* Develop and scale repeatable content series and franchises: highlights-led narratives, analysis, interviews, explainers, football culture and personality-led formats.
* Work with video, production and design teams to deliver platform-native content with strong hooks and retention.
* Ensure tone of voice, quality and brand consistency across all channels.

### **Community & Audience Growth**

* Drive follower growth, engagement and watch time across SportyTV and media brand channels.
* Oversee community management: comments, DMs, moderation, sentiment monitoring and escalation of sensitive issues.
* Spot local relevance opportunities across our key markets and global football audiences.

### **Talent, Creators & Partnerships**

* Work with presenters, journalists, pundits, creators and sports personalities to grow reach and credibility.
* Support partnerships, rights-holder relationships and co-branded activations with clubs, leagues and media partners.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on organic and paid amplification.

### **Reporting & Performance**

* Track KPIs: reach, views, watch time, engagement, follower growth, retention and sentiment.
* Deliver weekly/monthly reporting with clear insights and next actions for the team and leadership.
* Run testing frameworks to improve formats, hooks, timing and distribution.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **5+ years** of experience in social media, with at least **2 years coordinating or leading social media teams**.
* Background in **sports journalism, sports media or a sports newsroom** (degree in Journalism or Communications is a plus).
* Proven experience running social channels for **sports media brands, publishers, broadcasters, clubs or leagues**.
* Deep football and sports knowledge, with a strong news sense and love for the game.
* **Excellent English (C1/C2 or native)**: you'll write, edit and approve content in English and it's our main working language. Spanish or other languages are a plus.
* Strong editorial judgement: accuracy, fact-checking, tone and handling sensitive stories.
* Excellent platform instincts across TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube and Facebook, and a good understanding of video-first content.
* Confident using analytics and social listening tools to guide decisions.
* Strong organisation, stakeholder management and the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced, high-output environment.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with live coverage of major tournaments.
* Experience working with audiences in Africa, Latin America or other international markets.
* Hands-on video editing or production experience.

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

**Our Team**

The core Netflix Ads team is charged with building a new, best-in-class ads organisation to establish Netflix as the go-to platform for advertiser partners. The Netflix Ads measurement team is tasked with building industry-leading research for advertisers in support of our broader advertising sales efforts. This role is specifically for Spain.

  
  

Netflix Ads in Spain has seen amazing growth since its launch, and there has never been a more exciting time to get involved.

  
  

**Summary**

Netflix’s Ads Spain Measurement team is looking for a new Ads Measurement Lead to join the team. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, consumer insights, data science, and our vendor partners. If you are someone who has experience taking independent action, demonstrating strong attention to detail, and working effectively in a collaborative environment, Netflix may be the place for you. For an insider's look at Netflix’s culture, make sure to read Seeking Excellence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce research and insights that tell the Spanish Netflix Ads story to the marketplace and advertiser clients through audience insights and campaign measurement results.
* Lead full-funnel measurement initiatives, including Reach & Frequency, BLS, and Attention, to guide clients on optimising their investment in Netflix Ads.
* Lead exploratory lower-funnel initiatives, such as syndicated MMMs, Conversion Lift, and 1P developments.
* Lead integration projects through interaction with Product teams and third-party vendors.
* Collaborate with the Head of Measurement as a supporting SME for Live events and measurement capabilities in ES.
* Partner with advertisers to establish strategic learning agendas and category playbooks.
* Oversee product and engineering project management for technical audience measurement integrations and API deployments.
* Drive upskilling sessions and set cross-functional strategy for Insights, Audience, and Full-Funnel measurement across the team.
* Act as an expert on TV/Video and Digital audience metrics, staying ahead of industry standards to ensure Netflix’s practices remain best-in-class.
* Develop meta-analyses and case studies based on full-funnel tests and audience insights for the Spanish market.
  

  

**Experience & Skills**

* At least 6 years of experience in media research at a streaming, agency, advertiser, or digital media company.
* Strong understanding of methodology, data, and systems from research providers, as well as direct digital technology and analytics.
* Experienced in effectiveness measurements such as Reach & Frequency, Incremental lift, Brand lift, Matched-Market testing, A/B testing, Marketing Mix Models and bespoke campaign effectiveness studies.
* Proficient in Spanish and English with effective communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of the advertising landscape, across all kinds of media channels and methods of buying.
* Demonstrated ability to generate strategic insights from rigorous analysis.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge in advertising for Live events.
* Experience managing projects independently with a high attention to detail.
* Experience in building and following processes to make working methods more efficient.
* Experience navigating early-stage environments with ambiguity.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with clients and colleagues, valuing diverse perspectives for better decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate and interpret data meaning.

title: F&B Server - Six Senses Quexigal Palace (New Hotel Opening)
description:

Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and ensure full knowledge and active participation of all our brand initiatives.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

As F&B Server, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation in the following:

* Ensure all guests are welcomed warmly and courteously, using their names whenever possible, and provide attentive, personalized service.
* Escort guests to their tables or bar seating, present menus professionally, and handle telephone calls efficiently.
* Take food and beverage orders accurately, advising guests on menu items, cocktails, wines, pairings, ingredients, and allergens.
* Prepare and serve alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages according to established recipes, presentation standards, and Six Senses guidelines when required.
* Ensure prompt and efficient service, coordinating effectively between restaurant and bar teams.
* Maintain thorough knowledge of all F&B menus, outlet opening hours, daily specials, activities, and operational procedures.
* Ensure all mise en place is properly prepared before service and follow opening and closing checklists.
* Recommend and promote food, beverages, resort facilities, and experiences, identifying appropriate upselling opportunities.
* Monitor stock levels of beverages and service items, communicate replenishment needs, and ensure responsible use of resources.
* Maintain clean, organized, and well-maintained service areas, equipment, menus, wine lists, and beverage lists, ensuring compliance with hygiene and safety standards.
* Handle guest billing accurately, minimizing discrepancies and ensuring correct payment procedures.
* Uphold Six Senses service standards and strictly adhere to LQA requirements, using guest feedback to continuously improve service quality.
* Maintain high standards of personal appearance, grooming, and hygiene, and comply with all relevant safety, security, and emergency procedures.
* Respect guest privacy and confidentiality, ensuring the proper protection of personal data.
* Attend briefings, meetings, and training sessions to remain informed about operational updates, special events, policies, and guest preferences.
* Support colleagues across restaurant and bar operations, promoting teamwork and seamless service delivery.
* Perform any additional duties assigned by the Assistant Restaurant Manager, Restaurant Manager, or Head Bartender in support of overall operations.

To execute the position of F&B Server, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:

* High school diploma or equivalent and at least 1-3 years restaurant experience in a full-service outlet or similar setting. Hospitality diploma/degree from a recognized hospitality school is preferred.
* Fluent in English; I understand that additional languages are preferred.
* Alcohol awareness certification and/or food service permit or valid health/food handler card as required by local or state government agency.
* Fluent in English and Spanish; I understand that additional languages are preferred.

Six Senses Quexigal Palace is an equal opportunity employer. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

Six Senses serves as a changemaker and maintains a leadership commitment to community, sustainability, emotional hospitality, wellness, and crafted experiences, infused with a touch of quirkiness.

Whether an exquisite island resort, mountain retreat, or urban hotel; Six Senses unites a diverse, multinational, and multicultural portfolio of properties. Each host brings to life the values in their own way, while delivering on the brand’s vision: to reawaken people’s senses so they feel the purpose behind their travels and ultimately reconnect with themselves, others, and the world around them.

You’re about to be the author of this journey that takes you through life’s undiscovered passageways, hidden treasures, and meaningful experiences.

It’s a story unlike any other. Out of the ordinary, one could say. A journey across lands and seas, a tale about what it means to connect to the world around us.

Let the journey begin.

title: Nike LEAD Associate (Líder de Equipo) - LA JONQUERA - Contrato Permanente - Full Time (40hs)
description:
Position Type

Full Time

Career area

Retail Stores

Location

CC Gran Jonquera, La Jonquera, Girona 17700, Spain

Job ID

R-96442

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**Líder de equipo de Nike/Lead:** todos los géneros

**Disponibilidad Completa**

  

**Empleo en NIKE Retail**

NIKE, Inc. no solo ofrece equipación a atletas de élite mundial, sino que también experimenta con el potencial, derriba las barreras y supera los límites de lo posible. Buscamos personas capaces de crecer, pensar, soñar y crear. Su cultura anima a aceptar la diversidad y fomentar la imaginación. Necesitamos líderes, gente visionaria y personas con talento. En NIKE, Inc. todo el mundo aporta sus habilidades y pasiones en un partido desafiante en constante cambio.

Trabajar en las tiendas significa representar a NIKE, Inc. Los equipos de las NIKE Stores se centran constantemente en los conocimientos de los productos y el servicio al cliente para ofrecer siempre experiencias valiosas a los clientes. De Londres a Estambul, cada tienda tiene una perspectiva única y cuenta con una comunidad emocionante de gente a la que le gusta el deporte y la moda. Para trabajar en retail con NIKE se necesita creatividad y ambición. También hay que ofrecer la oportunidad de desarrollarse junto a un equipo y atletas de élite de la industria.

¿Sabes qué nos falta para ser el mejor equipo de retail del mundo? ¡Alguien como TÚ!

En nuestras NIKE Retail Stores utilizamos nombres especiales para los puestos: cada store manager se llama "head coach", cada store manager adjunto se llama "assistant head coach", cada manager de departamento se llama "coach", cada líder de equipo se llama "lead" y cada empleado de ventas se llama "athlete".

  
  

**Únete al equipo NIKE, Inc.**

Como **lead**, **disfrutarás de**:

* Utilizar tus capacidades en el ámbito del servicio excepcional al cliente para ofrecer las experiencias de una marca premium a nuestros clientes
* Coordinar, asesorar y motivar a empleados de tu zona y garantizar un ambiente de trabajo excelente
* Cpoyar la gestión del trabajo diario en tu zona para alcanzar los objetivos de ventas (por ejemplo, con servicios digitales, presentaciones visuales, en la sala de ventas o en campañas promocionales)
* Identificar y resolver problemas en colaboración con tu store leader
* Representar a la marca en las iniciativas de NIKE
* Garantizar que la tienda cumple con todos los estándares y las directrices de NIKE
  

  

Más en concreto, la estructura de nuestra tienda consiste en los siguientes 3 funciones de lead:

**COMERCIAL**

* Apoyar a un equipo que puede recibir productos de forma eficiente, realizar inventarios precisos y cumplir con los estándares de presentación
* Garantizar que los procesos de todos los inventarios funcionan bien para que la sala de ventas esté siempre llena, tenga una buena presentación y cumpla con los estándares de la marca
* Trabajar con coaches de departamento que supervisarán los componentes individuales (recepción de productos y presentación visual) mientras te encargas de estas labores
* Estar a cargo de preparar las iniciativas de los lanzamientos mensuales a tiempo y ofrecer feedback de forma periódica
* Utilizar nuestras herramientas de informes con tu coach de departamento para tomar las mejores decisiones comerciales
* Dar ejemplo de cómo realizar un inventario preciso para completar los pedidos digitales

**EXPERIENCIA DE ATHLETES**

* Garantizar que el equipo cuenta con las herramientas para ofrecer experiencias de athletes de la máxima (Objetivo)
* Colaborar con coaches para programar actividades de NIKE Community Ambassador para fortalecer el equipo
* Trabajar en el proceso de contratación e incorporación en colaboración con store leaders con experiencia
* Trabajar con tu store coach para implementar los horarios de la tienda la disponibilidad, la utilización y los envíos
* Colaborar con el equipo de la tienda para implementar y mantener una cultura NIKE positiva

**EXPERIENCIA DE LOS CLIENTES**

* Dar ejemplo de cómo ofrecer nuestro servicio en la sala de ventas y animar la experiencia de los clientes
* Aportar recursos para que el equipo cuente con conocimientos de la marca sobre todos los aspectos del servicio al cliente, como utilizar los servicios digitales
* Completar formaciones específicas e informar a los servicios de athlete
* Utilizar datos y análisis para ofrecer información y colaborar con store leaders con experiencia para mejorar continuamente
  

  

Estos son los **beneficios**:

* Un sueldo atractivo que evoluciona con el mercado y experiencia
* La oportunidad de recibir bonificaciones mensuales
* Descuentos interesantes para empleados en tienda y online
* Un paquete de ventajas increíble
* Oportunidades laborales y de formación ilusionantes
* Formaciones habituales sobre ventas y productos
* Un ambiente motivador y dinámico en el que se valora la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión
* Uniforme de empleado para representar a NIKE y fomentar el espíritu de equipo
* Acceso a actividades deportivas
* Oportunidades para participar en eventos NIKE únicos
  

  

Esto es **lo que tienes que ofrecer:**

* Pasión por NIKE y por el deporte
* Más de 2 años de experiencia en tienda
* Capacidad para hablar de forma profesional

title: Marketing Planning and Performance Manager
description:
Just imagine shaping how the LEGO® brand builds demand across Spain and Portugal. Then make it real.

  
  

**About the role**

As our Marketing Planning & Performance Manager for Iberia, you’ll lead insight-driven marketing planning, budget management and marketing effectiveness. You’ll translate global and Western Europe priorities into commercially grounded local plans. Working closely with Marketing and Finance, you’ll connect consumer, shopper and market insights with investment decisions, monitor performance and recommend action when results move off track. The position will belong to the marketing leadership team reporting directly to the Head of Marketing.

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience in coordinating planning cycles, tracking spend and forecasts, investigating variances and supporting month-end and year-end financial processes.
* Strong ease working with figures and complex datasets; ability to check data accuracy, identify trends and variances, interpret marketing, consumer, shopper and commercial data, evaluate effectiveness and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced Excel, strong PowerPoint and confidence working with reporting and planning systems to produce accurate analysis and clear decision-ready presentations.
* Stakeholder influence and collaboration: build strong relationships across Marketing, Finance and regional teams
* Being able to connect analysis to business priorities, communicate a clear storyline and present practical recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Prioritisation, ownership and adaptability: focus on the highest-impact priorities - make trade-offs, anticipate risks, maintain attention to detail and deliver reliably under pressure
* Professional fluency in English and Spanish
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Applied marketing mix modelling, campaign evaluation, or consumer and shopper research to guide media and marketing investment decisions.
* Coordinated integrated marketing plans across multiple markets, aligning local priorities with regional direction.
  

**What you'll build**

* Coordinating the marketing contribution to Iberia’s annual strategy, bringing together insights and priorities to shape a coherent plan aligned with business objectives and Western Europe direction.
* Optimising marketing budgets throughout the year, allocating and reallocating investment in line with strategic priorities and business performance to focus resources where they can have the greatest impact.
* Balancing brand-building priorities, commercial objectives and budget constraints, including recommendations to address gaps to target.
* Translating complex performance data and marketing effectiveness findings into practical investment choices and clear stakeholder narratives.
* Improving planning tools, data quality and ways of working while building shared ownership of performance and continuous learning.
  

  

If you’ve owned a marketing budget or planning cycle and used performance data to change an investment decision, you’ll feel at home here. What matters most is making complex findings clear, practical and useful.

You’ll join the Iberia Marketing team, which creates demand through locally relevant programmes grounded in consumer, shopper and commercial understanding. You’ll collaborate across Brand Marketing, Digital Media, Brand Relations, Trade Marketing and Finance. You’ll take ownership, manage competing priorities and communicate clear storylines, while constructively challenging requests when focus is needed.

You’ll create transparent budgets, reliable planning routines and timely performance reviews that lead to action. As the team strengthens integrated planning across Spain and Portugal, you’ll help embed marketing effectiveness and consumer insights into investment discussions. You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing, the Marketing Leadership Team, Finance, Western Europe peers, insight specialists, the Marketing Effectiveness team and external agencies.

title: Regional People Partner - Europe Major Markets
description:

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.  
  
The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.  
  
Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.  
  
Lush is committed to pay transparency and equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. Pay decisions are made objectively based on role scope, geographic market data, experience, and capability, without regard to gender or protected characteristics.  
  
**Role overview:**

Develop meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships between people practices and commercial business success across our European major markets. Engage with regional leaders, country managers, and business partners. Deliver change and transformation, taking the lead in people related projects with a broad and objective view of the impact across diverse business areas and geographies within the region.

This role involves direct line management and leadership of People Leads across our European entities. Driving regional alignment, operational consistency, and team development. You will utilise sound knowledge of Lush people principles and best practices, working collaboratively and proactively with other members of the global and regional people team on cross functional projects, in support of colleagues doing their best work across multiple markets.

**Office Location:** This role will support our colleagues in France, Germany, Italy and Spain and ideally you're main location of work will be Paris, Berlin, Milan or Madrid.

**Business Travel:** As this role will be supporting France, Germany, Italy and Spain, travelling will be a requirement.  
  
**Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.**

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Directly line manage and empower the People Leads across European entities, fostering their growth, setting clear operational standards, and ensuring strong local HR delivery.
* Work alongside the Leader/Director, FBP, and their team on a wide range of topics, such as change management, projects, organisational design, recruitment, training and development, and communications.
* Provide tactical advice and guidance to the management of your business areas on all people matters relating to capability, skills required, and performance output.
* Connect regularly with the People Discipline Leads creating alignment in standards of staff experience in recruitment, onboarding, training, pay, and development while respecting and adapting to local cultural and regulatory nuances within the region.
* Deliver organisational development projects and support organisational change initiatives within the business entities. Establishing needs, proposing solutions, and monitoring effectiveness to get the best possible return for the business area while managing regional complexity and local implementation.
* Navigate local employment law landscapes across major markets, partnering with local experts and employee representative bodies such as Works Councils and Trade Unions to ensure fair, compliant, and culturally sensitive operations.
* Build relationships of mutual learning and trust with regional peers and stakeholders and have a good understanding of individuals' working styles and team dynamics.
* Assess and review team structures & development pathways. Identify skills gaps, succession planning, talent, and performance management opportunities across your team and European entities.
* Clearly communicate guidance to staff at all levels on change management and restructures, with emphasis on the how, ensuring compliance with all relevant jurisdictional requirements by working with local experts.
* Proactively anticipate issues before they happen and act for prevention, particularly regarding cross border people movement and regulatory changes across European markets.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Minimum of 5 years of HR/People Partnering experience, ideally within a multi site retail, commercial, or multinational environment.
* Proven track record in line managing, coaching, and developing HR/People leads across international or multi entity business models.
* Broad understanding of the commercial landscape within Europe with a drive to help others understand it too.
* Solid working knowledge of French employment law is highly beneficial. Familiarity with employment law in other key European markets is desirable, though core knowledge across other jurisdictions can be taught and supported by local specialists.
* Experience in, or strong capability to navigate:
  + Works Councils (Comité Social et Économique / Betriebsrat) in France and Germany.
  + Trade Unions & Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA / CCN) in Spain and Italy (e.g., *Convenio Colectivo*, *Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro*).
* Trusted relationship with the Director/s, with a track record of providing useful advice and recommendations on people matters.
* Act with kindness, integrity, and respect.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to make decisions independently.
* Informed, relevant, and up to date with the business and team sentiment across the region.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to think quickly and sensitively in a culturally diverse environment.
* Demonstrable ability to influence, challenge, and negotiate with management at all levels and execute with excellence.
* Excellent ability to navigate multiple perspectives and stakeholders to deliver action that works for everyone.
* Desire to represent a professional and fair approach.
* Strong ability to constantly assess and prioritise the needs of the business and individuals.
* Positive attitude, motivated, action oriented.
* Able to support the growth and development of individuals at all levels.
* Competent in recruiting, interviewing, career conversations in addition to performance management, sensitive feedback, or exit conversations.
* Commercially minded, analytical, and objective, with a strong grasp of regional market data and trends.
* Collaborate closely with other People disciplines to ensure support for all employees, including Talent, Global Mobility, Pay and Benefits, ED&I, People Support, and L&D.

**Languages**

* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.
* Professional fluency in one or more major European languages (French, German, Spanish, or Italian) is strongly preferred to effectively manage localised People Leads and partner with regional stakeholders across key entities.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Bonus scheme
* Day off for weekday birthdays
* A generous discount on Lush products and spa treatments
* Employee assistance programme
* We’re 10% Employee Owned - all colleagues play a role in protecting our ethics, our independence, contributing ideas for the future and share in the rewards of success when the company is doing well.
* Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.

Localised benefits can be discussed in more detail during the recruitment process.

We believe that your information is yours and that it is Lush's responsibility to process your personal information in a secure, fair and accurate manner. Every individual processed by LUSH has certain rights over their data, which are detailed in our Privacy Notice here.

### **About Lush**

Since establishing in 1995 in Poole, Dorset, Lush has been driven by innovation and its ethics.  
Creators of pioneering beauty products such as the fizzing bath bomb, shower jellies and solid shampoo bars, we place emphasis on fresh ingredients like organic fruits and vegetables, fight against animal testing and combat over-packaging by developing products that can be sold ‘naked’ to the customer without any packaging.  
  
We currently operate in 52 countries with 928 global shops. Through our separate business divisions we invent, manufacture and sell our handmade products direct to our customers through our own shops and online. The fact that we make all our products by hand is something we are really rather proud of!  
  
Lush is 10% Employee Owned since 2017 and our people are the heart and soul of our business.

Manager, Strategy & Execution

Posting Start Date: 10/26/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution**

* **Location:** Copenhagen / Lisbon
* **Work model:** Hybrid / Full time
* **Contract type / duration:** Permanent

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

  

**What your day will look like**

As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

* Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days
* Developing a methodology to define future market roles
* Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency
* Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period
* Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board
* Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution
* Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

* Project managing complex, cross-functional projects
* Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)
* Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions
* Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations
* Running workshops with senior leaders
* Building slide decks to tell a compelling message
* Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)
  

**What you’ll bring**

* You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience
  + Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus
* Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward
* Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors
* Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail
* Strong stakeholder management and team working experience
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel
  + Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus
  + Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus
* Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging
* A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you
* Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs
* Professionally fluent in English
  

**What you’ll learn**

* There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching
* This could include:
  + Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector
  + Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way
  + Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success
  + Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization
* This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite
* Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too
  

**Working at STG & What to expect**

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against key competencies and requirements for the role.
