title: BSA Head of Primary
description:
**Job Description**

**Purpose of Role**
===================

**As a Senior Leader, you are critical in supporting the Head of School in establishing both a School of Choice and an Employer of Choice. You report directly to your Head of School and work in active, positive collaboration with your Senior Leadership Team. You are accountable for delivering on the desired outcomes in each of the components listed below, and the ongoing development of the school and learning improvement.**


**Role Specific Duties**
========================

**Safeguarding and Wellbeing. You are responsible for the safety and wellbeing of the students and adults in your area of responsibility. This includes all activities, operations and policies to ensure students and adults are kept safe both physically and mentally, removing barriers and personalising learning. You model and foster an open culture and inclusive atmosphere where everyone cares for one another and focuses on learning and getting better. You work in collaboration with your teams to gather, learn from, and act on feedback to inform your decisions in creating an inclusive learning environment. You are crucial in supporting your Head of School to ensure a safe, open, caring, collaborative and inclusive space exists for everyone to grow and develop.**


**Culture Building.** **You model your shared ideas that are underpinned by ISP’s** **principles and** **learning approach. You nurture and drive a learning-focused atmosphere in your area of responsibility.** **You notice, support, and provide opportunities for staff to develop professionally and personally. You acknowledge and celebrate individual successes and achievements. In collaboration with other Senior Leaders in your school, y****ou actively support, encourage and inspire your school community, contributing to a positive school atmosphere.**


**Leadership and Development. You understand your own strengths and areas for development, knowing when to take action and when to seek advice, support or mentor. You lead with vision, empathy and integrity. You actively connect, collaborate and engage with your teams and the wider school community to continually innovate and improve. You establish and monitor systems and procedures to support staff learning and motivation. You recruit, develop and retain talent. Your support for your middle leaders empowers them to effectively build and lead high-impact and collaborative teams. Your coaching and mentoring develop self-directed middle leaders and learners, who in turn are able to do the same for their own teams.**


**Learning and Embedding Quality. You support your Head of School, collaborate with your peers and empower your teams to focus on the quality of learning in your area of responsibility to ensure movement towards Mastering in the 9 criteria of ISP’s Learning Improvement Process. You model your own continual learning and plan and lead meaningful professional learning opportunities for your staff. You promote dialogue and reflection on learning and improvement. You facilitate and engage in professional and respectful dialogue with teachers, parents and the ISP community about learning and teaching, inspiring a shared commitment to getting better. Your teachers feel confident to have open and honest conversations about the learning of their students, their own learning and how they can get better. You and your leadership team regularly gather, document and analyse evidence of learning and use this to inform your teams’ decision-making process and work with your middle leaders to identify targets and action steps for improving learning for all.**


**Partnership with ISP. You are committed to working in partnership with ISP, specifically with the Regional Director of Learning and, when required, and other members of your Regional Team. You harness the potential of the ISP network through building and nurturing collaborative relationships with colleagues in other ISP schools. You understand and value ISP’s role as a trusted advisor and resource to support you in your role as a learning leader. You see the school as part of the group and articulate the added value of being an ISP school to your teams. You understand your collective responsibility to the school and ISP, successfully balancing the school’s interests with ISP’s purpose and principles.**


**Partnership with Parents, Carers and the wider community. You support and provide opportunities for your school community to build positive relationships. You foster a culture of partnership based on effective, regular direct communication and two-way feedback between teachers and parents. Together with your teaching teams, you help parents and carers understand the school’s shared ideas about learners and learning in ways that help them to engage confidently when talking about what their child is getting better at, what their next steps are, and how they will be supported at home. Accessible and available to parents and carers, you ensure their individual needs are understood and that they feel informed and involved as valued members of the school’s learning community. You represent your school to the wider community, third-party vendors, regulatory bodies and others, and you excel in forging and developing beneficial connections.**


**Communication and Admissions. You are a clear and compelling storyteller, articulating the vision and story of your division and ISP in a way that inspires parents, students and colleagues. You have a clear understanding of the learning in your area of responsibility and can effectively communicate the ways in which your school is improving the learning of the students and teachers. You contribute to both your schools and your region’s efforts to share stories of Amazing Learning to support Admissions. You contribute to your Senior Leadership Team’s effort in using parent feedback and NPS data to guide future plans and parent/carer engagement.**


**ISP Principles**
==================

**Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.**


**Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.**
========================================================================================================================================================

**Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.**
=============================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Are financially responsible.** **We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.**
======================================================================================================================================

**Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.**
=================================================================================================================================================

**ISP Senior Leaders Key Responsibilities**
===========================================

**At ISP, everyone is a learner. As a senior leader, you model learning and a growth mindset, demonstrating a desire to learn and build on your knowledge, skills and understanding in leading learning and the learning of others. You foster the learning and growth of your leadership team, which will be fundamental to your success.**


**Learner (ISP definition)**
============================

**The ISP learner recognises that their mindset, experiences and actions drive their learning outcomes. With this awareness, they exercise voice, choice, and ownership over their process of learning - leading their learning and the learning of others.**
=============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

* **Adhere to global** **ISP Principles** **and follow the criteria set out in the** **ISP Senior Leadership for Learning Role Profile**

* **Under the reasonable direction of the Headteacher, carry out the professional duties of a school teacher as set out in the current UK Teachers’ standards document:** **https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment\_****data/file/1040274/Teachers Standards\_Dec\_2021.pdf**

* **Joint responsibility, with the Headteacher for the academic progress and pastoral care of all pupils from FS1 to Year 6.**
* **Ensure the primary school is fully prepared at all times for a successful external inspection or Best Practice Review**
* **Substitute effectively in the absence of the Headteacher in conjunction with the Head of Secondary.**

**ISP Key Responsibilities**
============================

**1. Atmosphere:** **You enable students to learn in a safe, open, caring, collaborative and inclusive atmosphere. Your students feel confident in having open and honest conversations about their learning and how they can get better. You create a positive atmosphere by building relationships, behaviours, and inclusive learning experiences that support a good struggle for** ***all*** **your learners. You engage in professional and respectful dialogue with colleagues and the wider school and ISP communities about learning and teaching, with a shared commitment to getting better.**


**2. Shared Ideas:** **You know and model your school’s values and contribute to its mission and vision through your daily actions. Through all aspects of learning and teaching, you create a strong sense of shared behaviours and purpose for learners and their learning.**
===============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**3.** **A Focus on Learners and Learning.** **You put learners and their learning first. Your understanding of the difference between learning and the factors that affect learning enables you to plan and support a good struggle for** ***all*** **your students to get better. You are committed to your personal and professional learning and development, engaging in a series of learning visits and inquiries with colleagues and leaders to support your ongoing self-evaluation. You are an active and valued member of dynamic learning communities,**


**4.** **Learning and Teaching.** **You put learners and their learning first in your design and facilitation of learning outcomes, content and experiences, which are underpinned by positive and supportive relationships. You understand the types and phases of learning and apply your knowledge, skills and understanding of these to effectively facilitate learning, teaching, and assessing to meet the personalised needs of each student. You empower students to lead their own learning, supporting them to monitor, assess and adjust their learning in response to feedback. You continuously inquire into the process of learning, making evidence-informed decisions and taking action to further improve learning and teaching.**


**5. Evidence of Learning.** **You gather, document and analyse evidence of learning from various sources and use this to identify targets and action steps for improving learning. You support students in knowing the different ways their learning can be evidenced and how to use feedback and learning advice to get better. Evidence enables you to make secure judgments about your students’ learning in line with their personal learning goals, age and stage appropriate expectations, and local, national and international benchmarking. You document and share evidence of learning to answer the questions: “What are my students learning?” and “How do I know?”.**


**6. Leadership for Learning.** **You see yourself as a leader for learning and demonstrate the same vision, values and commitment as school leaders to support students to continuously learn and get better. You take responsibility for where students are now with their learning and the targets and action steps needed to improve. You support students to become leaders of their own learning by helping them develop their voice, choice and ownership of their learning process.**


**7.** **Learning Spaces.** **You create and use spaces to support and demonstrate the school’s shared ideas about learners and learning and the ways in which students are getting better. You ensure learning spaces (physical and digital) are safe, collaborative, accessible and inclusive, and enable students to play an active role in their development.**


**8. In Partnership with Parents and Carers.** **You work in partnership with parents and carers, communicating with them regularly about their child’s learning, inviting their feedback and using this feedback to improve learning. You help parents and carers understand the school’s shared ideas about learners and learning in ways that help them to engage confidently when talking about what their child is getting better at, what their next steps are, and how they will be supported at home. You ensure that the individual needs of parents and carers are understood and that they feel informed and involved as valued members of the school’s learning community.**


**9. Learning****Improvement Planning.** **You are committed to learning and getting better and ensure this improvement happens strategically and effectively. You are active and accountable for your contribution in setting your own professional goals, targets and action steps that focus on improving learning and gathering evidence to demonstrate these. You contribute to department and school improvement planning where possible and view the school’s learning improvement plan as the central focus for getting better together.**


**Strategic Responsibilities**
==============================

* **Support the vision, ethos and policies of the school, and of ISP, and promote the highest levels of achievement and attainment.**
* **Support the evaluation of the effectiveness of the school’s policies and developments.**
* **Be a key member of the SLT, attending meetings and school events as and when necessary.**
* **In conjunction with the other members of the SLT, translate the vision into agreed objectives which are reflected in an on-going School Improvement Plan and help to monitor, and evidence progress via the Self Evaluation Rubric.**
* **Plan, in line with school planning cycles, and develop appropriate mechanisms for regular monitoring and review.**
* **With the Headteacher, regularly review the appropriateness of staffing in the primary department and the curriculum offer at BSA**

**Marketing and External Links**
================================

* **Maintain effective relationships with parents and other members of the community, both to ensure an excellent local reputation for the school and to develop a partnership with them.**
* **Develop creative initiatives which complement the activities of the school with the result that a culture of extra-curricular and other opportunities thrive.**
* **Work with the Head of Admissions and Marketing, KS Leaders, SLT and the Headteacher to achieve excellent internal and external communications, including relevant parts of the School Newsflash, year books and other parental links.**
* **Support the work of the Admissions and Marketing Departments in recruiting pupils**

**Leadership**
==============

**Support the Headteacher in the following:**
=============================================

* **Develop and maintain a culture of high expectations for self and others.**
* **Develop and maintain positive working relationships with, and between, Primary staff and provide and sustain motivation.**
* **Develop and maintain effective strategies and procedures for staff recruitment, induction, professional development and performance review, which deliver intended and agreed outcomes.**
* **Provide training opportunities for staff in terms of their leadership and management skills.**
* **Develop an ethos which ensures regular involvement of staff in school developments and encourages collaboration, innovation and individual and team creativity.**

**Management**
==============

* **Ensure all primary school resources are managed strictly within allocated budgets; actively seek opportunities for cost-improvements and ensure that ‘value for money’ is at the core of all financial activities.**
* **Help to elaborate an effective programme of staff training in September and June, and at other points in the academic year, in consultation with the Headteacher and the Head of Secondary.**
* **Develop the primary timetable working in conjunction with the Head of Secondary**
* **Monitor staff absence and organise suitable cover arrangements when required**
* **Full involvement in the recruitment of staff**
* **Ensure the TLSE appraisal system is completed and reviewed by all staff**
* **Oversee the organisation and running of Primary Parents’ Evenings**
* **Supervise the planning of curriculum trips and ensure that there is a balanced offer of off-site learning opportunities across subjects and phases in the secondary department**
* **Assist and advise the Admissions team, particularly during visits by potential new pupils**
* **Ensure adequate child protection measures and training are in force, in consultation with the DSL and DDSL.**
* **Promote Health and Safety and ensure compliance with statutory requirements, liaising directly with the Health and Safety Representative for the Group and BSA’s Health and Safety Officer.**

**Leading Teaching and Learning**
=================================

* **Promote excellence in teaching and learning, ensuring a continuous and consistent primary school-wide focus on pupil achievement and development in order that each child fulfils his or her full potential.**
* **Oversee and support in the development of the Primary PSHE programme.**
* **Ensure that progress is effectively monitored through the use of performance data, benchmark data (GL assessment) and regular self-evaluation.**

* **Support the Head of Learning in ensuring that the Leading the Learning programme is embedded throughout all areas of the primary department**
* **Promote pertinent, relevant and regular professional development for all staff.**
* **Ensure that individual pupil progress is regularly assessed, recorded, reported and used to inform future teaching.**
* **Ensure that pupil support systems are in place and promote and monitor high standards of pupils’ conduct (including dress, manners and general behaviour).**
* **Cover a part-time teaching timetable in your own specialist area.**

**Pastoral Care**
=================

* **Be responsible for maintaining good discipline and a high standard of uniform throughout the primary school.**
* **Ensure there is a regular programme of assemblies and tutorial activities and assist with these when required**
* **Ensure effective systems of supervision during pupil breaks and lunchtime are in place.**
* **Provide leadership (as required) in the supervision of pupil activities, both extra-curricular and social.**
* **Work with your team to oversee and manage the school house system and related events and activities.**
* **Maintain an overview of the transition from Primary to Secondary.**
* **Help to develop a proactive attitude towards dealing with parents and support staff in parent meetings when required**

**Qualifications and Professional Development**
===============================================

**Essential**
=============

* **Qualified Teacher Status (PGCE or BEd or equivalent)**
* **Degree level education or an equivalent professional qualification in specialist subject**
* **Previous middle management or senior leadership experience within a school setting**

**Knowledge, skills and competencies**
======================================

=============

* **Thorough knowledge of the UK Primary curriculum in EYFS, Key Stage 1 and Key Stage 2**
* **A real passion for teaching and a desire to constantly improve their pupils´ learning**
* **Strong organisational skills**
* **Experience in the development and implementation of new initiatives and programmes**

=================

title: Regional Security Manager (Temporal)

description:
**Everything you are looking for and more**

At InPost, we are looking for a Regional Security Manager to lead and drive our security strategy across Spain and Portugal, ensuring the protection of our people, assets, facilities and operations.

Reporting to the Security Director Iberia, you will play a key role in strengthening security standards across our network, managing risks and ensuring business continuity in a dynamic logistics environment. You will oversee physical and electronic security, lead security teams and external providers, manage the departmental budget, and ensure compliance with applicable legislation and InPost Group standards.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational responsibility, including security systems management, incident investigations, site audits and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

Based in San Fernando de Henares (Madrid), you will travel frequently across Spain and Portugal, covering approximately 50% of the Iberian territory. Availability outside regular working hours and on-call support will also be required.

**What responsibilities and objectives will you have?**

* **Security Strategy & Risk Management:** Define and implement the security strategy for the assigned Iberian territory, aligned with InPost Group objectives. Identify, assess and mitigate risks across facilities, transportation and operational processes, ensuring business continuity and resilience.
* **Team Leadership & Workforce Management:** Lead, develop and coordinate security specialists, security guards and auxiliary personnel. Manage workforce planning, schedules, shift coverage, substitutions and team allocation to ensure service continuity and operational efficiency.
* **Budget & Provider Management:** Prepare and monitor the annual security budget, optimising costs without compromising protection. Act as the main point of contact for external security providers, overseeing service levels, performance, contractual requirements and continuous improvement initiatives.

***Nice to have***

* ASIS CPP/APP, TAPA, ISO 28000 or other relevant security certifications.

**About ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza**

ZEST Hotel Resort is where dynamic energy meets effortless luxury. Designed for those who seek both indulgence and authenticity, we create a space where creativity thrives and every moment is a celebration of the senses. From vibrant days by the pool to elegant evenings under the stars, ZEST pulses with movement, music, and connection. Our approach to luxury is relaxed yet refined, stylish, welcoming, and always inspiring. Here, pleasure is an art, and every stay is an unforgettable experience.

ZEST Hotel Resort is a new luxury resort in Cap Negret, Ibiza, scheduled to open in April 2027. With 206 rooms and seven villas, destination dining, wellness facilities, and a Beach Club, we are building a team that will bring warm, thoughtful hospitality to every part of the guest experience.

  

**About the Role**

Lead the culinary vision behind one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury resort openings.

As we prepare for opening, we are looking for an exceptional Executive Chef to join our Executive Leadership Team and help shape the culinary identity of this landmark resort.

This is an opportunity to do much more than lead a kitchen. We are seeking a culinary leader who can create memorable dining experiences, develop innovative concepts, build an outstanding brigade, and establish a food culture that celebrates the energy, creativity, and natural abundance of Ibiza.

Reporting to the Director of Food Beverage, the Executive Chef will have overall responsibility for the culinary strategy, food quality, and kitchen operations across the resort.

Working closely with the Food Beverage leadership team and wider resort stakeholders, you will help define and deliver the culinary vision of ZEST across restaurants, bars, Pool Club, in-room dining, banqueting, and special events. You will play a key role in translating the ZEST brand into exceptional dining experiences while balancing creativity, operational excellence, team development, and commercial performance.

As part of the pre-opening team, you will help establish kitchen infrastructure, recruit and develop the culinary team, create menus and concepts, and ensure operational readiness ahead of launch.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and deliver the overall culinary vision and food strategy for ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza.
* Create innovative menus and dining concepts that combine Mediterranean and Ibicenco influences with contemporary international cuisine.
* Champion local, seasonal, and sustainable ingredients, building strong partnerships with Ibizan and Balearic suppliers and producers.
* Lead all culinary operations across restaurants, bars, Pool Club, in-room dining, events, banqueting, and employee dining facilities.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and inspire a high-performing culinary team, creating a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Establish kitchen structures, operational standards, recipes, procedures, and working practices ahead of opening.
* Collaborate closely with the Director of Food Beverage on concept development, menu engineering, pricing strategies, and guest experience enhancement.
* Drive food quality, consistency, creativity, and presentation standards across all outlets.
* Manage food costs, labor productivity, purchasing, inventory controls, and departmental budgets to achieve financial objectives.
* Lead seasonal menu development and adapt offerings to reflect market trends, guest preferences, and Ibiza's operating seasons.
* Embed sustainability, responsible sourcing, waste reduction, and environmental best practices throughout the culinary operation.
* Ensure full compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene, health and safety, and all regulatory requirements.
* Monitor guest feedback, culinary trends, and competitive positioning to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* Support resort events, VIP experiences, brand activations, and special culinary collaborations.
* Contribute to all pre-opening activities, including kitchen design reviews, equipment selection, supplier sourcing, training programs, and operational readiness planning.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Culinary degree or professional qualification in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Significant leadership experience as an Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef, or senior culinary leader within a luxury hotel, resort, lifestyle brand, or high-end multi-outlet operation.
* Demonstrated success managing multiple restaurants and diverse culinary concepts within a complex hospitality environment.
* Strong understanding of Mediterranean cuisine, local sourcing, seasonality, and international food trends.
* Proven experience developing successful restaurant concepts, menus, and guest dining experiences.
* Strong commercial acumen with expertise in food cost management, labor control, purchasing, budgeting, and profitability.
* Experience recruiting, developing, and leading large culinary teams.
* Previous hotel or resort pre-opening experience is highly desirable.
* In-depth knowledge of HACCP, food safety regulations, and Spanish/EU compliance requirements.
* Fluent in English and Spanish.
* Valid EU work authorization or the appropriate Spanish work permit.

Key Competencies

* Creative and visionary culinary leadership.
* Passion for exceptional food quality and guest experiences.
* Strong commercial and business acumen.
* Inspirational leadership and team development skills.
* Operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Innovation, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management abilities.
* Alignment with ZEST values, culture, and service philosophy.

  

**Benefits**

At ZEST, we believe exceptional culinary experiences are at the heart of unforgettable hospitality. As Executive Chef, you will have the opportunity to create and lead a food program that becomes a defining part of the guest experience and a benchmark within Ibiza's luxury hospitality scene.

* Competitive executive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to join the Executive Leadership Team of a landmark luxury resort.
* Be part of a pre-opening project and shape the culinary identity from day one.
* Creative freedom to develop concepts, menus, and experiences that reflect the ZEST brand.
* Opportunities for professional growth, development, and industry recognition.
* Employee recognition and engagement initiatives that celebrate success and performance.
* The opportunity to make a lasting impact on one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury hospitality destinations.
* Work within a culture driven by the ZEST Effect, where passion, creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.

**Why Join Us?**

This is far more than a traditional Executive Chef role.

You will join the team responsible for launching one of Ibiza's most exciting new luxury lifestyle resorts, helping define its culinary identity, dining concepts, guest experiences, and long-term reputation from day one.

If you are excited by the opportunity to build something exceptional from the ground up and create culinary experiences that guests remember long after they leave, we would love to hear from you.

At Fluidra, we believe that sustainable business transformation goes beyond technology. It requires rethinking how we operate, challenging existing ways of working and building globally aligned, efficient and scalable business processes.

We are looking for a **Global Business Process Owner (GPO) – Procure-to-Pay & Supply Chain** to play a pivotal role in shaping and driving the evolution of our global operating model.

You will act as a key transformation agent, bridging business strategy, operational excellence, process governance and digital enablement.

**Your mission will be to transform how Fluidra operates — not simply by improving individual processes, but by creating a more integrated, efficient, data-driven and future-ready organization.**

* Define and evolve the global end-to-end process strategy, roadmap and governance framework for the P2P and Supply Chain domains, aligned with Fluidra’s business priorities.

* Build and prioritize a global process transformation roadmap based on business impact, strategic relevance, feasibility and value creation.

* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, automation and structural simplification, ensuring sustainable adoption and measurable results.

* Drive a data-driven approach to process management, leveraging process analytics, benchmarking and process mining where appropriate.
* Monitor process performance across regions and entities, identifying deviations, root causes and opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, compliance and working capital.
* Define business cases and expected benefits for major process transformation initiatives.
* Work with business stakeholders to track value realization and ensure that process improvements deliver tangible, sustainable business outcomes.
  

**4. Digital Enablement & Technology Alignment**

* Translate business process requirements into clear functional priorities and design principles for technology and digital transformation initiatives.
* Act as the strategic business counterpart to IT, ERP and digital teams, ensuring that technology solutions enable the agreed global operating model.
* Play a leading role in business process design, validation and adoption within SAP and other relevant enterprise platforms.
* Identify and champion opportunities to leverage automation, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics and emerging technologies to improve process performance.
* Ensure that technology investments support process harmonization, scalability and long-term business value, rather than simply reproducing existing practices.
  

**5. Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong partnerships with Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Controlling, IT and regional business leaders.
* Drive alignment across functions, geographies and organizational levels, influencing decisions without necessarily relying on direct hierarchical authority.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on process strategy, transformation priorities, performance and operational improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate complex discussions, manage competing priorities and build consensus around global standards and transformation initiatives.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability and shared ownership of end-to-end business performance.
  

**6. Change Leadership & Organizational Transformation**

* Act as a catalyst for organizational change, championing new ways of working and embedding a culture of process excellence and continuous improvement.
* Work with business leaders and change management teams to ensure effective adoption of new processes, capabilities and operating practices.
* Anticipate organizational impacts, resistance to change and capability gaps, defining appropriate mitigation and enablement actions.
* Support the development of process knowledge, communities of practice and internal capabilities across the organization.
* Foster a global mindset that combines strategic vision, operational discipline and adaptability.
  

**Languages:** Fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

This is more than a process ownership role. It is an opportunity to contribute directly to the transformation of a global organization. Reporting to the Global Business Process Director, you will work at the intersection of business strategy, operational excellence and technology, with exposure to international stakeholders and the opportunity to influence how Fluidra operates worldwide.

**About the job**

**Job purpose**

Your purpose is to build and run a holistic AI security program for AXA. You will establish the governance, risk management framework, and security controls to protect our AI/ML models and data, ensuring that AXA's use of AI is not only powerful but also secure and trustworthy.

**Main missions**

Your mission is to build the program around the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, adapted for AI:

* Govern: Develop and follow implementation the Group's AI Security Strategy, in line with responsible AI principles and emerging regulations (e.g., EU AI Act). Establish policies for secure AI development, data usage, and model governance
* Identify: Lead risk assessments methodology design on AI models and systems, focusing on unique threats like data poisoning, model evasion, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection. Ensure a consolidate inventory of critical AI assets
* Protect: Define security standards and architecture patterns for the AI/ML lifecycle, from secure data acquisition and feature engineering to model training and deployment. Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of models and training data
* Detect: Oversee the implementation of monitoring mechanisms to detect model drift, anomalous behavior, and security attacks against AI systems. Define AI-specific incident precursors for the SOC
* Respond & Recover: Define and test the incident response playbook for AI-specific security events, such as a compromised model or a severe data leak through a Generative AI service

**Expected skills & experience**

We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills:

**Experience**

More than 10 years of experience in Information Security or a related field, with demonstrated experience in a leadership role focused on data science, AI/ML, or the security thereof.

**Technical skills**

* Good understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle
* Knowledge of common AI frameworks
* Familiarity with AI-specific security threats (adversarial ML, etc.) and controls
* Knowledge of data privacy and emerging AI regulations is essential

**Soft skills / transversal skills**

Profile

* Ability to build consensus and drive collaboration between highly technical data science teams, business units, AXA Group functions, and AXA entities.
* Exceptional ability to communicate in English, translating complex AI security concepts into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences from developers to senior executives

**Where will you be in the organization?**

* The division: As the thematic CISO for Artificial Intelligence within Group Security, you will be AXA's leading expert on AI security. You will partner with data science teams, innovation hubs, and local CISOs to ensure our AI initiatives are secure, trustworthy, and compliant.

We are looking to hire a European Logistics Operations Manager to plan and manage operations, lead the European Logistics team, and collaborate across the company to deliver an awesome guest experience at our Girona Warehouse, The ROW Logistics.  
  
The European Logistics Operations Manager must possess a wide variety of skills, including excellent organization, a drive for continuous improvement, and the ability to analyze and interpret multiple data points to plan current operations and forecast future operations and budget cycles. They will have experience managing, coaching, and motivating teams to deliver awesome hospitality and uphold high standards. This is your opportunity to join The ROW Logistics/Trek Travel team and leave your mark on our company, on the active travel industry and on the world at large.  
  
**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT NOT LIMITED TO:**  
**Unit & Fleet Operations**

* Coordinate, communicate, and oversee Unit Operations in Europe, including Fleet Lifecycle, Bike Allocation, Field Support, and Unit Equipment & Inventory.
* Manage Unit condition throughout the season, analyzing trends to forecast and plan efficient, cost-effective distribution and maintenance of bikes and equipment.
* Collaborate with the European Schedule Coordinator to ensure an efficient, cost-effective schedule for unit movement.
* Set and communicate standards for Unit Work, Load/Unload, and Unit handoffs; ensure reports are completed and follow up when standards are not met.
* Own the European fleet lifecycle: resource planning for new fleet builds, end-of-season service, retirement and resale of the outgoing fleet, and international shipments, including customs documentation.
* Oversee and maintain accurate data on bike assets and inventory in our systems, and implement tracking and controls for bikes, batteries, navigation devices, and other high-value equipment.

**Budget, Bike Sales & Facilities**

* Manage the European Logistics budget, including current and future year forecasting, controlling spend on parts, shipping, consumables, and facilities, and proactively identifying cost-reduction opportunities.
* Own European Bike Sales results: work with the Bike Sales Coordinator to set and implement sales strategy, pricing, and targets, with direction from the Director of Logistics and Finance, and report on results.
* Manage the Girona warehouse facility, including leases, utilities, licenses and permits, maintenance, safety, and security, in collaboration with Finance.
* Partner with Finance, legal counsel, and corporate service providers on Spanish entity compliance, contracts, and vendor agreements.
* Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting to the Director of Logistics and the Leadership team.
* Support the Logistics team with special projects and continuous improvement efforts.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Sales & Guest Experience: own timely resolution of logistics-related Log Letters and drive root-cause fixes, answer questions, and build excellent working relationships with the team.
* Trip Design: complete initial trip logistics reviews as assigned, provide Ground Operations oversight, participate in End of Season meetings, and act as a resource to support Trip Design activities.

* EU work authorization and a valid driver’s license.
* A technical cycling background with an understanding of SRAM and Shimano bike mechanics.
* Experience managing budgets and controlling operating costs, including negotiating with vendors or landlords.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage multi-disciplinary projects and navigate complex challenges within tight time constraints.

At The ROW Logistics/Trek Travel, we think outside the box, continuously improve, encourage feedback, and give it all we got, all the time, no exceptions. * Velocidad de testing creativo (compartido con Creative Strategist)

Define opportunities, territories, and strategic approaches to build a relevant and distinctive social presence.

Contribute to evolving the role of social media within CUPRA's global strategy.

Transform cultural and social insights into strategic perspectives and opportunities for CUPRA.

description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

**Why Ebury?**

* **Competitive Starting Salary** with an **annual discretionary bonus**that truly rewards your performance from day one.
* **Dedicated Mentorship:** Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.
* **Clear, Accelerated Career Progression:** Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.
* **Dynamic & Supportive Culture:** Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.
* **Generous Benefits Package:** Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.
* **Central** **Madrid** **Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.**

description:
Job Requisition ID: 20804

This is a **fixed-term appointment** with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years.

  

**Location**
  
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.

**Description**
---------------

The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.

The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE for the data curation, archiving and dissemination of its planetary missions (e.g., Rosalind Franklin Mission and other Mars or Lunar experiments). Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.

You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for ESA planetary missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist and functionally reporting to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S).

You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you will support, initially with the ESA ExoMars Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and Mars Analog Sample Laboratory archiving work.

**Duties**
----------

You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the Scientific Archive for the supported ESA planetary missions, initially the ESA ExoMars Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and Mars Analog Sample Laboratory archiving work, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal to maximise the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archives scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.

  

As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include:

  

* ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
  + interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
  + providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported ESA planetary missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
* chair and coordinate a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
* monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
* with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
* liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
* encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
* participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
* supporting the scientific community on archive- and data product-related questions.
  

As a scientist, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in ESA research activities.

**Technical competencies**
--------------------------

Experience in science data management and archiving systems

Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions

Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple interfaces at international level within a large multidisciplinary team.

Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions

**Behavioural competencies**
----------------------------

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking

**Education and professional experience**
-----------------------------------------

A PhD in a relevant domain is required for this post, together with one year of relevant professional experience.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

The following are assets for this position:

  

* Experience in promoting science to the wider scientific community and general public;
* Understanding of user needs in relation to complex software systems;
* Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions;
* Experience in agile and DevOps methodologies, human factor engineering (UX design) and associated technologies and their use in modern software engineering.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness**
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

  

**Important Information and Disclaimer**
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2-A4). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.

title: Director de Software Delivery
description:
Buscamos un **Director de Software Delivery**

**Perfil buscado**

* Más de 12 años en ingeniería y entrega de software, de los cuales al menos 5 en dirección de delivery, DevOps o plataforma.
* Experiencia implantando CI/CD, release management y metodología de SDLC en organizaciones grandes y con múltiples proveedores.
* Experiencia en gobierno de APIs y conocimiento práctico de MCP y del desarrollo asistido por IA.
* Perfil con base técnica sólida, con credibilidad ante los equipos y capacidad para exigir estándares a los proveedores. No se busca un perfil exclusivamente metodológico o de agile coach.

**Encaje en la organización**

Una de sus funciones es mediar entre Run y Change y gobernar un calendario unificado de releases para ambos.

Su eficacia depende sobre todo de las áreas que entregan y operan el software fuera del área del CTO.

**Fuera del área del CTO**

* Dominios de producto. Son el principal interlocutor. Aplican la metodología en sus proyectos, sean internos o externalizados, y la exigen a sus proveedores. Software Delivery les da un proceso claro y les acompaña en su adopción.
* PMO. Alinea la planificación y el seguimiento de proyectos con la metodología y con el calendario de releases.
* SRE. Define con Software Delivery los criterios de paso a producción, la observabilidad y el rollback, y aporta las métricas de fallo de cambios y tiempo de recuperación.
* Infraestructura. Provee los entornos y la infraestructura sobre los que se ejecutan los pipelines y los entornos no productivos.
* Soporte. Recibe cada release con la comunicación y el traspaso a Run adecuados, y aporta las incidencias posteriores a cada subida como indicador de calidad.
* IT4IT. Provee y opera las herramientas del ciclo de vida (requisitos, repositorios, CI/CD, gestión de servicios), conforme a los estándares definidos por Software Delivery.

**Dentro del área del CTO**

* Arquitectura y UX. Definen sus estándares; Software Delivery garantiza que intervienen en cada proyecto mediante puntos de control obligatorios.
* QA. Define la estrategia de pruebas y su automatización; Software Delivery la integra como gate en la plataforma CI/CD y en el flujo entre entornos.
* IA. Construye el framework de desarrollo agéntico; Software Delivery lo industrializa dentro del SDLC.
* Ciberseguridad. Valida los controles de seguridad de los pipelines, las APIs y los servidores MCP.

description:
We are expanding our Corporate Information Security Team and look forward to welcoming new colleagues and leaders. We are looking for a **Head of Information Security Architecture** **(m/f/d)** .

Reporting to the Global CISO, you will define how security is embedded across Liebherr’s IT, OT, cloud, data, digital products and emerging technology landscape. You will own the information security architecture strategy, target state, principles and governance, translate business risks and regulatory obligations into scalable architectural direction, and drive Security by Design from idea through to operation.

The role leads the Information Security Architecture team and acts as the enterprise-level security architecture authority in close partnership with Enterprise Architecture and all Corporate Information Security domains.

The working location for this position will be in Madrid city where we are currently setting up a new office. We operate a hybrid model, requiring at least 40% of the working time on-site on a weekly basis.

**Creating passion: your responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------

**Principles, standards and reference architectures:**

* Define, maintain and govern information security architecture principles, standards, patterns, reference architectures and reusable blueprints.
* Provide integrated architectural direction across identity and access, cloud, network and Zero Trust, infrastructure, endpoint, data protection, security monitoring, OT and Product Security.
* Contribute to the information security architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning security architecture with business and CIS priorities.
* Define security architecture guardrails for AI and emerging technologies, partnering with key stakeholders to ensure secure-by-design solutions aligned with risk, policy and regulatory requirements.

**Security by Design and architecture governance:**

* Establish and drive Security by Design, embedding proportionate security requirements into initiatives from idea, investment and design through implementation and operation.
* Establish and chair the information security architecture decision, and governance process, including architecture intake, design reviews, decision rights, approval criteria, escalation paths and exception management.
* Design a scalable, risk-based engagement model that supports delivery teams without making Information Security Architecture a bottleneck.

**Risk, regulatory and threat alignment:**

* Translate business risk, cybersecurity risk, regulatory obligations and security policies into architecture principles, patterns and technical control requirements in collaboration with Security GRC and accountable control owners.
* Ensure architecture decisions reflect relevant threats, attack paths, systemic risks and lessons from security operations, incidents, assurance activities and vulnerability exposure.
* Advise senior management on strategic security risks, architectural trade-offs, residual risk and major technology decisions.

**Stakeholder leadership and architecture community:**

* Provide enterprise-level architectural authority and coordination for IT, OT, product engineering, business and Corporate Information Security stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with Enterprise Architecture, technology platforms, engineering teams, divisional security functions and relevant governance bodies. Team leadership and performance.
* Lead and manage the Information Security Architecture team, including organizational design, hiring, objectives, performance management, succession and capacity planning.
* Define and report meaningful KPIs and KRIs covering standards adoption, review outcomes, exceptions, technical debt, Security-by-Design effectiveness and target-state maturity.

**Contributing your strengths: your qualifications**
----------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Proven ability to establish Security by Design, architecture governance, standards and target-state architectures.
* Strong leadership and ability to translate business, risk and regulatory requirements into clear architecture decisions and guardrails.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture and security architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and SABSA, and security standards such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443.
* Professional fluency in English is required; German language skills are an advantage.
* Willingness to travel internationally (up to 30%) as required by project work.

Preferred certifications Relevant certifications are advantageous, for example: CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, ITIL, COBIT, and cloud or technology-specific architecture certifications across Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.

title: Director, User Experience Design
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

Levi's is seeking a visionary User Experience Design leader to shape the future of technology across our global retail, e-commerce, and internal platforms. This role sets the UX strategy, champions end-user needs, and partners closely with product, engineering, merchandising, marketing, and brand creative teams. Leading a team of 12 (two group managers and 10 designers), you'll drive design excellence, influence product roadmaps, align senior leaders around innovative ideas, and collaborate across regions and functions. You'll also help redefine how work gets done at Levi's by integrating AI into the design process. This role can be based anywhere in the US and reports to the VP, Product Management & User Experience.

**About the Job**

* Provide the vision to transform user experience across the entire ecosystem of Levi's products and services
* Champion design thinking and UX best practices across the organization
* Set and maintain design quality standards, including critique, design reviews, and the design system, so great work scales across channels and regions
* Tie design work to business results, such as conversion and retention in consumer channels and adoption and productivity in internal tools, and use those measures to set priorities
* AI-immersed, you lead with curiosity and adapt your team's workflow to changing technology
* Lead the design of AI-powered experiences for consumers and associates, including how people understand and come to trust what the AI is doing
* Direct the rapid creation and iteration of ideas through storyboards, user flows, mock-ups, prototypes, and other novel methods
* Develop new experiences and experience paradigms, and produce patterns, training, and resources that help teams build better experiences
* Evolve the use of various inputs to identify customer problems and define new solutions
* Influence and implement big-idea design thinking with VP+ level executives
* Drive a cohesive user experience vision across the tools our teams and partners use every day, from store and associate tools to planning, merchandising, and wholesale
* Understand when to direct the team to skim broadly and when to dive deep into the design of an experience – especially where to draw the line on the MVP
* Recruit, develop, and retain an exceptional, multidisciplinary team of diverse user experience talent, while investing in culture, health, and inclusivity

**About You**

* BA/BS degree in a design-related field such as Interface Design, Interaction Design, HCI, or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of experience in UX or product design roles with an emphasis on global e-commerce and global retail
* 5 years of people management experience
* Experience with AI prototyping and coding tools (e.g., Lovable, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)
* Experience with different channels (web, app, and in-store)
* Experience collaborating across organizational boundaries, domains, and geographies
* Deep understanding of the needs and culture of all creative disciplines that make up a UX team
* Experience working directly with brand and creative teams, in addition to UX
* Compelling and confident storyteller
* A strong eye for design, and critique that makes the work better
* High standards for detail, including the interaction and visual polish customers notice
* A portfolio showing work you led and the business results it drove

*This is a remote role based in the U.S. The expected starting salary range for this role is $148,600 - $245,400 per year****.*** *We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on the location of the role. The amount a particular employee will earn within the salary range will be based on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance and business needs.*

Levi Strauss & Co. (LS&Co.) offers a total rewards package that includes base pay, incentive plans, 401(k) matching, paid leave, health insurance, product discounts, and more designed to help you and your family stay healthy, meet your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. Available benefits and incentive compensation vary depending upon the specifics of the role; details relating to a specific role will be made available upon request. Read more about our benefits here.

LS&Co. is an affirmative action and equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome and value people from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences to make LS&Co. a collective success.

title: Director, Audience Development & Digital Marketing (Parental leave 12 Months FTC)
description:
The Orchard are looking for a highly motivated, forward thinking, Audience Development & Digital Marketing Director to join us on a 12 Month parental leave cover.

You will be responsible for finding unique ways to grow audience data and drive engagement by running effective CRM strategies and engaging fanbases to drive sales and revenue for new releases and catalogue titles across our client roster.

As this a senior role you will be expected to be a strategic thinker in the marketing space and help execute marketing campaigns at a high level across the team.

**As a team we meet in the London office from Monday–Thursday.** ***People may choose to work remotely on Fridays.***

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Work closely with our Marketing Strategists to help lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategies that grow artists' first-party fan audiences across email & SMS
* Serve as the main point of contact for CRM and audience development in the UK office encouraging best practices with The Orchard's internal and 3rd party tools
* Develop scalable acquisition frameworks & benchmarks that can be adapted across artists, genres, & campaign types.
* Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks across acquisition channels, markets, artists and campaign types.
* Build case studies and best-practice guidance that can help scale successful acquisition strategies across the organization.
* Be on hand to help the Marketing Strategists with executing creative and innovative marketing campaigns. You will also be working closely with the Paid Media team to deploy digital advertising campaigns across the main platforms Meta, TikTok, Google, Snapchat and Spotify and more
* Seek out opportunities for artist and label development through internal resources and external tools or services that could enhance campaign efforts. Work with multiple departments and team members to bring innovative marketing activations to life in the digital and real world. Foster fan community relationships to amplify campaign reach and effectiveness
* Be proactive in identifying challenges and providing solutions to keep release campaigns on track. Demonstrate flexibility and a balance of supporting label needs. Be nimble as priorities arise outside of process, be able to move with importance as well as vision

**Who you are:**
----------------

* Minimum of 5 years of audience development, digital marketing, fan acquisition, growth marketing or related experience in the music industry or a similar field.
* Proven track record of successful campaign development, audience growth and execution.
* Passionate about the music business and have a desire to build a career in the industry.
* In-depth understanding of social media platforms and the current platform trends and updates required
* An understanding of digital service provider platforms and how they can be used in digital marketing campaigns to elevate music consumption and discovery
* A strong proficiency in utilizing analytics tools to track and interpret release performance, trends, and metrics.
* Basic Photoshop, HTML and video editing software experience is preferred
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to serve as a key liaison between artists, labels, internal teams, and external clients
* Familiarity with Google Suite and project management software a plus
* Strong project management skills and the ability to handle multiple campaigns simultaneously. A highly organized professional that pays close attention to the details with the ability to multitask and prioritize to tight deadlines.

**What we give you:**
---------------------

* You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
* A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
* Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
* The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
* We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives
* We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There's also time off over winter break
