title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Overview**

Imsi Creative is a boutique, culture-led and conversion-focused marketing agency working across London and Melbourne with hospitality, fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands.

We’re looking for an experienced, commercially minded Head of Marketing to lead our client portfolio, shape marketing strategy and oversee the delivery of paid media, social content and creative campaigns.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable developing a marketing strategy, managing client relationships, directing creative and getting into Meta and Google Ads accounts.

Working closely with the founder, you’ll lead a small team of marketing specialists and contractors, take ownership of client performance and help drive the next stage of the agency’s growth.

**Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Leadership:** Lead marketing strategy across a portfolio of hospitality, lifestyle and consumer brands, identifying opportunities to improve performance, strengthen positioning and drive commercial results.
* **Paid Media:** Oversee Meta and Google Ads campaigns, working closely with our paid media specialist on strategy, budgets, targeting, optimisation and reporting. You’ll bring the technical expertise to confidently manage campaigns yourself when required.
* **Creative & Content:** Set the creative direction for social media and content campaigns, collaborating with our Content and Social Lead, photographers and videographers to deliver compelling, culturally relevant work.
* **Client Management:** Own senior client relationships, lead strategic meetings and ensure activity consistently delivers against business objectives.
* **Team Leadership:** Manage and develop our internal team and external specialists, ensuring priorities, responsibilities and deliverables are clear.
* **Commercial Growth:** Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts, contribute to new business pitches and proposals, and support the continued growth of Imsi Creative.
* **Agency Operations:** Oversee project delivery, reporting, resourcing and account profitability, ensuring the agency operates efficiently and maintains a consistently high standard of work.

**Experience**

**Required**

* 7+ years of marketing experience, ideally within a creative, digital or integrated marketing agency.
* Strong, hands-on experience managing and optimising paid media campaigns across Meta and Google Ads, with a proven understanding of performance metrics and commercial outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute integrated marketing strategies across paid media, organic social and content.
* A strong creative eye and experience directing campaigns, content production and creative teams.
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts, building senior stakeholder relationships and delivering measurable results.
* Experience leading teams, managing contractors and overseeing competing priorities.
* Commercial awareness, with an understanding of agency operations, client retention, budgets and account growth.
* A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to work independently and take ownership.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with hospitality, fashion, lifestyle or consumer brands.
* Previous experience as a Head of Marketing, Senior Account Director, Marketing Director or similar.
* Experience working in a boutique agency or fast-growing business.
* Knowledge of SEO, Google Business Profile and CRM/email marketing.
* Experience developing proposals, pitching for new business and growing client accounts.

**Why Join Imsi Creative?**

You’ll join a growing independent agency with an exciting portfolio of brands, a talented creative team and the opportunity to genuinely shape how the business operates.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of client strategy and delivery, work across a diverse mix of creative and performance marketing projects, and play a meaningful role in the agency’s growth.

We offer a collaborative, flexible working environment, direct access to the founder and a performance-based bonus structure that rewards new business growth.

**Package**

**Salary:** £65,000 per annum  
**Location:** London (hybrid)  
**Contract:** Permanent  
**Bonus:** Performance-based commission on new business revenue

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV alongside two examples of your work: one paid media campaign you’ve personally managed and one creative or content campaign you’ve helped lead.

We’d love to understand your contribution to each project and the results achieved.

Pay: £65,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Marketing: 6 years (required)
* paid advertising: 4 years (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London WC2R 1EA

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**About Ramp**
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
  
  
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
  
  
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
  
  
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
  
  
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
  
  
**About The Role**
Design at Ramp looks very different than it did a year ago: we’re building tools and agents, designing memory, shipping PRs, and rethinking the process every few months as new capabilities unlock. A few things have not changed, the role of design is to distill problems to their essence, obsess over craft and delight where it matters most, know customers deeply and advocate for them, lead with creativity and storytelling, and keep it fun, because a product built with joy always wins.
  
  
We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead a team of builders across some of our highest-priority bets. This role is for you if you’re excited by:
  
  

* Leading through craft, setting vision and unlocking customer impact: you will define where a product should go, then jump into the details with the team to unblock, teach, and ship. You raise the bar through product judgment, design craft, and your ability to make everyone around you better.
* Actually shipping and demonstrating real impact: You'll start by owning a product area and team to build trust and get your bearings at Ramp, with room to take on broader leadership over time. You'll stay close to customers and ship meaningful work alongside your designers, product managers and engineers.
* Building the environment where great work comes from: clear roles, high standards, low ego, and just enough structure to keep the bar high without slowing people down. That means building a caring yet demanding structure, investing deeply in people — coaching, feedback, growth — so designers can do the best work of their careers and develop in this new age of Design.

It’s never been a more interesting time to build.
  
  
***Please note that this role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 3 days/week.***
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Lead and grow a high-performing team of product designers
* Own product vision and design direction across critical product areas
* Partner with product and engineering to shape strategy and deliver customer impact
* Stay close to customers and use their feedback to guide product decisions
* Jump into the work when needed to unblock teams and accelerate progress
* Create clarity, raise quality, and help teams ship faster
* Raise the bar for product thinking, interaction design, systems thinking, and craft
* Coach designers through clear feedback, high standards, and strong mentorship
* Help define how design works in an AI-native world
* Build strong partnerships across product, engineering, data, and design

What You Need
  
  

* Experience leading and developing high-performing product design teams
* Strong product judgment, design craft, and systems thinking
* Track record of shipping products with meaningful customer and business impact
* Deep customer empathy and comfort operating in ambiguity
* Ability to influence across functions and develop exceptional talent
* Curiosity that borders obsession over how AI changes the nature software and how we work

Nice to Haves
  
  

* Founder or early-stage startup experience
* Experience designing AI-native, automation, or agentic systems
* Experience building workflow or operations tooling
* Experience leading managers or multi-layered teams
* Comfort working closely with technical teams on implementation details

**Benefits Available To All Full-time Ramp Employees (Global)**

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**

* 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
**Role Objective**
**AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.**
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
* Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
* Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
* High-Tempo Work Ethic (60+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 60+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
* Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
* AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.

**Working Hours & Culture**

* Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
* Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.

**How To Apply & What To Expect**
At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Director of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Director of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. This is not a traditional Director of Creative role. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.
* You make sound engineering decisions while balancing safety, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and operational impact.
* You can make informed recommendations when technical information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
* You identify design and execution risks early and develop practical solutions before they affect project or operational outcomes.
* You communicate complex engineering issues clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leadership.
* You build alignment across Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and external partners.
* You establish standards and governance that improve consistency without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.
* You use field experience, data, root cause analysis, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
* You develop internal talent while holding consultants, contractors, and other external resources accountable for quality and results.
* You are comfortable spending time in the field to understand problems firsthand and validate solutions.
* You demonstrate the judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership expected under Switch's Culture Codes.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive engineering experience supporting industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities such as data centers, power generation, or oil and gas facilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical professionals, consultants, or comparable resources.
* 4+ years of project management experience supporting data center engineering or comparable mission-critical infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in mission-critical environments, including power distribution, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, cooling systems, HVAC, controls, and fire protection.
* Experience leading or supporting construction, commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, retrofit, or infrastructure improvement activities.
* Experience managing engineering projects, consultants, contractors, and other external technical resources.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, and MEP documentation.
* Experience with EPMS, SCADA, BMS, or comparable monitoring and controls systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety requirements and applicable OSHA standards for multi-megawatt or mission-critical facilities.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute solutions for complex engineering and operational problems.
* Strong project and program management, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience using engineering, project management, calculation, data analysis, and collaboration tools.
* Ability to support after-hours or weekend activities when required for critical projects, maintenance windows, commissioning, or operational events.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer registration or other relevant professional engineering certification.
* Experience leading enterprise or multi-region engineering programs within data centers or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience establishing engineering governance, technical standards, design-change processes, or post-IFC execution frameworks.
* Experience supporting root cause analysis, fleet optimization, lifecycle management, and infrastructure reliability programs.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Why Switch?**

* A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
* Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.
* Flexibility & Remote Opportunities – Whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive.
* Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.
* Generous Benefits Package - Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more!

### **Join Us & Make a Difference**

This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you.

Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together.

  

**Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice**  
Your privacy rights may vary by location. Learn more in our Switch Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.switch.com/applicant-and-candidate-privacy/ to understand how Switch collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information during the recruiting process.

**Safe Hiring Notice**  
Legitimate Switch recruiting emails come from switch.com. Current opportunities are posted on https://switch.com/careers and the official Switch LinkedIn Company page https://www.linkedin.com/company/switch-data-centers/. Switch will never ask you to pay fees, purchase equipment, send money, cash a check, or transfer funds as part of recruiting. Personal information is collected only through approved Switch systems.

If you suspect recruiting fraud, stop communicating with the sender and review FTC guidance https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/what-do-if-you-were-scammed.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  
Switch is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Accommodations**  
Switch provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If you need an accommodation, contact careers@switch.com.

Switch also considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable law.

**Recruitment Agencies**  
Switch does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies without a current written agreement. Switch is not responsible for fees related to unsolicited submissions.

title: 21GRAMS- Director, Product Design (UI)
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

**21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary, is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human.** Not just in our work, but in how we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. We believe in being good to each other and hard on the work, and in creating work that makes a meaningful difference for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and brands.

#### **Job Summary**

The Director, Product Design is a senior design leader responsible for setting the product design vision, raising the quality of the work, and building the conditions for teams to deliver cohesive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. This role leads complex engagements across websites, platforms, products, services, and connected ecosystems, translating user needs, brand strategy, business goals, technology constraints, and healthcare requirements into clear experience direction.

This is not solely an execution role. The Director is accountable for design strategy, client leadership, team development, resourcing, design operations, and measurable experience outcomes. They remain close enough to the work to guide critical decisions, facilitate discovery, critique design, and step into high-impact moments while enabling senior designers to lead day to day.

#### **What You Will Do**

**Design Vision and Product Strategy**

* Own the product design vision and experience strategy across a portfolio of complex client engagements, connecting user needs, brand intent, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Partner with Experience Strategy, UX, Product Management, Creative, Technology, Data, Medical, Strategy, and Account leadership to frame opportunities, define roadmaps, and establish measurable outcomes.
* Lead discovery and definition activities, including stakeholder alignment, experience principles, journey framing, service blueprints, value propositions, prioritization, and product or platform planning.
* Identify opportunities that extend beyond the immediate brief and turn them into clear, decision-ready recommendations for clients and agency leadership.

**Design Excellence and Delivery**

* Set and uphold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, responsive behavior, content hierarchy, prototyping, motion, and end-to-end experience coherence.
* Guide teams from early concepts through detailed design, validation, launch, and optimization, ensuring that strategic intent is maintained through implementation.
* Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
* Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.
* Use qualitative research, analytics, usability findings, and business measures to evaluate design decisions and recommend iteration.

**Client and Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
* Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

**People Leadership and Practice Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
* Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
* Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
* Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

* Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
* Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
* Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
* Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
* The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
* Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

#### **What You Should Have**

* 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
* A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
* Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
* Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
* Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

#### **This Position Is a Strong Fit If**

* You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
* You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
* You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
* You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
* Our Company values – *Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always* and *Accountability with an “I”* – really speak to you.
* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
* You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient support, medical technology, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
* Experience supporting business development, scoping, estimating, and presenting capabilities or pitch work.
* Experience leading enterprise websites, authenticated platforms, service ecosystems, omnichannel programs, or AI-enabled experiences.

  

**Pay Range:** $140,000 - $155,000  
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. title: Director, Brand & Creative Marketing
description:
As a Director of Brand & Creative Marketing, will own the evolution of MongoDB's global brand identity and creative expression. MongoDB isn't just about logos or design systems—it's about driving real business outcomes, translating our complex technical offerings into stories and experiences, and fostering pride and loyalty among all audiences. This is your chance to shape the creative future of one of the fastest-growing enterprise companies in the world.

You will lead and influence all aspects of MongoDB's brand visual expression. You are an articulate champion for design, passionate about quality and craft, and an experienced leader of diverse teams who can elevate ambitious work while delivering outstanding business results. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Marketing, you will work with peer leaders in Marketing and Product to transform the MongoDB brand to drive mindshare and market share with developer and executive audiences.

You are responsible for leading a team of creative professionals and collaborating with marketing, product, and sales to develop marketing plans, analyze results, and identify opportunities. You are also responsible for meeting budget requirements by forecasting and managing expectations.

### **What you'll do:**

Strategic Impact & Vision

* Develop and articulate a bold, clear, and compelling brand strategy that enhances MongoDB's market differentiation, emotional resonance, and business impact with audiences ranging from developers to senior executives
* Translate MongoDB's business priorities into powerful creative concepts and brand campaigns. Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to craft ideas that move both our brand and the business forward
* Identify and resolve strategic challenges by innovating bold, creative solutions that drive transformation and brand loyalty
* Establish operational goals and metrics to measure awareness, emotional resonance, loyalty, and business outcomes—and implement mechanisms to continuously optimize MongoDB's brand performance globally

Creative Leadership & Brand Development

* Push the boundaries of our brand expression—from timeless visual systems to innovative campaigns—delivering emotional, human-centered work while staying connected to MongoDB's technical roots
* Lead narrative-driven storytelling across a variety of mediums (digital, video, events, product experiences, swag, etc.). Make technical complexity feel engaging, empowering, and relatable
* Stay ahead of emerging creative technologies, including AI, generative design, motion, and interactive storytelling. Leverage these tools not just for efficiency, but to unlock bold, new creative possibilities
* Build for digital-first experiences across platforms. Think intuitively about feeds, formats, and moments, creating a brand presence designed for today's fast-moving, online world
* Lead the refresh of our brand foundation and visual identity, ensuring MongoDB's design system is distinct, scalable, and future-ready

Team Leadership & Collaboration

* Recruit, mentor, and inspire a multidisciplinary creative team of designers, content creators, illustrators, and more, fostering a culture of excellence and inclusion where bold ideas thrive
* Champion a culture of creativity and collaboration, driving strong concept development, attention to craft, and team cohesion
* Build partnerships across Product, Marketing, Employee Experience, and Corporate Communications to ensure brand consistency and cohesion across all touchpoints
* Serve as a key brand ambassador internally and externally, confidently articulating MongoDB's brand vision to executives, employees, and the wider ecosystem

Executional Excellence

* Deliver scalable, high-impact creative campaigns and brand experiences that resonate with developers and executive audiences alike
* Manage resources, timelines, and budgets with strategic efficiency that maximizes ROI while ensuring quality and innovation across projects
* Set a high bar for creative output, inspiring teams to raise the standard for storytelling, emotional connection, and visual expression at MongoDB
* Experiment boldly across digital, live events, swag, and interactive environments to create unforgettable experiences that make "using MongoDB" synonymous with belonging to something bigger

### **What you'll bring to the table:**

* Elevate our storytelling in product and company narratives through clear and compelling visual designs and elements
* Develop and articulate a compelling design vision and operational strategy aligned with MongoDB's goals
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative work with business objectives and achieve pull-through across brands' platforms. This includes centralizing brand information, guidelines, collaboration tools, and digital asset management to ensure consistent brand communication
* Present design concepts and strategies to senior leadership, influencing decisions and direction. Through regular reviews and meetings, ensure clarity and consistent workflow
* Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project buy-in and execution
* Track industry trends and best practices, bringing innovative ideas back into MongoDB

 **Job Description**

**Team and Role**

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with Engineering and Product Management from the outset.

This is a product-focused creative leadership role. You will work as part of cross-functional software development teams and partner across Platform and the business units to connect creative vision with customer needs, product strategy, and technical realities. Product teams retain ownership of their product strategy, design, roadmap, quality, and delivery; this role provides shared visual direction, systems, critique, and enablement.

You will also advance the responsible use of AI in creative work and make accessibility intrinsic to the product visual language.

**What you get to do in this role**

* Define and champion a differentiated visual direction for the product portfolio, grounded in our brand, customer needs, product strategy, and the evolving relationship between people and AI.
* Establish a clear point of view across typography, color, composition, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, density, and other visual foundations.
* Create future-state concepts, reference experiences, and exemplars that make the visual direction tangible.

* Lead, develop, and attract exceptional visual, motion, and multidisciplinary design talent.
* Build the culture, enablement, and shared critique practices that help product designers and distributed visual designers understand, apply, and continually raise the visual craft bar.
* Build a network of creative leaders and contributors across the business units who can extend the direction while maintaining coherence.

* 12+ years of experience in product design, visual design, experience design, creative direction, or a related field, including significant leadership experience shipping complex digital products.

* Experience defining or materially evolving a visual language across a complex, multi-product software portfolio.
* Deep understanding of design systems, including visual foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, governance, contribution models, and the relationship between design and code.
* Demonstrated experience adopting AI-enabled creative tools and workflows and moving teams from isolated experimentation to sustained, responsible use at scale.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and align multiple organizations without relying solely on reporting authority.

* Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect an inspiring creative idea to the practices and adoption mechanisms required to make it real at scale.
* Demonstrated commitment to accessible and inclusive design, with working knowledge of WCAG and platform accessibility considerations.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, and critique skills, including the ability to make a direction compelling to executives and actionable for delivery teams.
* Experience leading leaders and building high-performing, inclusive creative teams.

title: Director, Recruitment & Admissions
description:
**ABOUT PER SCHOLAS:**

For 30 years, Per Scholas has been on a mission to drive mobility and opportunity in the ever-advancing technology landscape by unlocking the untapped potential of individuals, uplifting communities, and meeting the needs of employers through rigorous tech training. By teaming up with dynamic employer partners, ranging from Fortune 500 companies to innovative startups, we're forging inclusive tech talent pipelines, fulfilling an ever-increasing need for skilled talent. With national remote training and campuses in 20+ cities and counting, Per Scholas offers no-cost training programs in the most sought-after tech skills, spanning Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, IT Support, Software Engineering, and more. To date, 30,000+ individuals have been trained through Per Scholas, propelling their professional trajectories into high-growth tech careers with salaries three times higher than their pre-training earnings. Learn more by visiting PerScholas.org and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

**Per Scholas candidates must reside in one of the following states, provided the position does not carry a specific office location requirement:** AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, MA, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, WA, WI.

**Position Title:** Director, National Recruitment (Digital Strategy and Applicant Experience)

**Reports To:** VP, National Recruitment, Applicant Process and Tech Integration

**Location:** National / Remote

  

**Role Summary**

Per Scholas is seeking a Director to lead our Digital Strategy and Applicant Experience team and serve as a key architect of our national recruitment and admissions model. Reporting to the VP, National Recruitment, Applicant Process and Tech Integration, the Director will help translate enrollment goals and organizational priorities into a digital strategy, operating model, and execution roadmap. You will lead, coach, and grow a dedicated team across content, web, and applicant support, and manage the learner's digital journey, from first ad impression through enrollment - centralizing work to streamline processes while simultaneously increasing conversion. This role is a force multiplier; you will support moving the recruitment and applicant process to a more scalable, tech-enabled model. You will drive the strategy for paid media, web presence, content governance, and digital support operations, ensuring our ecosystem is high-performing, consistent, and efficient. The Director will partner closely with MarComms on brand, enterprise messaging, and creative standards; with IT on technical architecture, integrations, security, and deployment; with campus leaders on local implementation and adoption; and with external agencies to execute priorities. Within approved priorities and budgets, the Director will independently establish strategy, make operating decisions, and remain accountable for performance, consistency, and continuous improvement across the recruitment and admissions funnel.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Paid Media & Campaign Strategy**

* Strategic Direction: Own end-to-end campaign planning and creative direction, ensuring digital media spend is optimized toward high-converting initiatives.
* Efficiency & Performance: Monitor performance targets, and reallocate investment and recommend corrective action based on performance.
* Agency and Campaign Leadership: Direct internal contributors and external agencies responsible for campaign execution, media buying, and creative production. Own briefs, review cycles, quality standards, and performance management.
* Capacity Building: Build repeatable campaign processes that support changing course offerings, enrollment priorities, and an expanding market footprint without sacrificing speed, quality, or measurement.

**Learner-Facing Website & Conversion**

* Conversion & UX Ownership: Direct strategy for conversion optimization and user experience (UX) to ensure our digital front door drives enrollment.
* Experimentation: Lead testing of landing pages, copy, forms, and other key conversion points, documenting results and incorporating successful practices into national standards.
* Course Launch Governance: Establish clear responsibilities, service levels, and review cycles for course launches and updates across National Recruitment and Admissions, in partnership with campuses, product, MarComms, IT, and external partners.

**Digital Learner Journey & Process Design**

* End-to-End Journey: Oversee the national applicant experience across paid media, the website, application, email, SMS, and applicant support channels, including forms, automation logic, segmentation, lead routing, timing, and escalation paths.
* Content Production: Lead the creation, deployment, and ongoing optimization of recruitment-specific email and SMS copy, templates, landing pages, forms, FAQs, scripts, and automated sequences. Ensure work aligns with MarComms brand and messaging standards.
* Quality Assurance: Establish testing, approval, monitoring, and quality-assurance practices that ensure communications are accurate, coordinated, accessible, and delivered as intended.
* Funnel Improvement: Identify friction, abandonment, and communication gaps across the recruitment and admissions funnel and lead cross-functional improvements that increase conversion and strengthen the applicant experience.
* Innovation: Evaluate and implement appropriate technology and automation that make the recruitment and admissions experience more scalable, responsive, and effective.

**Content Governance & Lifecycle Management**

* Standardization: Own the standards, review cycles, and approval workflows for all digital applicant-facing content.
* Accessibility & Quality: Ensure recruitment content meets accessibility, brand, legal, and compliance requirements, as well as defined performance benchmarks.
* Digital Inventory: Maintain a centralized inventory of recruitment and admissions digital assets, including owners, approval status, performance, and scheduled review dates

**Team Leadership & Resource Management**

* Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop Digital Strategy & Applicant Experience team, with clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Manage agencies and vendors: Manage relationship, deliverables, performance and coordination with internal teams for external digital marketing and applicant journey vendors.
* Cross Functional Partnership: Work collaboratively with stakeholders across multiple functions and levels within the organization.

**Applicant Support Operations**

* Service Standards: Oversee national support channels and build a unified operation with clear service standards, replacing fragmented inbox-based work.
* AI Integration: Deploy AI-driven solutions, including website chatbots, to resolve routine inquiries and free staff for high-touch applicant work.
* Escalation Management: Own resolution paths for complex applicant and technical issues so they don't route back to campuses or leadership

  

**What You'll Bring**

* Leadership & Coaching: Proven experience leading and mentoring a team, providing direct coaching, and managing service standards across distributed or national operations.
* Strategic Operations: Proven track record of auditing and designing workflows that remove administrative burden and create operational efficiencies.
* Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of digital systems, including web CMS, automation platforms (email/SMS/Hubspot), and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).
* Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in using performance data (conversion metrics, campaign ROI, funnel analytics) to inform strategy and make real-time, high-stakes decisions.
* Paid Media and Growth Marketing: Demonstrated experience leading paid-media strategy, budget allocation, channel and campaign analysis, structured experimentation, conversion optimization, and ROI-based decision-making.
* Content and Journey Operations: Experience leading the creation and governance of multichannel content and automated customer or applicant journeys, including email, SMS, web, and forms.

  

**Compensation**

For this role specifically, we are targeting a salary range of **$90,000–$100,000,** where the difference in salary is typically determined by several factors, including geography in which the selected candidate resides and alignment with qualifications and experience.

**Benefits & Perks**

Per Scholas offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and overall quality of life!

**Holidays & PTO:** Full-TimePer Scholas team members enjoy **over 40 days** of paid time off each year through a mix of holidays, vacation, and sick/personal time! All employees are eligible for Holiday pay upon hire (a total of 22 holidays annually, including **a week off for Independence day** and **a week before the New Year**). Full-Time Benefits Eligible employees also receive 80 Wellness Hours to use for Sick, Safe, or Personal reasons and accrue Vacation at a rate of 8 hours at the beginning of every month, supporting rest, recharge, and work-life balance. Vacation accruals increase with tenure. Part-time employees are afforded time off on a prorated basis and in accordance with local requirements.

**Comprehensive Medical Coverage**: Benefit eligible employees can choose from multiple medical plans through Cigna or Kaiser Permanente (where available), with options to fit your needs. Eligible employees also have access to a Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) that reimburses eligible out-of-pocket expenses, up to $4,000 for individuals and $8,000 for families.

**Dental and Vision Insurance**: Eligible employees can select from two dental plan options and a vision plan. Employees who waive medical coverage receive employer paid dental and vision premiums.

**Retirement Savings:** 401(k) plan with a current 100% employer match on contributions up to 6%, eligible employees are offered entry and full vesting after 90 days with the company.

**Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**: Free, confidential, 24/7 access to counseling, legal support, and financial resources for employees and their household members

**Parental Leave:** Eligible employees are offered up to 6 weeks of 100% paid parental leave to support employees as they welcome a new child and bond with their family.

**Additional Benefits & Perks:** Eligible employees have access to employer-paid life and AD&D Insurance, as well as employer-paid short-term disability coverage, with the option to elect additional life coverage and long-term disability insurance. Flexible Spending accounts are available for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting expenses. Per Scholas also offers a range of voluntary benefits, including: Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Services, and Pet Insurance. Additional resources include healthcare concierge support, financial wellness tools, and employee discount programs.

**QUESTIONS?**

If you have any questions about this role, please feel free to email our Talent team at jobs@perscholas.org. We look forward to viewing your application!

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

title: 2026 Managing Director
description:
**Who we are:**

United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to support, engage, and empower them to make their voices heard and win!

With an online reach of over 5 million every month, more than 1,000,000 members as well as 4 statewide branches and local groups across 28 states. UWD is made up of fearless young people fighting to improve the lives of our members and their families. Our vision is a society which celebrates our diversity and believes in a multi-ethnic, intersectional path to getting there. Over 60% of our members are womxn and 30% identify as LGBTQ.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Our grassroots-driven approach has a proven record of success and we’re looking for talented folks to join our team!

Learn more about United We Dream by visiting www.unitedwedream.org.

**Position Summary**

United We Dream is seeking a new senior leader and organization-builder to serve in the role of Managing Director. In partnership with the Executive Director, the Managing Director will develop and drive an organizational strategy to maximize UWD’s assets including its people power, brand, as well as financial and operational resources, to build the power necessary to change the lives of our members, leaders and communities.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, insightful, and mission-driven leader who thrives on creating and managing systems and community in service to an organization’s mission. As the primary thought partner to the Executive Director (ED), the Managing Director translates the organization’s vision into seamless, cohesive execution across five core pillars: 1) long-term organizational strategic vision; 2) financial sustainability & growth strategy; 3) operations strategy responsive to the needs of a fast-paced community power building infrastructure; 4) organizational security and compliance strategy; and 5) organizational structure and culture that successfully drives organizational priorities.

This position works with all members of the internal leadership, including leading the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team, and will coordinate internal processes across departments to cultivate and maintain an effective team, a commitment to excellence, and healthy organizational culture.

A successful candidate will be passionate about UWD’s mission and be highly motivated to work in a fast-growing, front-line, history-making organization. They must be committed to leadership development, power building, and building collaborative structures which make the most of a highly talented staff team.

This is a full-time exempt position. Much day-to-day work will be handled remotely, but travel (local, nation-wide, international) is expected for approximately 30-40% of the time. Applicants working in the eastern time zone are preferred but not required. Multilingual communication skills are a plus though not required.

**Primary Responsibilities**

### **Long-Term Organizational Strategy & Leadership Alignment**

* Strategic Thought Partner: Serves as thought partner to the Executive Director on all aspects of organizational strategy including programs, internal operations and team management, growth, and brand.
* Strategic Planning: Lead the development, rollout, and regular evaluation of the multi-year organizational strategic vision in partnership with the Executive Director, Senior Leadership Team, and Board of Directors.
* Execution & Accountability: Lead the Executive Team, the Senior Leadership Team, and the Staff through annual goal setting, translating the organization’s long-term vision into ambitious but realizable organizational goals that build year after year
  + Works with the Senior Leadership Team to arrive at Department-Level goals that will implement the organizational goals
  + Leads periodic stepbacks with the SLT and the Staff to assess progress made on goals as well as any changes that need to be made
* Internal Leadership:

* Provides day-to-day management of the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team and ensures that the teams are high functioning, collaborative and effective leadership bodies.
  + Lead ET and SLT meetings and stepback spaces
* Oversees planning and execution of all-staff and all-leadership gatherings and retreats.
* Staffs the Executive Director in internal settings or speaks on their behalf in internal settings when required.
* Serves as the chief of internal communications, crafting and/or approving internal communications materials related to United We Dream’s organizational effectiveness.
* Supports the Executive Director to ensure the achievement of key internal culture and operations goals.
* Board Management:
  + Work with the Executive Director and Co-Chairs of the Board to lead board meetings and relevant board committee meetings
  + Prepare high-level briefings and strategic board materials
  + Facilitate alignment at Executive Committee meetings.
* Special Projects: Direct priority high-stakes or rapid-response projects and incubates initiatives from concept to handoff or implementation.

### **Financial Sustainability & Growth Strategy**

* Supervise the Senior Director of Finance and Development
* Revenue Strategy Collaboration: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to strategize around and execute long-term revenue diversification strategies, including major gifts, institutional funding, earn-income models, and rapid-response campaign fundraising.
* Resource Allocation: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to ensure strategic priorities are directly linked to annual budgeting and financial forecasting analysis, optimizing resource allocation for maximum programmatic impact.
* Capital & Reserve Management: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to oversee financial sustainability and growth metrics, long-term reserve and investments planning, and fiscal decision-making models to weather potential political or economic shifts.

### **Operational Strategy & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Supervise the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems.
* Oversee the contract relationship with our operations partner Seed the Dream, and create staff and consultant support systems as needed.
* Change Management:
  + Lead major organizational change initiatives or organizational redesigns
  + Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to lead culture-building endeavors that promote courage, rigor, community, resilience, and high performance.
* Inter-Departmental Collaboration:
  + Serve as the central, high-level oversight ensuring effective coordination between all parts of the organization – the Membership and Campaigns Department, Narrative Department, Development Department, Finance Department, and the Data and Operations Department.
* Movement-Values Aligned & Effective Operations:
  + Oversees the Operations partner to ensure the complete, seamless, and values-aligned operational apparatus and set-up for programs, activities, tactics, etc.
  + Oversees the Operations partner to ensure the complete, seamless, and values-aligned planning and execution of in-person events or actions, including large scale ones with multiple external participants and partners.

### **Security, Risk Mitigation & Compliance**

* Holistic Organizational Strategy:
  + Anticipate and monitor changes in legal, regulatory and administrative environments
    - Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to devise plans to implement changes in organizational policies/procedures as needed to maintain compliance.
    - Partner with the Adviser on Special Projects and the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to strategize about legal risks to the organization and bring in necessary counsel
    - Partner with the Narrative Director to assess any additions to external communications strategy
  + Anticipate and monitor our organizational security needs across all aspects (physical, digital, data, reputational, etc.) and and partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to devise plans for improvements necessary to support the growth of specific programs and UWD overall;
* Legal Compliance: Ensure complete compliance across nonprofit regulatory frameworks (including 501(c)(3) / 501(c)(4) advocacy and lobbying rules, charitable registrations, etc.), maintaining proactive legal and reputational risk management policies and systems.
* Crisis Management: Develop and maintain rapid-response crisis plans, leading incident response teams during political retaliation, legal challenges, security breaches, or public relations crises.

**Organizational Leadership**

* Strengthen the culture: Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to ensure a safe, welcoming, and inspiring organizational culture for staff to excel in. Role model and uphold UWD’s values of creating a courageous, rigorous, and community-oriented working environment.
  + Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems and with the Operations partner to develop, revise, and uphold organization policies and standards, ensuring that organizational policies are in line with the organization’s guiding principles as well as relevant compliance regulations and concerns.
* Support fundraising:Collaborate with the Executive Director and Development Department team in developing and executing a forward-thinking fundraising strategy for organizational priorities.
* Demonstrate embodied leadership:Prioritize taking care of your physical and emotional health as a key component of thriving in your role. Practice self-care behaviors in ways that work best for you and proactively encourage your staff to prioritize self-care as well. Project trust & confidence in your abilities and skills and recognize the achievements and abilities of others
* Manage organizational change:As the organization undergoes continued growth and innovation, the Managing Director will manage organizational change in a way that inspires and activates the Board, staff, members and community.

**Desired Qualifications and Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in the progressive, non-profit or movement space with a well rounded background across organizational departments.
* Well developed emotional intelligence and communication skills, is able to build trusting relationships with a wide array of individuals
* A critical thinker and a capable, flexible, curious generalist.
* Demonstrated experience in successfully developing and executing major, large-scale project plans involving many moving pieces and collaborators.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an ability to understand a wide range of audiences and interests.
* Demonstrated experience in building staff teams, management, coaching and leadership development.
* The ability to build strong relationships internal to the organization and external for the organization
* Experience with seeing the long vision of an organization while understanding the importance of accomplishing short and medium term objectives.
* Experience with being able to conceptualize and approach problems and solutions in a proactive, constructive, and innovative manner that will result in improved performance across the organization.
* Strong follow through with principals and with organizers.
* A passion for the mission: We believe that those closest to the pain are the closest to the solutions, therefore a successful candidate must be “all in” on UWD being an immigrant youth-led organization

**Interpersonal Skills**

* An exceptional team player; exemplifies a work style that is committed to the excellence that our members and team deserve while being flexible, respectful, collaborative and nimble;
* Can build trust, confidence, and leadership among a diverse range of staff, fellow, partner organizations - across race, gender, and other identities

**Cultural Competency**

* Strong understanding of the immigrant experience, preferably with lived experience as an undocumented person, immigrant, or immigrant family
* Understanding of race, gender, sexuality and other aspects of identity, and their intersections, and how that plays out in the work. Experience building strong relationships and trust across race, gender, class, and other group identities, both internally and externally
* Brings an anti-racist lens to their work and understands the role that white-supremacy and anti-Blackness play in the environments in which we operate
