title: Marketing Director
description:
Excellent creative work can help extraordinary organizations raise more and serve more. Unseen is looking for a Marketing Director who knows what great looks like, can explain why it works, and can bring together the people who make it happen.

You will own Unseen's brand, voice, marketing strategy, and creative standard. You will lead an outside agency through a brand rebuild, turn that work into a focused annual marketing plan, and direct major projects for selected Unseen partners.

You will turn complex information into compelling ideas that capture attention, build belief, and motivate action. You will set creative direction and hold teams accountable for quality.

Creating amazing products and campaigns is the floor. Activating people to invest in anti trafficking work is the job.

About Unseen

Unseen accelerates the fight against human trafficking and its root causes. We equip anti-trafficking organizations around the world with marketing, fundraising, and storytelling tools, and we deliver strategic grants that fund their most critical projects.

Since 2011, Unseen has worked with 94 partner organizations in 66 countries. Those partners have raised more than $119 million and served more than 1.3 million people.

We are entering a new chapter and investing in the leadership and creative work to support it.

The opportunity

This is a role for someone whose strength is creative judgment and leadership. You can recognize an exceptional idea, write a clear brief, give specific feedback, and push work further. You know how to recruit talented people and hold them to a high standard.

You will have direct access to Unseen's leadership, room to challenge assumptions, and the opportunity to shape work with lasting consequences. We want someone who can push back on the CEO's preferences, support their recommendations, and earn trust through their decisions.

You will lead through strategy, direction, and accountability, not by personally producing every asset. A social media specialist will activate the social strategy, and a production manager and production team will manage the execution of creative projects. You will guide the standard of work, help identify outside talent, and collaborate with the people responsible for daily delivery.

What you will lead

Brand and voice. Serve as the primary day-to-day client for an outside brand agency, guide the rebuild, and establish standards the team can consistently apply.

Marketing strategy. Build and execute an annual plan with clear audiences, priorities, budgets, responsibilities, and measures of success. Define how marketing builds awareness and trust, motivates engagement, and supports measurable growth.

Visibility and credibility. Build Unseen's visibility and credibility among priority donors and businesses, activating established relationships and advocates in selected markets.

Fundraising communications. Set the strategy and creative direction for campaigns, stories, and materials that support philanthropic strategy, major gifts, Guardian Business expansion, and a major capital initiative.

Partner projects. Lead strategic and creative oversight for substantial marketing and storytelling assignments for selected Unseen partners, with scope and delivery commitments established through the annual plan.

Creative talent. Identify, evaluate, recruit, and brief excellent agencies, freelancers, and other creative specialists.

Quality and accountability. Set creative standards, provide decisive feedback, and remain accountable for the quality and strategic effectiveness of work delivered by staff, production teams, agencies, and contractors without directly managing every task.

Practical AI adoption. Champion thoughtful AI use in research, creative development, workflows, and production, while protecting accuracy, privacy, and storytelling integrity.

Our philanthropic leadership owns fundraising strategy, donor relationships, and asks. Our Guardian Business lead owns that program's expansion. You will be their marketing partner, responsible for work that helps them succeed.

What you bring

* Exceptional creative judgment across storytelling, copy, design, photography, video, and campaigns.
* Demonstrated ability to turn complex information into persuasive creative concepts using audience psychology, narrative tension, message hierarchy, and clear calls to action.
* A track record of developing campaigns that produce measurable results, including fundraising outcomes, with an honest account of your strategy, decisions, contribution, and results.
* Experience selecting, briefing, directing, and evaluating outside agencies and creative specialists, including providing clear feedback and knowing when to change course.
* The ability to recruit strong creative talent beyond your existing contacts.
* Clear, constructive leadership that makes other people's work better.
* Strong execution skills, including setting priorities, managing budgets, and delivering on commitments through teams.
* Resourcefulness within a limited budget, with the judgment to surface tradeoffs early and recommend solutions.
* Practical fluency with AI tools and the ability to lead adoption collaboratively.
* Respect for ethical, survivor-centered storytelling that protects dignity, informed consent, privacy, and personal agency.

An established network of creative professionals, agencies, media contacts, or business partners is a plus. Experience in anti-trafficking work is welcome but not required.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

* Launch Unseen's brand rebuild and establish a consistent voice and creative standard.
* Build and execute a focused annual marketing plan with defined audiences, engagement goals, and performance measures.
* Provide creative direction and quality oversight for priority campaigns and partner projects delivered by the responsible teams against agreed goals, schedules, and budgets.
* Equip our fundraising and Guardian Business teams with compelling, useful materials and evaluate how those materials support engagement and growth.
* Build a dependable bench of creative specialists and strong working relationships with production leadership.
* Improve how we evaluate creative quality, audience response, campaign performance, and team delivery.

We will establish specific milestones together based on organizational priorities and available resources.

Working at Unseen

You will report to the COO and work closely with the CEO on brand direction and creative standards. Within approved organizational priorities and brand strategy, you will lead creative recommendations and day-to-day marketing decisions.

Our team works remotely across multiple locations. This role requires regular overlap with Central Time business hours and travel for selected events. Two team meetups per year are encouraged.

The salary range is $75,000 to $95,000, depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities.

You will have flexibility, meaningful creative responsibility, access to global partners and powerful stories of hope, and the opportunity to help organizations change lives for generations.

How to apply

Please submit your resume or professional background, plus:

1. Two examples of campaigns or major creative projects you led. Include the objective, your role, the team or agency involved, approximate budget, and results. At least one should demonstrate fundraising impact.

2. A short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what you would bring to Unseen.

3. An intro video highlighting who you are and what makes you the best fit to join this team.

Links, existing case studies, and concise summaries are welcome. You may anonymize confidential information. We are interested in the quality of your judgment and contribution, not the polish of your application.

Candidates who advance will discuss their work with our leadership team and participate in a focused creative leadership exercise.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Please share two examples of campaigns or major creative projects you led. Include the objective, your role, the team or agency involved, approximate budget, and results. At least one should demonstrate fundraising impact. Links or concise summaries are welcome.
* Please write a short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what you would bring to Unseen.
* Please include a link to a short intro video highlighting who you are and what makes you the best fit for this team.

description:

**Position:** State Chapter Lead

**Compensation:** $1,500/month

**Time Commitment:** Approximately 10 hours per week

**Reports To:** Hailey Coates, Director of Strategic Expansion

**About Love Your School**

Love Your School is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to helping families understand and access the education options available to their children. We believe parents know their children best and should have access to educational opportunities that meet their child’s unique needs.

Through parent support, education, community engagement, and advocacy, Love Your School works to advance and protect education freedom while helping families navigate school choice programs and policies.

As Love Your School expands into additional states, State Chapter Leads will play an important role in bringing our mission to families in their home state.

**Position Overview**

The State Chapter Lead serves as the primary leader and representative of Love Your School within their state. This individual will launch and grow a state chapter focused on supporting families, building strong community relationships, and advancing and protecting school choice policies.

The State Chapter Lead will identify and bring together 2–3 additional individuals who share Love Your School’s mission and can serve alongside them as the chapter’s initial Executive Team.

This is an entrepreneurial, community-facing role for someone who is naturally welcoming, highly relational, mission-driven, and excited to build something from the ground up while working within the mission, structure, and brand of Love Your School.

**Key Responsibilities**

Provide direct parent support by helping families understand and navigate education options, including ESAs, open enrollment, charter schools, homeschooling, scholarship programs, and special education resources.

Run a state-specific Love Your School podcast, including identifying relevant topics and guests and hosting conversations that educate and engage families.

Manage and grow the state’s Love Your School Facebook group, sharing resources and updates, answering parent questions, and building an engaged community of families.

Participate in community events, including parent gatherings, school events, conferences, tabling opportunities, webinars, and other outreach activities.

Build strong, professional relationships with parents, schools, community organizations, education leaders, and other partners throughout the state.

Recruit and lead 2–3 additional individuals to serve as the chapter’s Executive Team and help carry out chapter activities and goals.

Educate and engage families around school choice policies and help advance and protect education freedom in alignment with Love Your School’s mission and 501(c)(3) guidelines.

Complete and participate in Love Your School’s Education Navigator Training to become equipped in education freedom, parent support, and special education advocacy.

Work closely with the Love Your School national team to meet chapter goals, share parent needs and trends, and maintain consistent Love Your School messaging, branding, and standards.

**What We Are Looking For**

The strongest State Chapter Leads are individuals who are:

* Warm and relationship-oriented. You naturally make people feel welcome and build trust quickly while collaborating with parents, schools, and community leaders.
* Respected community leaders. You demonstrate wisdom, confidence, good judgment, and professionalism.
* Strong communicators. You can write clearly, speak confidently, and communicate about challenging issues without becoming hostile or overly political.
* Mission-driven. You care deeply about helping families access educational opportunities that meet their children’s needs.
* Entrepreneurial. You are comfortable building something new, solving problems, and taking initiative without needing constant direction.
* Organized and dependable. You follow through on commitments and can manage multiple projects, relationships, and responsibilities.
* Comfortable with digital communities. You can manage a Facebook community, communicate with parents online, and help maintain an engaged email list.
* Comfortable representing an organization publicly. You are willing to participate in podcasts, interviews, events, trainings, and other public-facing opportunities.

Pay: $1,500.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Communications Coordinator
description:
**Organizational Overview**

The National Center on Domestic Violence, Trauma, and Mental Health (NCDVTMH) is a federally funded national resource center providing training and technical assistance; policy analysis and development; research and evaluation; and public awareness. NCDVTMH’s work is survivor-defined and rooted in principles of social justice. It is guided by the experiences of domestic and sexual violence survivors and their families, up-to-date research, and by an intersectional analysis of how systems impact the lives of survivors. Our work emphasizes the realities faced by marginalized communities and is aligned with the broader anti-violence movement.

**Position Description**

The Communications Coordinator will carry out NCDVTMH’s day-to-day communications and dissemination activities, ensuring that our resources, trainings, and messages reach the field accurately, consistently, and on schedule. This is a part-time, non-exempt staff position of 20 hours per week. This role reports to the Operations Manager, who provides day-to-day supervision and management. The Director sets NCDVTMH’s strategic communications plan and approves written content before dissemination. This position is remote within Illinois.

**Core Duties:**

* **Newsletter and Contact List Management:** Write, produce, and distribute NCDVTMH’s monthly newsletter and manage contact list.
* **Social media:** Manage NCDVTMH’s Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn accounts by creating, scheduling, and posting content, engaging with partner organizations, and growing our audience.
* **Campaigns: Support** planning and implement two annual social media campaigns (October and May), including content calendars, graphics, and post-campaign summaries.
* **Director statements:** Disseminate the Director’s statements to NCDVTMH’s email list, social media channels, and media contacts.
* · **Ensure content approval prior to dissemination:** Implement the Director’s communications plan and route written content to the Director for review, editing, and approval before dissemination.
* **Webinars:** Provide post-webinar follow-up, including posting recordings and related materials to the website and distributing them to participants and partners.
* **Product design:** Lead product design and visual production, including creating designs for staff who need design support and reviewing and refining staff-created designs (primarily in Canva) for quality, brand consistency, and accessibility before dissemination.
* **Online resource library:** Upload new NCDVTMH products and descriptions to the website’s resource library and ensure they are accurate, accessible, and easy to find.
* **Website:** Keep website content accurate and current, add new pages as needed, and serve as the primary point of contact for NCDVTMH’s contracted webmaster, who handles technical maintenance, software updates, backups, and security.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Gather and organize web, newsletter, and social media analytics and prepare communications data for federal grant reporting.
* **Collaboration:** Work with NCDVTMH staff, partners, and consultants to meet project timelines and adapt content into accessible formats for different audiences.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The Communications Coordinator will bring strong writing, editing, and organizational skills; working knowledge of social media, email marketing, and website content management; and strong graphic design skills in Canva. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education:** B.A. in communications, women’s/gender and sexuality studies, or related field and/or equivalent non-profit communications experience in a professional capacity required.

**Experience:** At least two to three years of experience in communications:

· Experience working in the fields of interpersonal violence, gender-based violence, mental health, substance use, trauma, public health, human rights, social justice, and/or related communications encouraged. · Experience in communications for a national non-profit organization is preferred

**Required Skills:**

* Excellent interpersonal communication skills
* Excellent writing and copyediting skills
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines independently in a remote, part-time setting
* Design skills for print and web dissemination, including infographics, while implementing accessibility best practices
* Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and brand consistency

· Proficiency in:

* Social media management and scheduling tools, such as Hootsuite
* Website content management (WordPress or similar)
* Email marketing software, such as Mailchimp or Constant Contact
* General office software, such as MS Office and Google Drive

Pay: $38,000.00 - $40,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

title: Account Director
description:
**Salary range: $100,000-120,000**

tmp helps B2B marketing leaders create coherence in a chaotic world. We’re looking for obsessively curious people to join us.

You'll join 300 B2B experts across strategy, data, creative, media, client services, Sales activation, and shared services. Different skills brought together in integrated teams, centred around our clients: the world’s most impactful tech companies.

So, if you’re interested in what makes the world work, if you find solving complex problems fun, and you love making the answers as simple as possible, then we’d love to hear from you.

**What we are looking for**

We’re looking for an experienced Account Director who combines a passion for marketing with the confidence to lead. This role is pivotal to the success and health of our client partnerships. You’ll take ownership of one or more major accounts, driving excellence in client management, team leadership, and delivery.

Across your accounts, you’ll build strong relationships with your clients, providing advice on marketing strategy and recommending marketing solutions to specific business challenges. Whilst you will work on a variety of clients and integrated marketing programs, a thorough understanding and experience managing integrated media solutions for clients is needed to be successful in this role. Under your direction, tmp will deliver head-turning, results-driven campaigns for your accounts.

You’ll be accountable for an annual revenue target of $3M, ensuring your accounts are profitable, healthy, and positioned for growth. Client satisfaction, commercial success, and the development of your team will all sit within your remit. To deliver at this level, you’ll continually deepen your understanding of marketing best practice, your clients’ industries, and the broader landscape while always looking for opportunities where TMP can add more value.

This is a role for someone who thrives on responsibility, inspires confidence, and leads with TMP’s values. You’ll be entrepreneurial in growing opportunities, resilient when challenges arise, human in how you connect, bold in pushing ideas further, and always looking to bring the magic back to B2B marketing.

**What you will do**

**Client leadership**

* Lead and inspire teams to manage client relationships with excellence, ensuring we not only meet but anticipate client needs.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships with senior client stakeholders (Manager, Director, and beyond), positioning tmp as a trusted advisor.
* Shape and challenge marketing strategy, helping clients to connect their business objectives to tmp’s integrated solutions.
* Provide clear, confident recommendations on the level of investment required to achieve ambitious goals.
* Translate results into meaningful impact, communicating outcomes in a way that secures long-term commitment and funding for future projects and campaigns.
* Act as the strategic voice of your client’s business inside tmp, ensuring their brand, priorities, and ambitions are understood and championed.
* Challenge and elevate briefs by pushing for clarity, ambition, and strategic alignment to ensure every project starts with a strong foundation.
* Deliver compelling quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that provide inspiration, insight, and clear recommendations for future success, working together.

**Account leadership**

* Represent your client’s business, brand, strategy, and objectives within our internal team, ensuring they have the context they need to succeed.
* Partner closely with the delivery lead to oversee multiple complex programs, ensuring the right expertise and structure is in place across your account.
* Keep strategy and execution connected to drive excellence by ensuring delivery always ladders up to client goals.
* Maintain a focus on outcomes and campaign results to measure the success and outcomes of campaign activities.
* Critically review and refine strategic, conceptual, and creative outputs, raising the bar on quality and ensuring alignment to the brief and overall strategy.
* Collaborate seamlessly across global clients and teams, adapting to cultural nuances and ways of working to ensure tmp delivers with impact and consistency worldwide.

**Commercial management**

* Take full ownership for converting opportunities that are right for the client and commercially healthy and profitable for tmp.
* Be accountable for accurate and timely Scopes of Work across your accounts that balance ambition with realistic delivery and manage risks before they become blockers.
* Lead forecasting across your accounts, remain accountable for ensuring revenue projections are accurate and programs remain on track.
* Act decisively to resolve commercial issues that could impact profitability or growth.
* Contribute to overall growth targets and commercial reviews, using your insight to shape the wider business picture.
* Invest wisely in client development activity, balancing cost with opportunity and scale.

**Marketing strategy**

* Develop a deep understanding of your client’s business, industry and the work, using this insight to inform all aspects of your oversight, perspective and direction.
* Provide recommendations for marketing solutions that deliver measurable impact on the business objectives of your clients.
* Use your deep expertise across tmp’s full service offering to add value to every client conversation.
* Bring a challenger mindset by asking the questions that elevate thinking and push strategies further.
* Capture success stories across your accounts and share them widely, helping your teams and peers see what “great” looks like.

**Business development**

* Own and lead on the develop of account plans and growth strategies, turning plans into action and rallying your team around them.
* Proactively spot and convert opportunities that expand tmp’s impact and create long-term value.
* Expand and deepen client contact networks, nurturing advocates and alumni who help us open new doors.
* Play a central role in pitches and RFPs, bringing your insight, experience, and leadership presence to the table.
* Be entrepreneurial in your approach, resilient in the face of challenges, and human in the way you lead growth conversations.

**Mentorship and management**

* Set the standard for best practice account management, acting as a role model for the wider team.
* Coach and develop talent, providing ongoing feedback, guidance, and stretch opportunities that build confidence and capability.
* Create a positive, high-performing team culture where people feel supported, motivated, and proud of the work they deliver.
* Lead career development planning to help your team set ambitious goals, track progress, provide feedback and grow their careers within tmp.
* Ensure new hires are onboarded with confidence, connected to our culture, and set up to thrive.
* Manage, inspire, and motivate direct reports, ensuring they bring tmp’s values to life in their own leadership and delivery.

**Success is measured by**

* Team feedback: the team on your accounts feel inspired to do their best work and have clear direction on what good looks like.
* Client feedback we’re achieving 8.4+ in our client satisfaction survey across your accounts
* Account performance: we’re meeting or exceeding expected outcomes across our marketing activity
* Account profitability: we’re meeting client profitability targets and showing strong levels of revenue recovery across your accounts.
* Accuracy and stability of delivery in line with project plans including accurate forecasting across your accounts.
* Growth of account/s: Achieving client targets, developing new relationships and achieving growth goals across your accounts, as identified as part of Account Plans.

  
**Requirements**

**Who you are**

* A confident and inclusive leader who inspires trust across clients and teams.
* A strategic marketing thinker who can connect the bigger picture to the finer details.
* Positive and resilient, always proactive in finding solutions and moving work forward.
* Ready to challenge thinking constructively, pushing clients and teams to achieve the best possible outcomes.
* Skilled at relationship management, demonstrated by being brilliant at influencing, building trust, and communicating with clarity at every level.
* Curious and quick to learn, able to interrogate complex information and distill it into clear recommendations.
* A collaborative problem solver who guides and supports your team while staying open to new ideas and perspectives.
* Authentically human in approach and motivated by creating work that delivers real impact.

**What you will need**

* Deep experience leading integrated marketing programs, with proven expertise in media strategy, media buys, and channel selection to drive business outcomes for your client.
* Strong knowledge of brand and ABM programs, with the ability to connect strategy to measurable business impact.
* 5+ years of previous agency experience, ideally in a B2B environment, with a proven track record of delivering value and growth for clients at the senior level.
* Demonstrated experience managing senior client and partner relationships, confident communicating at a senior level both internally and externally.
* Proven ability to direct marketing programs based on business objectives, and to recommend bold, effective solutions to client challenges.
* Commercial acumen with experience in forecasting, financial management, and ensuring account profitability.
* Familiarity with account management tools and processes that keep delivery clear and efficient.
* Proficient with core business tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.

  
**Benefits**

**What we offer in return**

* **Medical, dental, and vision insurance:** Health is a priority worth investing in. We empower every employee to take charge of their health by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance so they can perform at their best ability.
* **Pre-tax flexible spending account (FSA)** – healthcare, dependent care, and transit available: We are committed to saving you money as we provide high-quality healthcare that is as flexible and diverse as our team.
* **4% 401(k) contribution with no vesting period**: We are invested in our employees' careers. Each individual has the opportunity to build a future for themselves through a 401(k), and we see that as a success for the company as well.
* **Plentiful paid time off**: Each employee has the freedom to choose how long they want to be away from work. We recommend at least 20 days of PTO, so employees can fully rest and avoid burnout.
* **Sick leave (15 days annually):** Illnesses are taken seriously at tmp. We provide 15 days of sick leave so employees can take their time to make a full recovery before returning to work.
* **Holiday shutdown (December 26th - 29th)**: As the whole company shuts down for a few days, you can celebrate the holidays with loved ones.
* **Parental leave:**
* + **Primary caregiver:** 12 weeks full pay and then 12 weeks 50% pay
* + **Secondary caregiver**: 12 weeks full pay
* **Access to Unmind:** Our well-being platform, including access to therapists and coaches
* **Employer-funded life, AD&D & disability insurance:** tmp offers all employees life and AD&D insurance and makes sure you and your loved ones are protected in times of need.
* **Company getaways:** Whether it is a local office holiday party or a full-blown international trip, we believe in bonding through quality time spent together as a team.

**We are currently eligible to hire within these US states:**

*CA, CO, IL, WA, and TX.*

**A note on applying:**

*Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. Research shows some people hold back unless they meet 100% of the requirements. We do not want that to be you.*

*At tmp, we hire for potential, mindset, and character as much as experience. If you are excited about the role but your background is not a perfect match, we would still love to hear from you. You might be exactly what we are looking for, either for this role or another.*

*Diversity equals increased creativity, which equals better results for all. We’re committed to equality of opportunity and applications from all individuals are encouraged. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please don’t hesitate to let us know.*

title: Director of Product Design
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

**What success looks like:**

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

* Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
* Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
* Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
* Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
* Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
* Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
* Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
* Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
* Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
* Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
* See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
* Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
* A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
* You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
* You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
* You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
* You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
* Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
* You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
* You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
* You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

description:

Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives discussion appraisal with each employee and performance; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline, and discharge and administer all other personnel actions.  

  
  
**Qualifications**

* Eager to grow and continue to improve Integrated Production and Post-Production offerings at EVERSANA INTOUCH.
* Solid business acumen and problem-solving skills.

description:
**We Make Everything Around Us Better**

At PRIME AE, that’s not a slogan, it’s how we work.

Every bridge, building, campus, park, and roadway we design exists to improve how people live, move, learn, and connect. Through architecture, engineering, planning, and consulting, we partner with clients to create thoughtful, practical solutions that leave communities stronger than we found them.

If you want your work to matter, and to be surrounded by smart, collaborative people who care about doing things the right way, you’ll feel at home here.

**Who We Are:**

**PRIME AE Group, Inc.** (www.primeeng.com) is a nationally ranked, full-service architecture and engineering firm driven by collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to strengthening the communities we serve. With a growing footprint of offices across the country and a diverse team of more than 550 professionals, we partner with public and private sector clients to deliver thoughtful, high-impact solutions across transportation, education, healthcare, municipal, federal, commercial, and recreational markets.

Our culture blends entrepreneurial energy with the resources of a scaled, multidisciplinary platform—giving our people the opportunity to shape meaningful projects while influencing the future direction of the firm. As PRIME AE continues to expand its capabilities, geographic reach, and leadership bench, this is an exciting time to join a team that is building momentum, investing in growth, and empowering leaders to make a lasting impact.

**The Opportunity:**

We are currently seeking a **Director, Bridge Design,** to join our **Massachusetts team**.

In this leadership role, you will help shape and grow PRIME AE’s bridge design practice throughout Massachusetts and the broader New England region. You will provide technical and operational leadership, oversee the successful delivery of bridge and structural projects, develop and mentor staff, strengthen key client relationships, and identify opportunities to expand the firm’s transportation portfolio.

**What You’ll Do:**

As the **Director, Bridge Design**, you will provide leadership and strategic direction for bridge and structural design services while remaining actively engaged with clients, project teams, and major pursuits. You will oversee project delivery, technical quality, staffing, and team development while helping ensure projects meet client expectations for scope, schedule, budget, and quality.

You will also serve as a senior client-facing leader, developing relationships with transportation agencies and industry partners, supporting proposals and pursuits, and helping build a sustainable pipeline of bridge and structural work.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic, technical, and operational leadership for bridge and structural design services, supporting the continued growth of PRIME AE’s transportation practice.
* Oversee the delivery of bridge design, rehabilitation, replacement, preservation, and structural transportation projects, ensuring technical quality and successful project performance.
* Provide senior-level technical guidance and quality oversight for plans, calculations, specifications, estimates, reports, and other engineering deliverables.
* Develop, mentor, and lead bridge engineering staff while supporting workforce planning, workload management, technical development, and succession planning.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with state DOTs, municipalities, transportation agencies, teaming partners, and other key clients.
* Lead and support business development, proposals, pursuits, presentations, contract negotiations, and strategic teaming opportunities to expand the bridge project portfolio.
* Monitor project and practice performance, including scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, quality, utilization, and overall project delivery.
* Collaborate with transportation and corporate leadership across PRIME AE to identify growth opportunities, share resources, and expand bridge capabilities throughout Massachusetts and the broader region.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline required.
* Significant progressive experience in bridge/structural engineering, project delivery, and leadership, including responsibility for complex transportation infrastructure projects.
* Professional Engineer (P.E.) license, with Massachusetts licensure.
* Strong technical expertise in bridge design, rehabilitation, replacement, structural analysis, and applicable AASHTO and transportation agency standards.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary project teams, technical staff, project managers, and complex bridge/structural programs.
* Proven ability to develop and maintain relationships with public transportation agencies, clients, consultants, and industry partners.
* Demonstrated success with business development, proposal development, project pursuits, client development, and building project backlog.
* Strong leadership, communication, mentoring, strategic planning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Prior experience with MassDOT and MBTA is required.

**Why PRIME AE:**

We don’t just fill positions; we invest in people.

At PRIME AE, you’ll find a supportive, flexible environment where careers are built intentionally, not accidentally. You’ll work on projects that improve everyday life, alongside colleagues who challenge and respect one another.

What sets us apart:

PRIME AE Group is committed to creating an inclusive environment where differences are respected, voices are heard, and everyone has the opportunity to succeed.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
  
  
**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**

Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
